9.1.e: That Indra will we laud whom songs and hymns of praise have magnified. Striving to win, we celebrate his many deeds of hero might. I Soma Pavamana

9.1.s: vr̥ṣā pavasva dʰārayā marutvate ca matsaraḥ viśvā dadʰāna ojasā ՙ compare diśvā taṃ tvā dʰarttāramoṇyo3ḥ pavamāna svardr̥śam hinve vājeṣu vājinam
9.1.d: वृषा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः विश्वा दधान ओजसा ՙ चोम्परे दिश्वा तं त्वा धर्त्तारमोण्यो३ः पवमान स्वर्दृशम् हिन्वे वाजेषु वाजिनम्
9.1.e: Fleet as swift steeds thy cows celestial have been poured, O Pavamana, with the milk into the vat. Sages who make thee bright, O friend whom Rishis love, have shed continuous streams from out the realm of air.

9.1.s: ayā citto vipānayā hariḥ pavasva dʰārayā yujaṃ vājeṣu codaya
9.1.d: अया चित्तो विपानया हरिः पवस्व धारया युजं वाजेषु चोदय
9.1.e: The beams of Pavamana, sent from earth and heaven his ensigns who is ever stedfast, travel round. When on the sieve the golden-hued is cleansed he rests within the jars as one who seats him in his place.

9.1.s: vr̥ṣā śoṇo abʰikanikradadgā nadayanneṣi pr̥tʰivīmuta dyām indrasyeva vagnurā śr̥ṇva ājau pracodayannarṣasi vācamemām
9.1.d: वृषा शोणो अभिकनिक्रदद्गा नदयन्नेषि पृथिवीमुत द्याम् इन्द्रस्येव वग्नुरा शृण्व आजौ प्रचोदयन्नर्षसि वाचमेमाम्
9.1.e: O thou who seest all things, sovran as thou art and passing strong, thy rays encompass every form. Pervading with thy natural powers thou flowest on, and as the whole world's Lord, O Soma, thou art King. II Soma Pavamana

9.1.s: rasāyyaḥ payasā pinvamāna īrayanneṣi madʰumantamam̐śum pavamāna santanimeṣi kr̥ṇvannindrāya soma pariṣicyamānaḥ
9.1.d: रसाय्यः पयसा पिन्वमान ईरयन्नेषि मधुमन्तमꣳशुम् पवमान सन्तनिमेषि कृण्वन्निन्द्राय सोम परिषिच्यमानः
9.1.e: From heaven hath Pavamana, made, as 'twere, the marvellous thunder, and The lofty light of all mankind.

9.1.s: evā pavasva madiro madāyodagrābʰasya namayanvadʰasnum pari varṇaṃ bʰaramāṇo ruśantaṃ gavyurno arṣa pari soma siktaḥ
9.1.d: एवा पवस्व मदिरो मदायोदग्राभस्य नमयन्वधस्नुम् परि वर्णं भरमाणो रुशन्तं गव्युर्नो अर्ष परि सोम सिक्तः
9.1.e: The gladdening and auspicious juice of thee, O Pavamana, King! Flows o'cr the woollen straining-cloth.

9.1.s: tvāmiddʰi havāmahe sātau vājasya kāravaḥ tvāṃ vr̥treṣvindra satpatiṃ narastvāṃ kāṣṭʰāsvarvataḥ
9.1.d: त्वामिद्धि हवामहे सातौ वाजस्य कारवः त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस्त्वां काष्ठास्वर्वतः
9.1.e: Thy juice, O Pavamana, sends its rays abroad fixe splendid skill, Like lustre, all heaven's light, to see. III Soma Pavamana

9.1.s: sa tvaṃ naścitra vajrahasta dʰr̥ṣṇuyā maha stavāno adrivaḥ gāmaśvam̐ ratʰyamindra saṃ kira satrā vājaṃ na jigyuṣe
9.1.d: स त्वं नश्चित्र वज्रहस्त धृष्णुया मह स्तवानो अद्रिवः गामश्वꣳ रथ्यमिन्द्र सं किर सत्रा वाजं न जिग्युषे
9.1.e: Impetuous, bright, have they come forth, unwearied in their speed, like bulls, Driving the black skin far away.

9.1.s: abʰi pra vaḥ surādʰasamindramarca yatʰā vide yo jaritr̥bʰyo magʰavā purūvasuḥ sahasreṇeva śikṣati
9.1.d: अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति
9.1.e: May we attain the bridge of bliss, leaving the bridge of woe behind: The riteless Dasa may we quell!

9.1.s: śatānīkeva pra jigāti dʰr̥ṣṇuyā hanti vr̥trāṇi dāśuṣe gireriva pra rasā asya pinvire datrāṇi purubʰojasaḥ
9.1.d: शतानीकेव प्र जिगाति धृष्णुया हन्ति वृत्राणि दाशुषे गिरेरिव प्र रसा अस्य पिन्विरे दत्राणि पुरुभोजसः
9.1.e: The mighty Pavamana's roar is heard as 'twere the rush of rain The lightning-Rashes move in heaven.

9.1.s: tvāmidā hyo naro 'pīpyanvajrinbʰūrṇayaḥ sa indra stomavāhasa iha śrudʰyupa svasaramā gahi
9.1.d: त्वामिदा ह्यो नरो ऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः स इन्द्र स्तोमवाहस इह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि
9.1.e: Indu, pour out abundant food with store of cattle and of gold, Of heroes, Soma! and of steeds!

9.1.s: matsvā suśiprinharivastamīmahe tvayā bʰūṣanti vedʰasaḥ tava śravām̐syupamānyuktʰya suteṣvindra girvaṇaḥ
9.1.d: मत्स्वा सुशिप्रिन्हरिवस्तमीमहे त्वया भूषन्ति वेधसः तव श्रवाꣳस्युपमान्युक्थ्य सुतेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः
9.1.e: Flow onward, dear to all mankind fi full the mighty heaven and earth, As Dawn, as Surya with his beams

9.1.s: yaste mado vareṇyastenā pavasvāndʰasā devāvīragʰaśam̐sahā
9.1.d: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वान्धसा देवावीरघशꣳसहा
9.1.e: On every side, O Soma, flow round us with thy protecting stream, As Rasa flows around the world! IV Soma Pavamana

9.1.s: jagʰnirvr̥tramamitriyam̐ sasnirvājaṃ divedive goṣātiraśvasā asi
9.1.d: जघ्निर्वृत्रममित्रियꣳ सस्निर्वाजं दिवेदिवे गोषातिरश्वसा असि
9.1.e: Flow on, O thou of lofty thought, flow swift in thy beloved form, Saying, I go where dwell the Gods.

9.1.s: saṃmiślo aruṣo bʰuvaḥ sūpastʰābʰirna dʰenubʰi sīdaṃ ccʰyeno na yonimā
9.1.d: संमिश्लो अरुषो भुवः सूपस्थाभिर्न धेनुभि सीदं च्छ्येनो न योनिमा
9.1.e: Preparing what is unprepared, and bringing store of food to man, Make thou the rain descend from heaven

9.1.s: ayaṃ pūṣā rayirbʰagaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati patirviśvasya bʰūmano vyakʰyadrodasī ubʰe
9.1.d: अयं पूषा रयिर्भगः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति पतिर्विश्वस्य भूमनो व्यख्यद्रोदसी उभे
9.1.e: Even here is he who, swift of course, hath with the river's wave Rowed down. From heaven upon the straining cloth.

9.1.s: samu priyā anūṣata gāvo madāya gʰr̥ṣvayaḥ somāsaḥ kr̥ṇvate patʰaḥ pavamānāsa indavaḥ
9.1.d: समु प्रिया अनूषत गावो मदाय घृष्वयः सोमासः कृण्वते पथः पवमानास इन्दवः
9.1.e: With might. producing glare, the juice enters the purifying sieve, Far-seeing, sending forth its light.

9.1.s: ya ojiṣṭʰastamā bʰara pavamāna śravāyyam yaḥ pañca carṣaṇīrabʰi rayiṃ yena vanāmahe
9.1.d: य ओजिष्ठस्तमा भर पवमान श्रवाय्यम् यः पञ्च चर्षणीरभि रयिं येन वनामहे
9.1.e: Inviting him from far away, and even from near at hand, the juice For Indra is poured forth as meath.

9.1.s: vr̥ṣā matīnāṃ pavate vicakṣaṇaḥ somo ahnāṃ pratarītoṣasāṃ divaḥ prāṇā sindʰūnāṃ kalaśām̐ acikradadindrasya hārdyāviśanmanīṣibʰiḥ
9.1.d: वृषा मतीनां पवते विचक्षणः सोमो अह्नां प्रतरीतोषसां दिवः प्राणा सिन्धूनां कलशाꣳ अचिक्रददिन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन्मनीषिभिः
9.1.e: In union they have sung the hymn: with stones they urge the golden-hued, Indu for Indra, for his drink. V Soma Pavamana

9.1.s: manīṣibʰiḥ pavate pūrvyaḥ kavirnr̥bʰiryataḥ pari kośām̐ asiṣyadat tritasya nāma janayanmadʰu kṣarannindrasya vāyūm̐ sakʰyāya vardʰayan
9.1.d: मनीषिभिः पवते पूर्व्यः कविर्नृभिर्यतः परि कोशाꣳ असिष्यदत् त्रितस्य नाम जनयन्मधु क्षरन्निन्द्रस्य वायूꣳ सख्याय वर्धयन्
9.1.e: The glittering maids send Sdra forth, the glorious sisters, closeallied, Send Indu forth, their mighty Lord.

9.1.s: ayaṃ punāna uṣaso arocayadayam̐ sindʰubʰyo abʰavadu lokakr̥t ayaṃ triḥ sapta duduhāna āśiram̐ somo hr̥de pavate cāru matsaraḥ
9.1.d: अयं पुनान उषसो अरोचयदयꣳ सिन्धुभ्यो अभवदु लोककृत् अयं त्रिः सप्त दुदुहान आशिरꣳ सोमो हृदे पवते चारु मत्सरः
9.1.e: Pervade, O Pavamana, all our treasures with repeated light, Pressed out, O God thyself, for Gods!

9.1.s: evā hyasi vīrayurevā śūra uta stʰirah evā te rādʰyaṃ manaḥ
9.1.d: एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरह् एवा ते राध्यं मनः
9.1.e: Pour on us, Pavamana! rain, as service and fair praise for Gods: Pour forth unceasingly for food! VI Agni

9.1.s: evā rātistuvīmagʰa viśvebʰirdʰāyi dʰātr̥bʰiḥ adʰā cidindra naḥ sacā
9.1.d: एवा रातिस्तुवीमघ विश्वेभिर्धायि धातृभिः अधा चिदिन्द्र नः सचा
9.1.e: The watchful guardian of the people hath been born, Agni, the very strong, for fresh prosperity. With oil upon his face. with high heaven-touching flame, he shineth splendidly, pure, for the Bharatas.

9.1.s: mo ṣu brahmeva tadindrayurbʰuvo vājānāṃ pate matsvā sutasya gomataḥ
9.1.d: मो षु ब्रह्मेव तदिन्द्रयुर्भुवो वाजानां पते मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः
9.1.e: O Agni, the Angirasas discovered thee what time thou layest hidden, fleeing back from wood to wood. Thou by attrition art produced as conquering might, and men, O Angiras, call thee the Son of Strength.

9.1.s: indraṃ viśvā avīvr̥dʰantsamudravyacasaṃ giraḥ ratʰītamam̐ ratʰīnāṃ vājānām̐ satpatiṃ patim
9.1.d: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः रथीतमꣳ रथीनां वाजानाꣳ सत्पतिं पतिम्
9.1.e: The men enkindle Agni in his threefold seat, ensign of sacrifice, the earliest bousehold-priest. With Indra and the Gods together on the grass let the wise priest sit to complete the sacrifice! VII Mitra-Varuna

9.1.s: sakʰye ta indra vājino mā bʰema śavasaspate tvāmabʰi pra nonumo jetāramaparājitam
9.1.d: सख्ये त इन्द्र वाजिनो मा भेम शवसस्पते त्वामभि प्र नोनुमो जेतारमपराजितम्
9.1.e: This Soma hath been pressed for you, Low-strengtheners, Mitra, Varuna! List, list ye here to this may call!

9.1.s: pūrvīrindrasya rātayo na vi dasyantyūtayaḥ yadā vājasya gomata stotr̥bʰyo mam̐hate magʰam
9.1.d: पूर्वीरिन्द्रस्य रातयो न वि दस्यन्त्यूतयः यदा वाजस्य गोमत स्तोतृभ्यो मꣳहते मघम्
9.1.e: Both Kings who never injure aught have come to their sublimest home, The thousand-pillared, firmly based.

9.1.s: eta asr̥gramindavastiraḥ pavitramāśavaḥ viśvānyabʰi saubʰagā
9.1.d: एत असृग्रमिन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः विश्वान्यभि सौभगा
9.1.e: Worshipped with fat libation. Lords of gifts, Adityas, sovran Kings, They wait on him whose life is true. VIII Indra

9.1.s: vigʰnanto duritā puru sugā tokāya vājinaḥ tmanā kr̥ṇvanto arvataḥ
9.1.d: विघ्नन्तो दुरिता पुरु सुगा तोकाय वाजिनः त्मना कृण्वन्तो अर्वतः
9.1.e: Armed with the bones of dead Dadhyach, Indra with unresisted. might The nine-and-ninety Vritras slew.

9.1.s: kr̥ṇvanto varivo gave 'bʰyarṣanti suṣṭutim iḍāmasmabʰyam̐ saṃyatam
9.1.d: कृण्वन्तो वरिवो गवे ऽभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिम् इडामस्मभ्यꣳ संयतम्
9.1.e: He, searching for the horse's head that in the mountains lay concealed, Found it in Saryandvdn lake.

9.1.s: rājā medʰābʰirīyate pavamāno manāvadʰi antarikṣeṇa yātave
9.1.d: राजा मेधाभिरीयते पवमानो मनावधि अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे
9.1.e: Then straight they recognized the mystic name of the creative Steer. There in the mansion of the Moon. IX Indra Agni I. As rain from out the cloud, for you, Indra and Agni, from my thought This noblest praise hath been produced.

9.1.s: ā naḥ soma saho juvo rūpaṃ na varcase bʰara suṣvāṇo devavītaye
9.1.d: आ नः सोम सहो जुवो रूपं न वर्चसे भर सुष्वाणो देववीतये
9.1.e: Indra and Agni, listen to the singer's call: accept his songs. Fulfil, ye mighty Lords, his prayers!

9.1.s: ā na indo śatagvinaṃ gavāṃ poṣam̐ svaśvyam vahā bʰagattimūtaye
9.1.d: आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं गवां पोषꣳ स्वश्व्यम् वहा भगत्तिमूतये
9.1.e: Give us not up to indigence, ye heroes, Indra, Agni, nor To Slander and reproach of men! X Soma Pavamana

9.1.s: taṃ tvā nr̥mṇāni bibʰratam̐ sadʰastʰeṣu maho divaḥ cārum̐ sukr̥tyayemahe
9.1.d: तं त्वा नृम्णानि बिभ्रतꣳ सधस्थेषु महो दिवः चारुꣳ सुकृत्ययेमहे
9.1.e: Gold-Hued! as one who giveth strength flow on for Gods to drink, a draught For Vayu and the Marut host!

9.1.s: saṃvr̥ktadʰr̥ṣṇumuktʰyaṃ mahāmahivrataṃ madam śataṃ puro rurukṣaṇim
9.1.d: संवृक्तधृष्णुमुक्थ्यं महामहिव्रतं मदम् शतं पुरो रुरुक्षणिम्
9.1.e: The Steer shines brightly with the Gods, dear Sage in his appointed home. Even Pavamana unbeguiled.

9.1.s: atastvā rayirabʰyayadrājānam̐ sukrato divaḥ suparṇo avyatʰī bʰarat
9.1.d: अतस्त्वा रयिरभ्ययद्राजानꣳ सुक्रतो दिवः सुपर्णो अव्यथी भरत्
9.1.e: O Pavamana, sent by prayer, roaring about thy dwelling-place, Ascend to Vayu as Law bids! XI Soma Pavamana

9.1.s: adʰā hinvāna indriyaṃ jyāyo mahitvamānaśe abʰiṣṭikr̥dvicarṣaṇiḥ
9.1.d: अधा हिन्वान इन्द्रियं ज्यायो महित्वमानशे अभिष्टिकृद्विचर्षणिः
9.1.e: O Soma, Indu, every day thy friendship hath been my delight. Many fiends follow me; help me, thou tawny-hued: pass on beyond these barriers!

9.1.s: viśvasmā itsvardr̥śe sādʰāraṇam̐ rajasturam gopāmr̥tasya virbʰarat
9.1.d: विश्वस्मा इत्स्वर्दृशे साधारणꣳ रजस्तुरम् गोपामृतस्य विर्भरत्
9.1.e: Close to thy bosom am I. Soma, day and night draining the milk, O golden hued. Surya himself refulgent with his glow have we, as birds, o'ertaken in his course. XII Soma Pavamana

9.1.s: iṣe pavasva dʰārayā mr̥jyamāno manīṣibʰiḥ indo rucābʰi gā ihi
9.1.d: इषे पवस्व धारया मृज्यमानो मनीषिभिः इन्दो रुचाभि गा इहि
9.1.e: Active, while being purified, he hath assailed all enemies: They deck the Sage with holy hymns.

9.1.s: punāno varivaskr̥dʰyūrjaṃ janāya girvaṇaḥ hare sr̥jāna āśiram
9.1.d: पुनानो वरिवस्कृध्यूर्जं जनाय गिर्वणः हरे सृजान आशिरम्
9.1.e: The Red hath mounted to his shrine; strong Indra hath approached the juice: In his firm dwelling let him rest!

9.1.s: punāno devavītaya indrasya yāhi niṣkr̥tam dyutāno vājibʰirhitaḥ
9.1.d: पुनानो देववीतय इन्द्रस्य याहि निष्कृतम् द्युतानो वाजिभिर्हितः
9.1.e: O Indu, Soma, send us now great opulence from every side: Pour on us treasures thousandfold! XIII Indra

9.1.s: agnināgniḥ samidʰyate kavirgr̥hapatiryuvā havyavāḍjuhvāsyaḥ
9.1.d: अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा हव्यवाड्जुह्वास्यः
9.1.e: Drink Soma, Indra Lord of bays! and let it cheer thee: the stone, like a well-guided courser, Directed by the presser's arms bath pressed it.

9.1.s: yastvāmagne haviṣpatirdūtaṃ deva saparyati tasya sma prāvitā bʰava
9.1.d: यस्त्वामग्ने हविष्पतिर्दूतं देव सपर्यति तस्य स्म प्राविता भव
9.1.e: So let the draught of joy, thy dear companion, by which, O Lord of bays, thou slayest Vritras, Delight thee, Indra, Lord of princely treasuresl

9.1.s: yo agniṃ devavītaye haviṣmām̐ āvivāsati tasmai pāvaka mr̥ḍaya
9.1.d: यो अग्निं देववीतये हविष्माꣳ आविवासति तस्मै पावक मृडय
9.1.e: Mark closely, Maghavan, the word I utter, this eulogy recited by Vasislitha: Accept the prayers I offer at thy banquet! XIV Indra

9.1.s: mitram̐ huve pūtadakṣaṃ varuṇaṃ ca riśādasam dʰiyaṃ gʰr̥tācīm̐ sādʰantā
9.1.d: मित्रꣳ हुवे पूतदक्षं वरुणं च रिशादसम् धियं घृताचीꣳ साधन्ता
9.1.e: Heroes of one accord brought forth and formed for kingship Indra who wins the victory in all encounters, For power, in firmness, in the field, the great destroyer, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour.

9.1.s: r̥tena mitrāvaruṇāvr̥tāvr̥dʰāvr̥taspr̥śā kratuṃ br̥hantamāśātʰe
9.1.d: ऋतेन मित्रावरुणावृतावृधावृतस्पृशा क्रतुं बृहन्तमाशाथे
9.1.e: The holy sages form a ring, to view and sing unto the Ram. Inciters, very brilliant, from all deceit, are with your chariters nigh to hear.

9.1.s: kavī no mitrāvaruṇā tuvijātā urukṣayā dakṣaṃ dadʰāte apasam
9.1.d: कवी नो मित्रावरुणा तुविजाता उरुक्षया दक्षं दधाते अपसम्
9.1.e: Bards joined in song to Indra so that he might drink the Soma juice. The Lord of light, that he whose laws stand fast might aid with power and with the help he gives. XV Indra

9.1.s: indreṇa sam̐ hi dr̥kṣase saṃjagmāno abibʰyuṣā mandū samānavarccasā
9.1.d: इन्द्रेण सꣳ हि दृक्षसे संजग्मानो अबिभ्युषा मन्दू समानवर्च्चसा
9.1.e: He who as sovran Lord of men moves with his chariots unrestrained, The Vritra-slayer, conqueror of all fighting hosts, preeminents, is praised in song.

9.1.s: ādaha svadʰāmanu punargarbʰatvamerire dadʰānā nāma yajñiyam
9.1.d: आदह स्वधामनु पुनर्गर्भत्वमेरिरे दधाना नाम यज्ञियम्
9.1.e: Honour that Indra, Puruhanman! for his aid, him in whose hand of old the fair Sustaining bolt of thunder, mighty like the God, like Surya, was deposited! XVI Soma Pavamana

9.1.s: vīḍu cidārujatnubʰirguhā cidindra vahnibʰiḥ avinda usriyā anu
9.1.d: वीडु चिदारुजत्नुभिर्गुहा चिदिन्द्र वह्निभिः अविन्द उस्रिया अनु
9.1.e: The Sage of heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands, with roars, Gives us delightful powers of life.

9.1.s: tā huve yayoridaṃ papne viśvaṃ purā kr̥tam indrāgnī na mardʰataḥ
9.1.d: ता हुवे ययोरिदं पप्ने विश्वं पुरा कृतम् इन्द्राग्नी न मर्धतः
9.1.e: He, the bright son, when born, illumed his parents who had sprung to life, Great Son, great strengtheners of Law.

9.1.s: ugrā vigʰaninā mr̥dʰa indrāgnī havāmahe tā no mr̥ḍāta īdr̥śe
9.1.d: उग्रा विघनिना मृध इन्द्राग्नी हवामहे ता नो मृडात ईदृशे
9.1.e: On, onward to a glorious home, free from all guile and dear to. men, Flow with enjoyment to our praise! XVII Soma Pavamana

9.1.s: hatʰo vr̥trāṇyāryā hatʰo dāsāni satpatī hatʰo viśvā apa dviṣaḥ
9.1.d: हथो वृत्राण्यार्या हथो दासानि सत्पती हथो विश्वा अप द्विषः
9.1.e: For, verily, Pavamana, thou, divine! endued with brightest splendour, calling all Creatures to immortality.

9.1.s: abʰi somāsa āyavaḥ pavante madyaṃ madam samudrasyādʰi viṣṭape manīṣiṇo matsarāso madacyutaḥ
9.1.d: अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम् समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपे मनीषिणो मत्सरासो मदच्युतः
9.1.e: With whom Dadhyach Navagva opened fastened doors, by whom the sages gained their wish, By whom they won the fame of lovely Amrita in the felicity of Gods. XVIII Soma Pavamana

9.1.s: taratsamudraṃ pavamāna ūrmiṇā rājā deva r̥taṃ br̥hat arṣā mitrasya varuṇasya dʰarmaṇā pra hinvāna r̥taṃ br̥hat
9.1.d: तरत्समुद्रं पवमान ऊर्मिणा राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् अर्षा मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धर्मणा प्र हिन्वान ऋतं बृहत्
9.1.e: Soma, while filtered, with his wave flows through the long wool of the sheep, Roaring, while purified, before the voice of song.

9.1.s: nr̥bʰiryemāṇo haryato vicakṣaṇo rājā devaḥ samudryaḥ
9.1.d: नृभिर्येमाणो हर्यतो विचक्षणो राजा देवः समुद्र्यः
9.1.e: With prayers they cleanse the mighty steed, sporting in wood, above the fleece: Our hymns, intoned, have praised him of the triple height.

9.1.s: tisro vāca īrayati pra vahnirr̥tasya dʰītiṃ brahmaṇo manīṣām gāvo yanti gopatiṃ pr̥ccʰamānāḥ somaṃ yanti matayo vāvaśānāḥ
9.1.d: तिस्रो वाच ईरयति प्र वह्निरृतस्य धीतिं ब्रह्मणो मनीषाम् गावो यन्ति गोपतिं पृच्छमानाः सोमं यन्ति मतयो वावशानाः
9.1.e: He hath been hastened to the jars, bountiful, like an eager horse, And, lifting up his voice, while filtered, glided on. XIX Soma Pavamana

9.1.s: somaṃ gāvo dʰenavo vāvaśānāḥ somaṃ viprā matibʰiḥ pr̥ccʰamānāḥ somaḥ suta r̥cyate pūyamānaḥ some arkāstriṣṭubʰaḥ saṃ navante
9.1.d: सोमं गावो धेनवो वावशानाः सोमं विप्रा मतिभिः पृच्छमानाः सोमः सुत ऋच्यते पूयमानः सोमे अर्कास्त्रिष्टुभः सं नवन्ते
9.1.e: Father of holy hymns, Soma flows onward, the father of the earth, father of heaven. Father of Agni, Surya's generator, the father who begat Indra and Vishnu.

9.1.s: evā naḥ soma pariṣicyamāna ā pavasva pūyamānaḥ svasti indramā viśa br̥hatā madena vardʰayā vācaṃ janayā purandʰim
9.1.d: एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमान आ पवस्व पूयमानः स्वस्ति इन्द्रमा विश बृहता मदेन वर्धया वाचं जनया पुरन्धिम्
9.1.e: Brahman of Gods, the leader of the poets, Rishi of sages, chief of savage creatures, Falcon amid the vultures, axe of forests, over the cleansing sieve goes Soma singing.

9.1.s: yaddyāva indra te śatam̐śataṃ bʰūmīruta syuḥ na tvā vajrintsahasram̐ suryā anu na jātamaṣṭa rodasī
9.1.d: यद्द्याव इन्द्र ते शतꣳशतं भूमीरुत स्युः न त्वा वज्रिन्त्सहस्रꣳ सुर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी
9.1.e: He, Soma Pavamana, like a river, hath stirred the wave of voice, our songs and praises Beholding these inferior powers, the hero, well knowing, takes his stand among the cattle. XX Agni I. Hither, for powerful kinship, I call Agni, him who prospers you, Most frequent at our solemn rites.

9.1.s: ā paprātʰa mahinā vr̥ṣṇyā vr̥ṣanviśvā śaviṣṭʰa śavasā asmām̐ ava magʰavangomati vraje vajriñcitrābʰirūtibʰiḥ
9.1.d: आ पप्राथ महिना वृष्ण्या वृषन्विश्वा शविष्ठ शवसा अस्माꣳ अव मघवन्गोमति व्रजे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः
9.1.e: That through this famed one's power he may stand by us, even as Tvasbtar comes Unto the forms that must be shaped.

9.1.s: vayaṃ gʰa tvā sutāvanta āpo na vr̥ktabarhiṣaḥ pavitrasya prasravaṇeṣu vr̥trahanpari stotāra āsate
9.1.d: वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते
9.1.e: This Agni is the Lord supreme above all glories' mid the Gods: May he come nigh to us with strength. XXI Indra

9.1.s: svaranti tvā sute naro vaso nireka uktʰinaḥ kadā sutaṃ tr̥ṣāṇa oka ā gama indra svabdīva vam̐sagaḥ
9.1.d: स्वरन्ति त्वा सुते नरो वसो निरेक उक्थिनः कदा सुतं तृषाण ओक आ गम इन्द्र स्वब्दीव वꣳसगः
9.1.e: This poured libation, Indra drink, immortal, gladdening, excellent! Streams of the bright have flowed to thee here at the seat of holy Law.

9.1.s: kaṇvebʰirdʰr̥ṣṇavā dʰr̥ṣadvājaṃ darṣi sahasriṇam piśaṅgarūpaṃ magʰavanvicarṣaṇe makṣū gomantamīmahe
9.1.d: कण्वेभिर्धृष्णवा धृषद्वाजं दर्षि सहस्रिणम् पिशङ्गरूपं मघवन्विचर्षणे मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे
9.1.e: When, Indra, thou dost guide thy bays, there is no better charioteer: None hath surpassed thee in thy might, none with good steeds o'ertaken thee.

9.1.s: taraṇiritsiṣāsati vājaṃ purandʰyā yujā ā va indraṃ puruhūtaṃ name girā nemiṃ taṣṭeva sudruvam
9.1.d: तरणिरित्सिषासति वाजं पुरन्ध्या युजा आ व इन्द्रं पुरुहूतं नमे गिरा नेमिं तष्टेव सुद्रुवम्
9.1.e: Sing glory now to Indra, say to him your solemn eulogies! The drops poured forth have made him glad: pay reverence to his noblest might! XII Indra

9.1.s: na duṣṭutirdraviṇodeṣu śasyate na sredʰantam̐ rayirnaśat suśaktirinmagʰavaṃ tubʰyaṃ māvate deṣṇaṃ yatpārye divi
9.1.d: न दुष्टुतिर्द्रविणोदेषु शस्यते न स्रेधन्तꣳ रयिर्नशत् सुशक्तिरिन्मघवं तुभ्यं मावते देष्णं यत्पार्ये दिवि
9.1.e: Indra, be pleased: drive forward, hero, striker of thy bays! Fair, like a sage, delighting in the meath, drink of the juice for rapturous joy.

9.1.s: tisro vāca udīrate gāvo mimanti dʰenavaḥ harireti kanikradat
9.1.d: तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः हरिरेति कनिक्रदत्
9.1.e: O Indra, fill thy belly anew with meath that seems to flow from heaven. The sweet-voiced raptures of this juice have come, as 'twere to heaven. to thee.

9.2.s: abʰi brahmīranūṣata yahvīrr̥tasya mātaraḥ marjayantīrdivaḥ śiśum
9.2.d: अभि ब्रह्मीरनूषत यह्वीरृतस्य मातरः मर्जयन्तीर्दिवः शिशुम्
9.2.e: Indra, victorious, Mitra-like, smote, like a Yati, Vritra dead. As Bhrigu quelled his foes, he cleft Vala in Soma's rapturous joy. I Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: rāyaḥ samudrām̐ścaturo 'smabʰyam̐ soma viśvataḥ ā pavasva sahasriṇaḥ
9.2.d: रायः समुद्राꣳश्चतुरो ऽस्मभ्यꣳ सोम विश्वतः आ पवस्व सहस्रिणः
9.2.e: Winner of gold and gear and cattle flow thou on, set as impregner, Indu! 'mid the worlds of life! Rich in brave men art thou, Soma, who winnest all: these holy singers wait upon thee with song.

9.2.s: sutāso madʰumattamāḥ somā indrāya mandinaḥ pavitravanto akṣaraṃ devāngaccʰantu vo madāḥ
9.2.d: सुतासो मधुमत्तमाः सोमा इन्द्राय मन्दिनः पवित्रवन्तो अक्षरं देवान्गच्छन्तु वो मदाः
9.2.e: O Soma, thou beholdest men from every side: O Pavamana, Steer, thou wanderest through these. Pour out upon us wealth in treasure and in gold: may we have strength to live among the things that be!

9.2.s: indurindrāya pavata iti devāso abruvan vācaspatirmakʰasyate viśvasyeśāna ojasāḥ
9.2.d: इन्दुरिन्द्राय पवत इति देवासो अब्रुवन् वाचस्पतिर्मखस्यते विश्वस्येशान ओजसाः
9.2.e: Thou passest to these worlds as sovran Lord thereof, O Indu, harnessing thy tawny well-winged mares. May they pour forth for thee milk and oil rich in sweets: O Soma, let the folk abide in thy decree! II Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: sahasradʰāraḥ pavate samudro vācamīṅkʰayaḥ somaspatī rayīṇām̐ sakʰendrasya divedive
9.2.d: सहस्रधारः पवते समुद्रो वाचमीङ्खयः सोमस्पती रयीणाꣳ सखेन्द्रस्य दिवेदिवे
9.2.e: The streams of Pavamana, thine, finder of all I have been ettused, Even as Surya's rays of light.

9.2.s: pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspate prabʰurgātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvataḥ ataptatanūrna tadāmo aśnute śr̥tāsa idvahantaḥ saṃ tadāśata
9.2.d: पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते प्रभुर्गात्राणि पर्येषि विश्वतः अतप्ततनूर्न तदामो अश्नुते शृतास इद्वहन्तः सं तदाशत
9.2.e: Making the light that shines from heaven thou flowest on to every form, Soma, thou swellest like a sea.

9.2.s: tapoṣpavitraṃ vitataṃ divaspade 'rcanto asya tantavo vyastʰiran avantyasya pavītāramāśavo divaḥ pr̥ṣṭʰamadʰi rohanti tejasā
9.2.d: तपोष्पवित्रं विततं दिवस्पदे ऽर्चन्तो अस्य तन्तवो व्यस्थिरन् अवन्त्यस्य पवीतारमाशवो दिवः पृष्ठमधि रोहन्ति तेजसा
9.2.e: Shown forth thou sendest out thy voice, O Pavamana, with a roar. Like Surya, God, as Law commands. III Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: arūrucaduṣasaḥ pr̥śniragriya ukṣā mimeti bʰuvaneṣu vājayuḥ māyāvino mamire asya māyayā nr̥cakṣasaḥ pitaro garbʰamā dadʰuḥ
9.2.d: अरूरुचदुषसः पृश्निरग्रिय उक्षा मिमेति भुवनेषु वाजयुः मायाविनो ममिरे अस्य मायया नृचक्षसः पितरो गर्भमा दधुः
9.2.e: Hitherward have the Somas streamed, the drops while they are purified: When blent, in waters they are raised.

9.2.s: pra mam̐hiṣṭʰāya gāyata r̥tāvne br̥hate śukraśociṣe upastutāso agnaye
9.2.d: प्र मꣳहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे उपस्तुतासो अग्नये
9.2.e: The milk hath run to meet them like floods rushing down a precipice: They come to Indra, being cleansed.

9.2.s: ā vam̐sate magʰavā vīravadyaśaḥ samiddʰo dyumnyāhutaḥ kuvinno asya sumatirbʰavīyasyaccʰā vājebʰirāgamat
9.2.d: आ वꣳसते मघवा वीरवद्यशः समिद्धो द्युम्न्याहुतः कुविन्नो अस्य सुमतिर्भवीयस्यच्छा वाजेभिरागमत्
9.2.e: O Soma Pavamana, thou flowest as Indra's gladdener: The men have seized and lead thee forth.

9.2.s: taṃ te madaṃ gr̥ṇīmasi vr̥ṣaṇaṃ pr̥kṣu sāsahim u lokakr̥tnumadrivo hariśriyam
9.2.d: तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृक्षु सासहिम् उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियम्
9.2.e: Thou, Indu, when, expressed by stones, thou runnest to the filter, art Ready for Indra's high decree.

9.2.s: yena jyotīm̐ṣyāyave manave ca viveditʰa mandāno asya barhiṣo vi rājasi
9.2.d: येन ज्योतीꣳष्यायवे मनवे च विवेदिथ मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि
9.2.e: Victorious, to be hailed with joy, O Soma, flow delighting men, As the supporter of mankind!

9.2.s: tadadyā citta uktʰino 'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvatʰā vr̥ṣapatnīrapo jayā divedive
9.2.d: तदद्या चित्त उक्थिनो ऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा वृषपत्नीरपो जया दिवेदिवे
9.2.e: Flow on, best Vritra-slayer; flow meet to be hailed with joyful lauds, pure, purifying, wonderful

9.2.s: śrudʰī havaṃ tiraścyā indra yastvā saparyati suvīryasya gomato rāyaspūrdʰi mahām̐ asi
9.2.d: श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महाꣳ असि
9.2.e: Pure, purifying, is he called, Soma effused and full of sweets, Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods. IV Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: yasta indra navīyasīṃ giraṃ mandrāmajījanat cikitvinmanasaṃ dʰiyaṃ pratnāmr̥tasya pipyuṣīm
9.2.d: यस्त इन्द्र नवीयसीं गिरं मन्द्रामजीजनत् चिकित्विन्मनसं धियं प्रत्नामृतस्य पिप्युषीम्
9.2.e: The Sage hath robed him in the sheep's wool for the banquet of the Gods, Subduing all our enemies.

9.2.s: tamu ṣṭavāma yaṃ gira indramuktʰāni vāvr̥dʰuḥ purūṇyasya naum̐syā siṣāsanto vanāmahe
9.2.d: तमु ष्टवाम यं गिर इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः पुरूण्यस्य नौꣳस्या सिषासन्तो वनामहे
9.2.e: For he, as Pavamana, sends thousandfold riches in the shape Of cattle to the worshippers.

9.2.s: pra ta āśvinīḥ pavamāna dʰenavo divyā asr̥granpayasā dʰarīmaṇi prāntarikṣātstʰāvirīste asr̥kṣata ye tvā mr̥jantyr̥ṣiṣāṇa vedʰasaḥ
9.2.d: प्र त आश्विनीः पवमान धेनवो दिव्या असृग्रन्पयसा धरीमणि प्रान्तरिक्षात्स्थाविरीस्ते असृक्षत ये त्वा मृजन्त्यृषिषाण वेधसः
9.2.e: Thou graspest all things with thy mind, and purifiest thee with thoughts: As such, O Soma, find us fame!

9.2.s: ubʰayataḥ pavamānasya raśmayo dʰruvasya sataḥ pari yanti ketavaḥ yadī pavitre adʰi mr̥jyate hariḥ sattā ni yonau kalaśeṣu sīdati
9.2.d: उभयतः पवमानस्य रश्मयो ध्रुवस्य सतः परि यन्ति केतवः यदी पवित्रे अधि मृज्यते हरिः सत्ता नि योनौ कलशेषु सीदति
9.2.e: Pour on us lofty glory, send sure riches to our liberal lords: Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

9.2.s: viśvā dʰāmāni viśvacakṣa r̥bʰvasaḥ prabʰoṣṭe sataḥ pari yanti ketavaḥ vyānaśī pavase soma dʰarmaṇā patirviśvasya bʰuvanasya rājasi
9.2.d: विश्वा धामानि विश्वचक्ष ऋभ्वसः प्रभोष्टे सतः परि यन्ति केतवः व्यानशी पवसे सोम धर्मणा पतिर्विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि
9.2.e: As thou art cleansed, O wondrous steed, O Soma, thou hast entered, like A pious king, into the songs,

9.2.s: pavamāno ajījanaddivaścitraṃ na tanyatum jyotirvaiśvānaraṃ br̥hat
9.2.d: पवमानो अजीजनद्दिवश्चित्रं न तन्यतुम् ज्योतिर्वैश्वानरं बृहत्
9.2.e: He, Soma, like a courser in the floods invincible, made bright With hands, is resting in the press.

9.2.s: pavamāna rasastava mado rājannaduccʰunaḥ vi vāramavyamarṣati
9.2.d: पवमान रसस्तव मदो राजन्नदुच्छुनः वि वारमव्यमर्षति
9.2.e: Disporting, like a liberal chief, thou goest. Soma to the sieve, Lending the laud heroic strength. V Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: pavamānasya te raso dakṣo vi rājati dyumān jyotirviśvam̐ svardr̥śe
9.2.d: पवमानस्य ते रसो दक्षो वि राजति द्युमान् ज्योतिर्विश्वꣳ स्वर्दृशे
9.2.e: Pour on us with thy juice all kinds of corn, each sort of nourishment! And, Soma, all felicities!

9.2.s: pra yadgāvo na bʰūrṇayastveṣā ayāso akramuḥ gʰnantaḥ kr̥ṣṇāmapa tvacam
9.2.d: प्र यद्गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः घ्नन्तः कृष्णामप त्वचम्
9.2.e: As thine, O Indu, is the praise, and thine what springeth from, the juice, Seat thee on the dear sacred grass!

9.2.s: suvitasya manāmahe 'ti setuṃ durāyyam sāhyāma dasyumavratam
9.2.d: सुवितस्य मनामहे ऽति सेतुं दुराय्यम् साह्याम दस्युमव्रतम्
9.2.e: And, finding for us steeds and kine, O Soma, with thy juice flow on Through days that fly most rapidly!

9.2.s: śr̥ṇve vr̥ṣṭeriva svanaḥ pavamānasya śuṣmiṇaḥ caranti vidyuto divi
9.2.d: शृण्वे वृष्टेरिव स्वनः पवमानस्य शुष्मिणः चरन्ति विद्युतो दिवि
9.2.e: As one who conquers, ne'er subdued, attacks and slays the enemy, Thus, vanquisher of thousands! flow! VI Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: ā pavasva mahīmiṣaṃ gomadindo hiraṇyavat aśvavatsoma vīravat
9.2.d: आ पवस्व महीमिषं गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् अश्ववत्सोम वीरवत्
9.2.e: Thou, Indu, with thy streams that drop sweet juices, which were poured for help, Hast settled in the cleansing sieve.

9.2.s: pavasva viśvacarṣaṇa ā mahī rodasī pr̥ṇa uṣāḥ sūryo na raśmibʰiḥ
9.2.d: पवस्व विश्वचर्षण आ मही रोदसी पृण उषाः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः
9.2.e: So flow thou onward through the fleece, for Indra flow to be his drink, Seating thee in the shrine of Law!

9.2.s: pari naḥ śarmayantyā dʰārayā soma viśvataḥ sarā raseva viṣṭapam
9.2.d: परि नः शर्मयन्त्या धारया सोम विश्वतः सरा रसेव विष्टपम्
9.2.e: As giving room and freedom, as most sweet, pour butter forth and milk, O Soma, for the Angirasas! VII Agni

9.2.s: āśurarṣa br̥hanmate pari priyeṇa dʰāmnā yatra devā iti bruvan
9.2.d: आशुरर्ष बृहन्मते परि प्रियेण धाम्ना यत्र देवा इति ब्रुवन्
9.2.e: Thy glories are, like lightnings from the rainy cloud, visible, Agni, like the comings of the Dawns, When, loosed to wander over plants and forest trees, thou crammest by thyself thy food into thy mouth.

9.2.s: pariṣkr̥ṇvannaniṣkr̥taṃ janāya yātayanniṣaḥ vr̥ṣṭiṃ divaḥ pari srava
9.2.d: परिष्कृण्वन्ननिष्कृतं जनाय यातयन्निषः वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव
9.2.e: When, sped and urged by wind, thou spreadest thee abroad, soon piercing through thy food according to thy will, The hosts, who ne'er decayest, eager to consume, like men on chariots, Agni! strive on every side.

9.2.s: ayam̐ sa yo divaspari ragʰuyāmā pavitra ā sindʰorūrmā vyakṣarat
9.2.d: अयꣳ स यो दिवस्परि रघुयामा पवित्र आ सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरत्
9.2.e: Agni, the Hotar-priest who fills the assembly full, waker of wisdom, chief controller of the thought- Thee, yea, none other than thyself, doth man elect priest of the holy offering, great and small, alike. VIII Mitra-Varuna

9.2.s: suta eti pavitra ā tviṣiṃ dadʰāna ojasā vicakṣāṇo virocayan
9.2.d: सुत एति पवित्र आ त्विषिं दधान ओजसा विचक्षाणो विरोचयन्
9.2.e: Even far and wide, O Varuna and Mitra, doth your help extend: May I obtain your kind good-will!

9.2.s: āvivāsanparāvato atʰo arvāvataḥ sutaḥ indrāya sicyate madʰu
9.2.d: आविवासन्परावतो अथो अर्वावतः सुतः इन्द्राय सिच्यते मधु
9.2.e: True Gods, may we completely gain food and a dwelling place from you: Ye Mitras, may we be your own!

9.2.s: samīcīnā anūṣata harim̐ hinvantyadribʰiḥ indumindrāya pītaye
9.2.d: समीचीना अनूषत हरिꣳ हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये
9.2.e: Guard us, ye Mitras, with your guards, save us, ye skilled to save: may we Subdue the Dasyus by ourselves! IX Indra I. Arising in thy might, thy jaws thou shookest Indra, having drunk The Soma which the press had shed.

9.2.s: hinvanti sūramusrayaḥ svasāro jāmayaspatim mahāminduṃ mahīyuvaḥ
9.2.d: हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः स्वसारो जामयस्पतिम् महामिन्दुं महीयुवः
9.2.e: Indra, both world gave place to thee as thou wast fighting, when thou wast The slayer of the Dasyu hosts.

9.2.s: pavamāna rucārucā devo devebʰyaḥ sutaḥ viśvā vasūnyā viśa
9.2.d: पवमान रुचारुचा देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः विश्वा वसून्या विश
9.2.e: From Indra, have I measured out a song eight-footed with nine parts, Delicate, strengthening the Law. X Indra-Agni

9.2.s: ā pavamāna suṣṭutiṃ vr̥ṣṭiṃ devebʰyo duvaḥ iṣe pavasva saṃyatam
9.2.d: आ पवमान सुष्टुतिं वृष्टिं देवेभ्यो दुवः इषे पवस्व संयतम्
9.2.e: Indra and Agni, these our songs of praise have sounded forth to you: Ye who bring blessings! drink the juice

9.2.s: janasya gopā ajaniṣṭa jāgr̥viragniḥ sudakṣaḥ suvitāya navyase gʰr̥tapratīko br̥hatā divispr̥ṣā dyumadvi bʰāti bʰaratebʰyaḥ śuciḥ
9.2.d: जनस्य गोपा अजनिष्ट जागृविरग्निः सुदक्षः सुविताय नव्यसे घृतप्रतीको बृहता दिविस्पृषा द्युमद्वि भाति भरतेभ्यः शुचिः
9.2.e: Come, Indra, Agni, with those teams, desired of many, which ye have, O heroes, for the worshipper

9.2.s: tvāmagne aṅgiraso guhā hitamanvavindañcʰiśriyāṇaṃ vanevane sa jāyase matʰyamānaḥ saho mahatvāmāhuḥ sahasasputramaṅgiraḥ
9.2.d: त्वामग्ने अङ्गिरसो गुहा हितमन्वविन्दञ्छिश्रियाणं वनेवने स जायसे मथ्यमानः सहो महत्वामाहुः सहसस्पुत्रमङ्गिरः
9.2.e: With those to his libation poured, ye heroes, Indra, Agni, come: Come ye to drink the Soma-juice! XI Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: yajñasya ketuṃ pratʰamaṃ purohitamagniṃ narastriṣadʰastʰe samindʰate indreṇa devaiḥ saratʰam̐ sa barhiṣi sīdanni hotā yajatʰāya sukratuḥ
9.2.d: यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरोहितमग्निं नरस्त्रिषधस्थे समिन्धते इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथꣳ स बर्हिषि सीदन्नि होता यजथाय सुक्रतुः
9.2.e: Soma, flow on exceeding bright with loud roar to the reservoirs, Resting in wooden vats thy home!

9.2.s: ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā sutaḥ soma r̥tāvr̥dʰā mamediha śrutam̐ havam
9.2.d: अयं वां मित्रावरुणा सुतः सोम ऋतावृधा ममेदिह श्रुतꣳ हवम्
9.2.e: Let water winning Somas flow to Indra, Vayu, Varuna, To Vishnu and Marut host!

9.2.s: rājānāvanabʰidruhā dʰruve sadasyuttame sahasrastʰūṇa āśāte
9.2.d: राजानावनभिद्रुहा ध्रुवे सदस्युत्तमे सहस्रस्थूण आशाते
9.2.e: Soma, bestowing food upon our progeny, from every side Pour on us riches thousandfold. XII Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: tā samrājā gʰr̥tāsutī ādityā dānunaspatī sacete anavahvaram
9.2.d: ता सम्राजा घृतासुती आदित्या दानुनस्पती सचेते अनवह्वरम्
9.2.e: Pressed out by pressers Soma goes over the fleecy backs of sheep, Goes even as with a mare in tawny-coloured stream, goes in a sweetly-sounding stream.

9.2.s: indro dadʰīco astʰabʰirvr̥trāṇyapratiṣkutaḥ jagʰāna navatīrnava
9.2.d: इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर्वृत्राण्यप्रतिष्कुतः जघान नवतीर्नव
9.2.e: Down to the water Soma, rich in kine, bath flowed with cows, with cows that have been milked. They have approached the mixing-vessels as a sea: the cheerer streams for the carouse. XIII Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: iccʰannaśvasya yaccʰiraḥ parvateṣvapaśritam tadvidaccʰaryaṇāvati
9.2.d: इच्छन्नश्वस्य यच्छिरः पर्वतेष्वपश्रितम् तद्विदच्छर्यणावति
9.2.e: O Purifying Soma, bring to us the wondrous treasure, meet. For lauds, that is in earth and heaven!

9.2.s: atrāha goramanvata nāma tvaṣṭurapīcyam ittʰā candramaso gr̥he
9.2.d: अत्राह गोरमन्वत नाम त्वष्टुरपीच्यम् इत्था चन्द्रमसो गृहे
9.2.e: Cleansing the lives of men, thou, Steer, bellowing on the sacred grass, Gold-hued, hast settled in thy home.

9.2.s: iyaṃ vāmasya manmana indrāgnī pūrvyastutiḥ abʰrādvr̥ṣṭirivājani
9.2.d: इयं वामस्य मन्मन इन्द्राग्नी पूर्व्यस्तुतिः अभ्राद्वृष्टिरिवाजनि
9.2.e: For ye twain, Indra, Soma, are Lords of heaven's light, Lords of the kine: Prosper, as mighty ones, our prayers XIV Indra

9.2.s: śr̥ṇutaṃ jariturhavamindrāgnī vanataṃ giraḥ īśānā pipyataṃ dʰiyaḥ
9.2.d: शृणुतं जरितुर्हवमिन्द्राग्नी वनतं गिरः ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः
9.2.e: By men hath Indra been advanced, the Vritra-sIayer, to joy and strength. Him only we invoke for help in battles whether great or small be he our aid in deeds or might!

9.2.s: mā pāpatvāya no narendrāgnī mābʰiśastaye mā no rīradʰataṃ nide
9.2.d: मा पापत्वाय नो नरेन्द्राग्नी माभिशस्तये मा नो रीरधतं निदे
9.2.e: For, hero, thou art like a host, art giver of abundant spoil. Strengthening e'en the feeble, thou aidest the sacrificer, thou givest great wealth to him who pours.

9.2.s: pavasva dakṣasādʰano devebʰyaḥ pītaye hare marudbʰyo vāyave madaḥ
9.2.d: पवस्व दक्षसाधनो देवेभ्यः पीतये हरे मरुद्भ्यो वायवे मदः
9.2.e: When war and battles are on foot, booty is offered to the bold. Yoke thou thy wildly-rushing bays! Whom wilt thou slay, and whom enrich? Do thou, O Indra, make us rich! XV Indra I. The juice of Soma thus diffused, sweet to the taste, the bright cows drink, Who travelling in splendour close to mighty Indra's side rejoice, good in their own supremacy.

9.2.s: saṃ devaiḥ śobʰate vr̥ṣā kaviryonāvadʰi priyaḥ pavamāno adābʰyaḥ
9.2.d: सं देवैः शोभते वृषा कविर्योनावधि प्रियः पवमानो अदाभ्यः
9.2.e: Craving his touch the dappled kine mingle the Soma with their milk. The milch-kine dear to Indra send forth his death dealing thunder-bolt, good in their own supremacy.

9.2.s: pavamāna dʰiyā hito3 'bʰi yoniṃ kanikradat dʰarmaṇā vāyumāruhaḥ
9.2.d: पवमान धिया हितो३ ऽभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् धर्मणा वायुमारुहः
9.2.e: With veneration, passing wise, they honour his victorious might. They follow close his many laws to win them due preeminence, good in their own supremacy. XVI Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: tavāham̐ soma rāraṇa sakʰya indo divedive purūṇi babʰro ni caranti māmava paridʰīm̐ rati tām̐ihi
9.2.d: तवाहꣳ सोम रारण सख्य इन्दो दिवेदिवे पुरूणि बभ्रो नि चरन्ति मामव परिधीꣳ रति ताꣳइहि
9.2.e: Strong, mountain-born, the stalk hath been pressed in the streams for rapturous joy. Hawk-like he settles in his home.

9.2.s: tavāhaṃ naktamuta soma te divā duhāno babʰra ūdʰani gʰr̥ṇā tapantamati sūryaṃ paraḥ śakunā iva paptima
9.2.d: तवाहं नक्तमुत सोम ते दिवा दुहानो बभ्र ऊधनि घृणा तपन्तमति सूर्यं परः शकुना इव पप्तिम
9.2.e: Fair is the juice beloved of Gods, washed in the waters, pressed by men: The milch kine sweeten it with milk

9.2.s: punāno akramīdabʰi viśvā mr̥dʰo vicarṣaṇiḥ śumbʰanti vipraṃ dʰītibʰiḥ
9.2.d: पुनानो अक्रमीदभि विश्वा मृधो विचर्षणिः शुम्भन्ति विप्रं धीतिभिः
9.2.e: Then, like a steed, have they adorned the inciter for eternal life, The meath's juice at the festival. XVII Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: ā yonimaruṇo ruhadgamadindraṃ vr̥ṣā sutam dʰruve sadasi sīdatu
9.2.d: आ योनिमरुणो रुहद्गमदिन्द्रं वृषा सुतम् ध्रुवे सदसि सीदतु
9.2.e: Make high and splendid glory shine hitherward, Lord of food, God, on the friend of Gods Unclose the cask of middle air

9.2.s: nū no rayiṃ mahāmindo 'smabʰyam̐ soma viśvataḥ ā pavasva sahasriṇam
9.2.d: नू नो रयिं महामिन्दो ऽस्मभ्यꣳ सोम विश्वतः आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम्
9.2.e: Roll onward from the press, O mighty one, effused, as kings, supporter of the tribes Pour on us rain from heaven, send us the water's flow, urging our thoughts to win the spoil! XVIII Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: pibā somamindra madantu tvā yaṃ te suṣāva haryaśvādriḥ soturbāhubʰyām̐ suyato nārvā
9.2.d: पिबा सोममिन्द्र मदन्तु त्वा यं ते सुषाव हर्यश्वाद्रिः सोतुर्बाहुभ्याꣳ सुयतो नार्वा
9.2.e: Breath of the mighty Dames, the Child, speeding the plan of sacrifice, Surpasses all things that are dear, yea, from of old.

9.2.s: yaste mado yujyaścārurasti yena vr̥trāṇi haryaśva ham̐si sa tvāmindra prabʰūvaso mamattu
9.2.d: यस्ते मदो युज्यश्चारुरस्ति येन वृत्राणि हर्यश्व हꣳसि स त्वामिन्द्र प्रभूवसो ममत्तु
9.2.e: The place that is concealed hath gained a share of Trita's pressing-stones, By the seven laws of sacrifice, even that dear place.

9.2.s: bodʰā su me magʰavanvācamemāṃ yāṃ te vasiṣṭʰo arcati praśastim imā brahma sadʰamāde juṣasva
9.2.d: बोधा सु मे मघवन्वाचमेमां यां ते वसिष्ठो अर्चति प्रशस्तिम् इमा ब्रह्म सधमादे जुषस्व
9.2.e: He hath sent forth unto the heights the three, in stream, as Trita's wealth: He who is passing wise measures his pathways out. XIX Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: viśvāḥ pr̥tanā abʰibʰūtaraṃ naraḥ sajūstatakṣurindraṃ jajanuśca rājase kratve vare stʰemanyāmurīmutogramojiṣṭʰaṃ tarasaṃ tarasvinam
9.2.d: विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरः सजूस्ततक्षुरिन्द्रं जजनुश्च राजसे क्रत्वे वरे स्थेमन्यामुरीमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तरसं तरस्विनम्
9.2.e: Flow to the filter with thy stream, effused, to win us spoil and wealth, Soma exceeding rich in meath for Indra, Vishnu, and the Gods

9.2.s: nemiṃ namanti cakṣasā meṣaṃ viprā abʰisvare sudītayo vo adruho 'pi karṇe tarasvinaḥ samr̥kvabʰiḥ
9.2.d: नेमिं नमन्ति चक्षसा मेषं विप्रा अभिस्वरे सुदीतयो वो अद्रुहो ऽपि कर्णे तरस्विनः समृक्वभिः
9.2.e: The hymns that know not guile, caress thee, golden-coloured, in the sieve. As mothers, Pavamana, lick the new-born calf, as Law commands.

9.2.s: samu rebʰaso asvarannindram̐ somasya pītaye svaḥpatiryadī vr̥dʰe dʰr̥tavrato hyojasā samūtibʰiḥ
9.2.d: समु रेभसो अस्वरन्निन्द्रꣳ सोमस्य पीतये स्वःपतिर्यदी वृधे धृतव्रतो ह्योजसा समूतिभिः
9.2.e: Lord of great sway, thou liftest thee above the heavens, above the earth. Thou, of Pavamana, hast assumed thy coat of mail with majesty. XX Soma Pavamana

9.2.s: yo rājā carṣaṇīnāṃ yātā ratʰebʰiradʰriguḥ viśvāsāṃ tarutā pr̥tanānāṃ jyeṣṭʰaṃ yo vr̥trahā gr̥ṇe
9.2.d: यो राजा चर्षणीनां याता रथेभिरध्रिगुः विश्वासां तरुता पृतनानां ज्येष्ठं यो वृत्रहा गृणे
9.2.e: Strong Indu, bathed in milk, flows on for Indra, Soma exciting strength, for his carousal. He quells malignity and slays the demons, King of the homestead, he who gives us comfort.

9.2.s: indraṃ tam̐ śumbʰya puruhanmannavase yasya dvitā vidʰarttari hastena vajraḥ prati dʰāyi darśato mahāṃ devo na sūryaḥ
9.2.d: इन्द्रं तꣳ शुम्भ्य पुरुहन्मन्नवसे यस्य द्विता विधर्त्तरि हस्तेन वज्रः प्रति धायि दर्शतो महां देवो न सूर्यः
9.2.e: Then in a stream he flows, milked out with press-stones, mingled with sweetness, through the fleecy filter-- Indu rejoicing in the love of Indra, the God who gladdens for the God's enjoyment.

9.2.s: pari priyā divaḥ kavirvayām̐si naptyorhitaḥ svānairyāti kavikratuḥ
9.2.d: परि प्रिया दिवः कविर्वयाꣳसि नप्त्योर्हितः स्वानैर्याति कविक्रतुः
9.2.e: He flows, as he is cleansed, to sacred duties, a God bedewing Gods with his own juices. Indu hath, clothed in powers that suit the season, on the raised fleece engaged the ten swift fingers. XXI Agni

9.2.s: sa sūnurmātarā śucirjāto jāte arocayat mahānmahī r̥tāvr̥dʰā
9.2.d: स सूनुर्मातरा शुचिर्जातो जाते अरोचयत् महान्मही ऋतावृधा
9.2.e: O Agni, God, we kindle thee, refulgent, wasting not away, That this more glorious fuel may send forth for thee its shine to heaven. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

9.2.s: prapra kṣayāya panyase janāya juṣṭo adruhaḥ vītyarṣa paniṣṭaye
9.2.d: प्रप्र क्षयाय पन्यसे जनाय जुष्टो अद्रुहः वीत्यर्ष पनिष्टये
9.2.e: To thee the splendid, Lord of light! bright! wondrous! prince of men! is brought. Oblation with the holy verse, O Agni, bearer of our gifts! Bring food to those who sing thy praise!

9.2.s: tvam̐ hyā3m̐ṅga daivyā pavamāna janimāni dyumattamaḥ amr̥tatvāya gʰoṣayan
9.2.d: त्वꣳ ह्या३ꣳङ्ग दैव्या पवमान जनिमानि द्युमत्तमः अमृतत्वाय घोषयन्
9.2.e: Thou heatest both the ladles in thy mouth, O brilliant prince of men! So fill us also in our hymns abundantly, thou Lord of Strength. Bring food to those who sing thy praise! XXII Indra

9.2.s: yenā navagvo dadʰyaṅṅaporṇute yena viprāsa āpire devānām̐ sumne amr̥tasya cāruṇo yena śravām̐syāśata
9.2.d: येना नवग्वो दध्यङ्ङपोर्णुते येन विप्रास आपिरे देवानाꣳ सुम्ने अमृतस्य चारुणो येन श्रवाꣳस्याशत
9.2.e: Sing ye a psalm to Indra; sing a great song to the lofty Sage, To him who maketh prayer, inspired, who loveth laud.

9.2.s: somaḥ punāna ūrmiṇāvyaṃ vāraṃ vi dʰāvati agre vācaḥ pavamānaḥ kanikradat
9.2.d: सोमः पुनान ऊर्मिणाव्यं वारं वि धावति अग्रे वाचः पवमानः कनिक्रदत्
9.2.e: Thou, Indra, art the conqueror: thou gavest splendour to the Sun. Maker of all things, thou art mighty and All-God.

9.2.s: dʰībʰirmr̥janti vājinaṃ vane krīḍantamatyavim abʰi tripr̥ṣṭʰaṃ matayaḥ samasvaran
9.2.d: धीभिर्मृजन्ति वाजिनं वने क्रीडन्तमत्यविम् अभि त्रिपृष्ठं मतयः समस्वरन्
9.2.e: Radiant with light thou wentest to the sky, the luminous realm of -heaven. The Gods, O Indra, strove to win thy friendly love. XXIII Indra

9.2.s: asarji kalaśām̐ abʰi mīḍʰvāntsaptirna vājayuḥ punāno vācaṃ janayannasiṣyadat
9.2.d: असर्जि कलशाꣳ अभि मीढ्वान्त्सप्तिर्न वाजयुः पुनानो वाचं जनयन्नसिष्यदत्
9.2.e: This Soma hath been pressed for thee, O Indra, bold one, mightiest, come! May Indra vigour fill thee full, as Surya fills mid-air with rays

9.2.s: somaḥ pavate janitā matīnāṃ janitā divo janitā pr̥tʰivyāḥ janitāgnerjanitā sūryasya janitendrasya janitota viṣṇoḥ
9.2.d: सोमः पवते जनिता मतीनां जनिता दिवो जनिता पृथिव्याः जनिताग्नेर्जनिता सूर्यस्य जनितेन्द्रस्य जनितोत विष्णोः
9.2.e: Slayer of Vritra, mount thy car! The bay steeds have been yoked by prayer. May, with its voice, the pressing-stone draw thine attention hitherward!

10.1.s: brahmā devānāṃ padavīḥ kavīnāṃ r̥ṣirviprāṇāṃ mahiṣomr̥gāṇām śyeno gr̥dʰrāṇām̐ svadʰitirvanānām̐ somaḥ pavitramatyeti rebʰan
10.1.d: ब्रह्मा देवानां पदवीः कवीनां ऋषिर्विप्राणां महिषोमृगाणाम् श्येनो गृध्राणाꣳ स्वधितिर्वनानाꣳ सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन्
10.1.e: His pair of tawny coursers bring Indra, resistless in his might. Hither to Rishis' songs of praise and sacrifice performed by men. I Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: prāvīvipadvāca ūrmiṃ na sindʰurgira stomānpavamāno manīṣāḥ antaḥ paśyanvr̥janemāvarāṇyā tiṣṭʰati vr̥ṣabʰo goṣu jānan
10.1.d: प्रावीविपद्वाच ऊर्मिं न सिन्धुर्गिर स्तोमान्पवमानो मनीषाः अन्तः पश्यन्वृजनेमावराण्या तिष्ठति वृषभो गोषु जानन्
10.1.e: Light of the sacrifice, be pours delicious meathp most wealthy, father and begetter of the Gods. He, gladdening, best of cheerers, juice that Indra loves, enriches with mysterious treasure earth and heaven.

10.1.s: agniṃ vo vr̥dʰantamadʰvarāṇāṃ purūtamam accʰā naptre sahasvate
10.1.d: अग्निं वो वृधन्तमध्वराणां पुरूतमम् अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते
10.1.e: The Lord of heaven, the vigorous and far-seeing one, flowsshouting to the beaker with his thousand streams. Coloured like gold he rests in seats where Mitra dwells, the Steer made beautiful by rivers and by sheep.

10.1.s: ayaṃ yatʰā na ābʰuvattvaṣṭā rūpeva takṣyā asya kratvā yaśasvataḥ
10.1.d: अयं यथा न आभुवत्त्वष्टा रूपेव तक्ष्या अस्य क्रत्वा यशस्वतः
10.1.e: As Pavamana thou flowest before the streams: thou goest on, before the hymn, before the kine. Thou sharest mighty booty in the van of war Soma, well-armed, thou art pressed out by men who press. II Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: ayaṃ viśvā abʰi śriyo 'gnirdeveṣu patyate ā vājairupa no gamat
10.1.d: अयं विश्वा अभि श्रियो ऽग्निर्देवेषु पत्यते आ वाजैरुप नो गमत्
10.1.e: Through our desire of heroes, kine, and horses, vigorous Somadrops, Brilliant and swift, have been effused.

10.1.s: imamindra sutaṃ piba jyeṣṭʰamamartyaṃ madam śukrasya tvābʰyakṣarandʰārā r̥tasya sādane
10.1.d: इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ज्येष्ठममर्त्यं मदम् शुक्रस्य त्वाभ्यक्षरन्धारा ऋतस्य सादने
10.1.e: They, beautified by holy men and purified in both the hands, Are flowing through the fleecy cloth.

10.1.s: na kiṣṭvadratʰītaro harī yadindra yaccʰase na kiṣṭvānu majmanā na kiḥ svaśva ānaśe
10.1.d: न किष्ट्वद्रथीतरो हरी यदिन्द्र यच्छसे न किष्ट्वानु मज्मना न किः स्वश्व आनशे
10.1.e: These Soma juices shall pour forth all treasures for the worshipper, From heaven and earth and firmament. III Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: indrāya nūnamarcatoktʰāni ca bravītana sutā amatsurindavo jyeṣṭʰaṃ namasyatā sahaḥ
10.1.d: इन्द्राय नूनमर्चतोक्थानि च ब्रवीतन सुता अमत्सुरिन्दवो ज्येष्ठं नमस्यता सहः
10.1.e: Flow, Soma, Indu, dear to Gods, swift through the purifying sieve, And enter fndra in thy strength

10.1.s: indra juṣasva pra vahā yāhi śūra hariha pibā sutasya matirna madʰoścakānaścārurmadāya
10.1.d: इन्द्र जुषस्व प्र वहा याहि शूर हरिह पिबा सुतस्य मतिर्न मधोश्चकानश्चारुर्मदाय
10.1.e: As mighty food speed hitherward, Indu, as a most splendid steer: Sit in thy place as one with power

10.1.s: indra jaṭʰaraṃ navyaṃ na pr̥ṇasva madʰordivo na asya sutasya svā3rnopa tvā madāḥ suvāco astʰuḥ
10.1.d: इन्द्र जठरं नव्यं न पृणस्व मधोर्दिवो न अस्य सुतस्य स्वा३र्नोप त्वा मदाः सुवाचो अस्थुः
10.1.e: The well-loved meath was made to flow, the stream of the creative juice: The Sage drew waters to himself.

10.1.s: indrasturāṣāṇmitro na jagʰāna vr̥traṃ yatirna bibʰeda valaṃ bʰr̥gurna sasāhe śatrūnmade somasya
10.1.d: इन्द्रस्तुराषाण्मित्रो न जघान वृत्रं यतिर्न बिभेद वलं भृगुर्न ससाहे शत्रून्मदे सोमस्य
10.1.e: The mighty waters, yea, the floods accompany thee mighty one, When thou wilt clothe thee with the milk.

10.1.s: govitpavasva vasuviddʰiraṇyavidretodʰā indo bʰuvaneṣvarpitaḥ tvam̐ suvīro asi soma viśvavittaṃ tvā nara upa girema āsate
10.1.d: गोवित्पवस्व वसुविद्धिरण्यविद्रेतोधा इन्दो भुवनेष्वर्पितः त्वꣳ सुवीरो असि सोम विश्ववित्तं त्वा नर उप गिरेम आसते
10.1.e: The lake is brightened in the floods. Soma, our friend, heaven's prop and stay, Falls on the purifying cloth.

10.1.s: tvaṃ nr̥cakṣā asi soma viśvataḥ pavamāna vr̥ṣabʰa tā vi dʰāvasi sa naḥ pavasva vasumaddʰiraṇyavadvayam̐ syāma bʰuvaneṣu jīvase
10.1.d: त्वं नृचक्षा असि सोम विश्वतः पवमान वृषभ ता वि धावसि स नः पवस्व वसुमद्धिरण्यवद्वयꣳ स्याम भुवनेषु जीवसे
10.1.e: The tawny Bull hath bellowed. fair as mighty Mitra to behold He gleams and flashes with the Sun.

10.1.s: īśāna imā bʰuvanāni īyase yujāna indo haritaḥ suparṇyaḥ tāste kṣarantu madʰumadgʰr̥taṃ payastava vrate soma tiṣṭʰantu kr̥ṣṭayaḥ
10.1.d: ईशान इमा भुवनानि ईयसे युजान इन्दो हरितः सुपर्ण्यः तास्ते क्षरन्तु मधुमद्घृतं पयस्तव व्रते सोम तिष्ठन्तु कृष्टयः
10.1.e: Songs, Indra, active in their might, are beautified for thee, wherewith Thou deckest thee for rapturous joy.

10.1.s: pavamānasya viśvavitpra te sargā asr̥kṣata sūryasyeva na raśmayaḥ
10.1.d: पवमानस्य विश्ववित्प्र ते सर्गा असृक्षत सूर्यस्येव न रश्मयः
10.1.e: To thee who givest ample room we pray, to win the wild delight, That Thou mayst have exalted praise,

10.1.s: ketuṃ kr̥ṇvaṃ divaspari viśvā rūpābʰyarṣasi samudraḥ soma pinvase
10.1.d: केतुं कृण्वं दिवस्परि विश्वा रूपाभ्यर्षसि समुद्रः सोम पिन्वसे
10.1.e: Winner of kine Indu, art thou, winner of heroes, steeds, and spoil: Primeval soul of sacrifice.

10.1.s: jajñāno vācamiṣyasi pavamāna vidʰarmaṇi krandaṃ devo na sūryaḥ
10.1.d: जज्ञानो वाचमिष्यसि पवमान विधर्मणि क्रन्दं देवो न सूर्यः
10.1.e: Pour on us, Indu! Indra-strength with a full stream of sweetness, like Parianya, sender of the rain! IV Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: pra somāso adʰanviṣuḥ pavamānāsa indavaḥ śrīṇānā apsu vr̥ñjate
10.1.d: प्र सोमासो अधन्विषुः पवमानास इन्दवः श्रीणाना अप्सु वृञ्जते
10.1.e: O Soma Pavamana, be victorious, win us high renown; And make us better than we are!

10.1.s: abʰi gāvo adʰanviṣurāpo na pravatā yatīḥ punānā indramāśata
10.1.d: अभि गावो अधन्विषुरापो न प्रवता यतीः पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत
10.1.e: Win thou the light, win heavenly light, and, Soma, all felicities; And make us better than we are!

10.1.s: pra pavamāna dʰanvasi somendrāya mādanaḥ nr̥bʰiryato vi nīyase
10.1.d: प्र पवमान धन्वसि सोमेन्द्राय मादनः नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे
10.1.e: Win skilful strength and mental power! O Soma, drive away our foes; And make us better than we are!

10.1.s: indo yadadribʰiḥ sutaḥ pavitraṃ paridīyase aramindrasya dʰāmne
10.1.d: इन्दो यदद्रिभिः सुतः पवित्रं परिदीयसे अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने
10.1.e: Ye purifiers, purify Soma for Indra, for his drink; Make thou us better than we are!

10.1.s: tvam̐ soma nr̥mādanaḥ pavasva carṣaṇīdʰr̥tiḥ sasniryo anumādyaḥ
10.1.d: त्वꣳ सोम नृमादनः पवस्व चर्षणीधृतिः सस्निर्यो अनुमाद्यः
10.1.e: Give us our portion in the Sun through thine own mental power and aids; And make us better than we are!

10.1.s: pavasva vr̥trahantama uktʰebʰiranumādyaḥ śuciḥ pāvako adbʰutaḥ
10.1.d: पवस्व वृत्रहन्तम उक्थेभिरनुमाद्यः शुचिः पावको अद्भुतः
10.1.e: Through thine own mental power and aids long may we look upon the Sun: Make thou us better than we are!

10.1.s: śuciḥ pāvaka ucyate somaḥ sutaḥ sa madʰumān devāvīragʰaśam̐sahā
10.1.d: शुचिः पावक उच्यते सोमः सुतः स मधुमान् देवावीरघशꣳसहा
10.1.e: Well-weaponed Soma, pour to us a stream of riches doubly great; And make us better than we are!

10.1.s: pra kavirdevavītaye 'vyā vārebʰiravyata sāhvānviśvā abʰi spr̥dʰaḥ
10.1.d: प्र कविर्देववीतये ऽव्या वारेभिरव्यत साह्वान्विश्वा अभि स्पृधः
10.1.e: As one victorious unsubdued in battle, pour forth wealth to us: And make us better than we are!

10.1.s: sa hi ṣmā jaritr̥bʰya ā vājaṃ gomantaminvati pavamānaḥ sahasriṇam
10.1.d: स हि ष्मा जरितृभ्य आ वाजं गोमन्तमिन्वति पवमानः सहस्रिणम्
10.1.e: With offerings, Pavamana! men have strengthened thee as Law commands: Make thou us better than we are!

10.1.s: pari viśvāni cetasā mr̥jyase pavase matī sa naḥ soma śravo vidaḥ
10.1.d: परि विश्वानि चेतसा मृज्यसे पवसे मती स नः सोम श्रवो विदः
10.1.e: O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds brilliant and quickening all life; And make us better than we are! V Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: abʰyarṣa br̥hadyaśo magʰavadbʰyo dʰruvam̐ rayim iṣam̐ stotr̥bʰya ā bʰara
10.1.d: अभ्यर्ष बृहद्यशो मघवद्भ्यो ध्रुवꣳ रयिम् इषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
10.1.e: Swift runs this giver of delight, even the stream of flowing juice: Swift runs this giver of delight.

10.1.s: tvam̐ rājeva suvrato giraḥ somāviveśitʰa punāno vahne adbʰuta
10.1.d: त्वꣳ राजेव सुव्रतो गिरः सोमाविवेशिथ पुनानो वह्ने अद्भुत
10.1.e: The Morning knows all precious things, the Goddess knows her grace to man: Swift runs this giver of delight.

10.1.s: sa vahnirapsu duṣṭaro mr̥jyamāno gabʰastyoḥ somaścamūṣu sīdati
10.1.d: स वह्निरप्सु दुष्टरो मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः सोमश्चमूषु सीदति
10.1.e: We have accepted thousands from Dhvasra's and Purusbanti's hands: Swift runs this giver of delight.

10.1.s: krīḍurmakʰo na mam̐hayuḥ pavitram̐ soma gaccʰasi dadʰatstotre suvīryam
10.1.d: क्रीडुर्मखो न मꣳहयुः पवित्रꣳ सोम गच्छसि दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम्
10.1.e: From whom we have accepted thus thousands and three-times ten besides: Swift runs this giver of delight. VI Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: yavaṃyavaṃ no andʰasā puṣṭaṃpuṣṭaṃ pari srava viśvā ca soma saubʰagā
10.1.d: यवंयवं नो अन्धसा पुष्टंपुष्टं परि स्रव विश्वा च सोम सौभगा
10.1.e: Forth with his stream who gladdens best these Soma juices have been poured, Lauded with songs for mighty strength.

10.1.s: indo yatʰā tava stavo yatʰā te jātamandʰasaḥ ni barhiṣi priye sadaḥ
10.1.d: इन्दो यथा तव स्तवो यथा ते जातमन्धसः नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सदः
10.1.e: Thou flowest to enjoy the milk, and bringest valour, being, cleansed: Winning the spoil flow hitherward

10.1.s: uta no govidaśvavitpavasva somāndʰasā makṣūtamebʰirahabʰiḥ
10.1.d: उत नो गोविदश्ववित्पवस्व सोमान्धसा मक्षूतमेभिरहभिः
10.1.e: And, hymned by Jamadagni, let all nourishment that kine supply, And general praises, flow to us! VII Agni

10.1.s: yo jināti na jīyate hanti śatrumabʰītya sa pavasva sahasrajit
10.1.d: यो जिनाति न जीयते हन्ति शत्रुमभीत्य स पवस्व सहस्रजित्
10.1.e: For Jatavedas, worthy of our praise, will we frame with our mind this eulogy as 'twere a car. For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm!

10.1.s: yāste dʰārā madʰuścuto 'sr̥graminda ūtaye tābʰiḥ pavitramāsadaḥ
10.1.d: यास्ते धारा मधुश्चुतो ऽसृग्रमिन्द ऊतये ताभिः पवित्रमासदः
10.1.e: We will bring fuel and prepare our sacred gifts, reminding thee at each successive holy time. Fulfil our thoughts that we may lengthen out our lives Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm!

10.1.s: so arṣendrāya pītaye tiro vārāṇyavyayā sīdannr̥tasya yonimā
10.1.d: सो अर्षेन्द्राय पीतये तिरो वाराण्यव्यया सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा
10.1.e: May we have power to kindle thee! Fulfil our prayers in thee the Gods eat the presented sacrifice. Bring hither the Adityas, for we long for them! Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm! VIII Mitra, Varuna, Aryaman

10.1.s: tvam̐ soma pari srava svādiṣṭʰo aṅgirobʰyaḥ varivoviddʰr̥taṃ payaḥ
10.1.d: त्वꣳ सोम परि स्रव स्वादिष्ठो अङ्गिरोभ्यः वरिवोविद्धृतं पयः
10.1.e: Soon as the Sun hath risen I sing to you, to Mitra, Varuna, And Aryaman who slays the foe.

10.1.s: tava śriyo varṣyasyeva vidyutogneścikitra uṣasāmivetayaḥ yadoṣadʰīrabʰisr̥ṣṭo vanāni ca pari svayaṃ cinuṣe annamāsani
10.1.d: तव श्रियो वर्ष्यस्येव विद्युतोग्नेश्चिकित्र उषसामिवेतयः यदोषधीरभिसृष्टो वनानि च परि स्वयं चिनुषे अन्नमासनि
10.1.e: With wealth of gold may this my song bring unmolested might; may this, Sages! obtain the sacrifice!

10.1.s: vātopajūta iṣito vaśām̐ anu tr̥ṣu yadannā veviṣadvitiṣṭʰase ā te yatante ratʰyo3 yatʰā pr̥tʰakśardʰām̐syagne ajarasya dʰakṣataḥ
10.1.d: वातोपजूत इषितो वशाꣳ अनु तृषु यदन्ना वेविषद्वितिष्ठसे आ ते यतन्ते रथ्यो३ यथा पृथक्शर्धाꣳस्यग्ने अजरस्य धक्षतः
10.1.e: May we be thine, God Varuna, and with our princes, Mitra, thine: May we gain food and heavenly light! IX Indra

10.1.s: medʰākāraṃ vidatʰasya prasādʰanamagnim̐ hotāraṃ paribʰūtaraṃ matim tvāmarbʰasya haviṣaḥ samānamittavāṃ maho vr̥ṇate nānyaṃ tvat
10.1.d: मेधाकारं विदथस्य प्रसाधनमग्निꣳ होतारं परिभूतरं मतिम् त्वामर्भस्य हविषः समानमित्तवां महो वृणते नान्यं त्वत्
10.1.e: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long:

10.1.s: purūruṇā ciddʰyastyavo nūnaṃ vāṃ varuṇa mitra vam̐si vām̐ sumatim
10.1.d: पुरूरुणा चिद्ध्यस्त्यवो नूनं वां वरुण मित्र वꣳसि वाꣳ सुमतिम्
10.1.e: Of which the world shall know forthwith as given by thee abundantly: Bring us the wealth for which we long:

10.1.s: tā vām̐ samyagadruhvāṇeṣamaśyāma dʰāma ca vayaṃ vāṃ mitrā syāma
10.1.d: ता वाꣳ सम्यगद्रुह्वाणेषमश्याम धाम च वयं वां मित्रा स्याम
10.1.e: O Indra, that which is concealed in strong firm place precipito us: Bring us the wealth for which we long! X Indra-Agni

10.1.s: pātaṃ no mitrā pāyubʰiruta trāyetʰām̐ sutrātrā sāhyāma dasyūṃ tanūbʰiḥ
10.1.d: पातं नो मित्रा पायुभिरुत त्रायेथाꣳ सुत्रात्रा साह्याम दस्यूं तनूभिः
10.1.e: Yea, ye are priests of sacrifice, winners in war and holy works Indra and Agni, mark this well!

10.1.s: uttiṣṭʰannojasā saha pītvā śipre avepayaḥ somamindra camūsutam
10.1.d: उत्तिष्ठन्नोजसा सह पीत्वा शिप्रे अवेपयः सोममिन्द्र चमूसुतम्
10.1.e: Bountiful, riders on the car, slayers of Vritra unsubdued, Indra and Agni, mark this well!

10.1.s: anu tvā rodasī ubʰe spardʰamānamadadetām indra yaddasyuhābʰavaḥ
10.1.d: अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे स्पर्धमानमददेताम् इन्द्र यद्दस्युहाभवः
10.1.e: The men with pressing-stones have pressed this meath of yours which gives delight: Indra and Agni, mark this well! XI Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: vācamaṣṭāpadīmahaṃ navasraktimr̥tāvr̥dʰam indrātparitanvaṃ mame
10.1.d: वाचमष्टापदीमहं नवस्रक्तिमृतावृधम् इन्द्रात्परितन्वं ममे
10.1.e: For Indra girt by Maruts, flow, thou Indu, very rich in meath, To seat thee in the place of song!

10.1.s: indrāgnī yuvāmime3 'bʰi stomā anūṣata pibatam̐ śambʰuvā sutam
10.1.d: इन्द्राग्नी युवामिमे३ ऽभि स्तोमा अनूषत पिबतꣳ शम्भुवा सुतम्
10.1.e: Sage: who know the lore of speech deck thee, the strong sustainer, well: Men make thee bright and beautiful.

10.1.s: yā vām̐ santi puruspr̥ho niyuto dāśuṣe narā indrāgnī tābʰirā gatam
10.1.d: या वाꣳ सन्ति पुरुस्पृहो नियुतो दाशुषे नरा इन्द्राग्नी ताभिरा गतम्
10.1.e: Let Mitra, Varuna, Aryaman drink Pavamana's juice, yea, thine. Sage! let the Maruts drink thereof. XII Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: tābʰirā gaccʰataṃ naropedam̐ savanam̐ sutam indrāgnī somapītaye
10.1.d: ताभिरा गच्छतं नरोपेदꣳ सवनꣳ सुतम् इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये
10.1.e: Deft-handed! thou when purified liftest thy voice amid the sea. Thou, Pavamana makest riches flow to us, yellow, abundant, much-desired.

10.1.s: arṣā soma dyumattamo 'bʰi droṇāni roruvat sīdanyonau yoneṣvā
10.1.d: अर्षा सोम द्युमत्तमो ऽभि द्रोणानि रोरुवत् सीदन्योनौ योनेष्वा
10.1.e: Made pure, as Pavamana, in the sheep's long wool, the Steer bath bellowed in the vat. Thou flowest, Soma Pavamana! balmed with 'milk unto the meeting-place of Gods. XIII Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: apsā indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbʰyaḥ somā arṣantu viṣṇave
10.1.d: अप्सा इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः सोमा अर्षन्तु विष्णवे
10.1.e: Him here, the offspring of the sea, the ten swift fingers beautify: With the Adityas is he seen.

10.1.s: iṣaṃ tokāya no dadʰadasmabʰyam̐ soma viśvataḥ ā pavasva sahasriṇam
10.1.d: इषं तोकाय नो दधदस्मभ्यꣳ सोम विश्वतः आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम्
10.1.e: With Indra and with Vayu he, effused, flows onward with the beams Of Surya to the cleansing sieve.

10.1.s: soma u ṣvāṇaḥ sotr̥bʰiradʰi ṣṇubʰiravīnām aśvayeva haritā yāti dʰārayā mandrayā yāti dʰārayā
10.1.d: सोम उ ष्वाणः सोतृभिरधि ष्णुभिरवीनाम् अश्वयेव हरिता याति धारया मन्द्रया याति धारया
10.1.e: Flow rich in sweets and lovely for our Bhaga, Vayu, Pushan, fair For Mitra and for Varuna! XIV Indra

10.1.s: anūpe gomāngobʰirakṣāḥ somo dugdʰābʰirakṣāḥ samudraṃ na saṃvaraṇānyagmanmandī madāya tośate
10.1.d: अनूपे गोमान्गोभिरक्षाः सोमो दुग्धाभिरक्षाः समुद्रं न संवरणान्यग्मन्मन्दी मदाय तोशते
10.1.e: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things, wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice!

10.1.s: yatsoma citramuktʰyaṃ divyaṃ pārtʰivaṃ vasu tannaḥ punāna ā bʰara
10.1.d: यत्सोम चित्रमुक्थ्यं दिव्यं पार्थिवं वसु तन्नः पुनान आ भर
10.1.e: Like thee, thyself, for singers yoked, thou movest, as it were besought, Bold one, the axle of the car,

10.1.s: vr̥ṣā punāna āyum̐ṣi stanayannadʰi barhiṣi hariḥ sanyonimāsadaḥ
10.1.d: वृषा पुनान आयुꣳषि स्तनयन्नधि बर्हिषि हरिः सन्योनिमासदः
10.1.e: That, Satakratu, thou, to serve and please thy praisers, as it were, Stirrest the axle with thy strength. XV Indra

10.1.s: yuvam̐ hi stʰaḥ svaḥpatī indraśca soma gopatī īśānā pipyataṃ dʰiyaḥ
10.1.d: युवꣳ हि स्थः स्वःपती इन्द्रश्च सोम गोपती ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः
10.1.e: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of good deeds, To our assistance day by day.

10.1.s: indro madāya vāvr̥dʰe śavase vr̥trahā nr̥bʰiḥ taminmahatsvājiṣūtimarbʰe havāmahe sa vājeṣu pra no 'viṣat
10.1.d: इन्द्रो मदाय वावृधे शवसे वृत्रहा नृभिः तमिन्महत्स्वाजिषूतिमर्भे हवामहे स वाजेषु प्र नो ऽविषत्
10.1.e: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma, Soma-drinker! yea, The rich one's rapture giveth kine.

10.1.s: asi hi vīra senyo 'si bʰūri parādadiḥ asi dabʰrasya cidvr̥dʰo yajamānāya śikṣasi sunvate bʰūri te vasu
10.1.d: असि हि वीर सेन्यो ऽसि भूरि पराददिः असि दभ्रस्य चिद्वृधो यजमानाय शिक्षसि सुन्वते भूरि ते वसु
10.1.e: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not; come hitherward! XVI Indra

10.1.s: yadudīrata ājayo dʰr̥ṣṇave dʰīyate dʰanām yuṅkṣvā madacyutā harī kaṃ hanaḥ kaṃ vasau dadʰo 'smāṃ indra vasau dadʰaḥ
10.1.d: यदुदीरत आजयो धृष्णवे धीयते धनाम् युङ्क्ष्वा मदच्युता हरी कं हनः कं वसौ दधो ऽस्मां इन्द्र वसौ दधः
10.1.e: As, like the Morning, thou has filled, O Indra, both the earth and heaven, So as the mighty one, great King of all the mighty race of men, the Goddess mother brought thee forth, the blessed mother gave thee life.

10.1.s: svādorittʰā viṣūvato madʰvaḥ pibanti gauryaḥ yā indreṇa sayāvarīrvr̥ṣṇā madanti śobʰase vasvīranu svarājyam
10.1.d: स्वादोरित्था विषूवतो मध्वः पिबन्ति गौर्यः या इन्द्रेण सयावरीर्वृष्णा मदन्ति शोभसे वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम्
10.1.e: Thou bearest in thine hand a lance like a long hook, great counsellor. As with his foremost foot a goat, draw down the branch O Maghavan. The Goddess mother brought thee forth, the blessed mother gave thee life.

10.1.s: tā asya pr̥śanāyuvaḥ somam̐ śrīṇanti pr̥śnayaḥ priyā indrasya dʰenavo vajram̐ hinvanti sāyakaṃ vasvīranu svarājyam
10.1.d: ता अस्य पृशनायुवः सोमꣳ श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः प्रिया इन्द्रस्य धेनवो वज्रꣳ हिन्वन्ति सायकं वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम्
10.1.e: Relax that mortal's stubborn strength whose heart is bent on wickedness. Trample him down beneath thy feet who watches for and aims at us. The Goddess mother brought thee forth, the blessed mother gave thee life. XVII Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: tā asya namasā sahaḥ saparyanti pracetasaḥ vratānyasya saścire purūṇi pūrvacittaye vasvīranu svarājyam
10.1.d: ता अस्य नमसा सहः सपर्यन्ति प्रचेतसः व्रतान्यस्य सश्चिरे पुरूणि पूर्वचित्तये वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम्
10.1.e: Soma, the dweller on the hills, effused, hath flowed into the sieve. All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

10.1.s: asāvyam̐śurmadāyāpsu dakṣo giriṣṭʰāḥ śyeno na yonimāsadat
10.1.d: असाव्यꣳशुर्मदायाप्सु दक्षो गिरिष्ठाः श्येनो न योनिमासदत्
10.1.e: Thou art a holy bard, a Sage; the meath offspring of thy sap: All bounteous art thou in carouse.

10.1.s: śubʰramandʰo devavātamapsu dʰautaṃ nr̥bʰiḥ sutam svadanti gāvaḥ payobʰiḥ
10.1.d: शुभ्रमन्धो देववातमप्सु धौतं नृभिः सुतम् स्वदन्ति गावः पयोभिः
10.1.e: All-d6ties of one accorcl have come that they may drink of thee: All-bounteous art thou in carouse. XVIII Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: ādīmaśvaṃ na hetāramaśūśubʰannamr̥tāya madʰo rasam̐ sadʰamāde
10.1.d: आदीमश्वं न हेतारमशूशुभन्नमृताय मधो रसꣳ सधमादे
10.1.e: Effused is he who brings good things, who brings us store of wealth, and sweet refreshing food, Soma who brings us quiet homes:

10.1.s: abʰi dyubʰnaṃ br̥hadyaśa iṣaspate dīdihi deva devayum vi kośaṃ madʰyamaṃ yuva
10.1.d: अभि द्युभ्नं बृहद्यश इषस्पते दीदिहि देव देवयुम् वि कोशं मध्यमं युव
10.1.e: He whom our Indra and the Marut host shall drink, Bhaga shall drink with Aryaman, By whom we bring to us Mitra and Varuna, and Indra for our great defence. XIX Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: ā vacyasva sudakṣa camvoḥ suto viśāṃ vahnirna viśpatiḥ vr̥ṣṭiṃ divaḥ pavasva rītimapo jinvangaviṣṭaye dʰiyaḥ
10.1.d: आ वच्यस्व सुदक्ष चम्वोः सुतो विशां वह्निर्न विश्पतिः वृष्टिं दिवः पवस्व रीतिमपो जिन्वन्गविष्टये धियः
10.1.e: Friends, hymn your Lord who makes him pure for rapturous carouse: let them Sweeten him, as a child, with lauds and sacred gifts

10.1.s: prāṇā śiśurmahīnām̐ hinvannr̥tasya dīdʰitim viśvā pari priyā bʰuvadadʰa dvitā
10.1.d: प्राणा शिशुर्महीनाꣳ हिन्वन्नृतस्य दीधितिम् विश्वा परि प्रिया भुवदध द्विता
10.1.e: Like as a calf with mother cows, so Indu is urged forth and sent, Glorified by our hymns;, the god-delighting juice.

10.1.s: upa tritasya pāṣyo3rabʰakta yadguhā padam yajñasya sapta dʰāmabʰiradʰa priyam
10.1.d: उप त्रितस्य पाष्यो३रभक्त यद्गुहा पदम् यज्ञस्य सप्त धामभिरध प्रियम्
10.1.e: Effectual help to power is he. he is a banquet for the troop, He who hath been effused, more rich in meath, for Gods. XX Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: trīṇi tritasya dʰārayā pr̥ṣṭeṣvairayadrayim mimīte asya yojanā vi sukratuḥ
10.1.d: त्रीणि त्रितस्य धारया पृष्टेष्वैरयद्रयिम् मिमीते अस्य योजना वि सुक्रतुः
10.1.e: For us the Soma juices flow, the drops best furtherers of weal, Effused as friends, without a spot, benevolent, finders of the light.

10.1.s: pavasva vājasātaye pavitre dʰārayā sutaḥ indrāya soma viṣṇave devebʰyo madʰumattaraḥ
10.1.d: पवस्व वाजसातये पवित्रे धारया सुतः इन्द्राय सोम विष्णवे देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तरः
10.1.e: These Soma juices, skill.ed in song, purified, blent with milk and curd, Hastening on and firmly set in oil resemble beauteous suns.

10.1.s: tvām̐ rihanti dʰītayo hariṃ pavitre adruhaḥ vatsaṃ jātaṃ na mātaraḥ pavamāna vidʰarmaṇi
10.1.d: त्वाꣳ रिहन्ति धीतयो हरिं पवित्रे अद्रुहः वत्सं जातं न मातरः पवमान विधर्मणि
10.1.e: Effused by means of pressing- stones, upon the oxhide visible, They, treasure-finders, have announced food unto us from every side. XXI Soma Pavamana

10.1.s: tvaṃ dyāṃ ca mahivrata pr̥tʰivīṃ cāti jabʰriṣe prati drāpimamuñcatʰāḥ pavamāna mahitvanā
10.1.d: त्वं द्यां च महिव्रत पृथिवीं चाति जभ्रिषे प्रति द्रापिममुञ्चथाः पवमान महित्वना
10.1.e: Pour forth this wealth with this purification: flow onward to the yellow lake, O Indu! Here, too, the bright one, wind-swift, full of wisdom, shall give a son to him who cometh quickly.

10.1.s: indurvājī pavate gonyogʰā indre somaḥ saha invanmadāya hanti rakṣo bādʰate paryarātiṃ varivaskr̥ṇvanvr̥janasya rājā
10.1.d: इन्दुर्वाजी पवते गोन्योघा इन्द्रे सोमः सह इन्वन्मदाय हन्ति रक्षो बाधते पर्यरातिं वरिवस्कृण्वन्वृजनस्य राजा
10.1.e: Flow on for us with this purification to the famed ford of thee whose due is glory! May the foe-queller shake us down, for triumph, like a tree's ripe fruit, sixty thousand treasures!

10.1.s: adʰa dʰārayā madʰvā pr̥cānastiro roma pavate adridugdʰaḥ indurindrasya sakʰyaṃ juṣāṇo devo devasya matsaro madāya
10.1.d: अध धारया मध्वा पृचानस्तिरो रोम पवते अद्रिदुग्धः इन्दुरिन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणो देवो देवस्य मत्सरो मदाय
10.1.e: Eagerly do we pray for those two exploits, at the blue lake and Prisana, wrought in battle. He sent our enemies to sleep and slew them, and turned away the foolish and unfriendly. XXII Agni

10.1.s: abʰi vratāni pavate punāno devo devāntsvena rasena pr̥ñcan indurdʰarmāṇyr̥tutʰā vasāno daśa kṣipo avyata sāno avye
10.1.d: अभि व्रतानि पवते पुनानो देवो देवान्त्स्वेन रसेन पृञ्चन् इन्दुर्धर्माण्यृतुथा वसानो दश क्षिपो अव्यत सानो अव्ये
10.1.e: O Agni, be our nearest friend, yea, our protector and our kind deliverer!

10.1.s: ā te agna idʰīmahi dyumantaṃ devājaram yuddʰa syā te panīyasī samiddīdayati dyavīṣam̐ stotr̥bʰya ā bʰara
10.1.d: आ ते अग्न इधीमहि द्युमन्तं देवाजरम् युद्ध स्या ते पनीयसी समिद्दीदयति द्यवीषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
10.1.e: As gracious Agni, famed for treasures, come, and, most resplendent, give us store of wealth!

10.1.s: ā te agna r̥cā haviḥ śukrasya jyotiṣaspate suścandra dasma viśpate havyavāṭtubʰyam̐ hūyata iṣam̐ stotr̥bʰya ā bʰara
10.1.d: आ ते अग्न ऋचा हविः शुक्रस्य ज्योतिषस्पते सुश्चन्द्र दस्म विश्पते हव्यवाट्तुभ्यꣳ हूयत इषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
10.1.e: To thee then, O most bright, O radiant God, we come with prayer for happiness for our friends. XXIII Indra

10.1.s: obʰe suścandra viśpate darvī śrīṇīṣa āsani uto na utpupūryā uktʰeṣu śavasaspata iṣam̐ stotr̥bʰya ā bʰara
10.1.d: ओभे सुश्चन्द्र विश्पते दर्वी श्रीणीष आसनि उतो न उत्पुपूर्या उक्थेषु शवसस्पत इषꣳ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
10.1.e: May we, with Indra and the Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds to full completion!

10.1.s: indrāya sāma gāyata viprāya br̥hate br̥hat brahmākr̥te vipaścite panasyave
10.1.d: इन्द्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत् ब्रह्माकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे
10.1.e: Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspring, let Indra with the Adityas-form and finish!

10.1.s: tvamindrābʰibʰūrasi tvam̐ sūryamarocayaḥ viśvakarmā viśvadevo mahām̐ asi
10.1.d: त्वमिन्द्राभिभूरसि त्वꣳ सूर्यमरोचयः विश्वकर्मा विश्वदेवो महाꣳ असि
10.1.e: With the Adityas, with the band of Maruts, let Indra send us medicines to heal us! XXIV Indra

10.2.s: vibʰrājaṃ jyotiṣā tva3ragaccʰo rocanaṃ divaḥ devāsta indra sakʰyāya yemire
10.2.d: विभ्राजं ज्योतिषा त्व३रगच्छो रोचनं दिवः देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे
10.2.e: Sing to your Indra, mightiest Vritra-slayer, sing to the Sage the song that he accepteth! I Soma Pavamana

10.2.s: asāvi soma indra te śaviṣṭʰa dʰr̥ṣṇavā gahi ā tvā pr̥ṇaktvindriyam̐ rajaḥ sūryo na raśmibʰiḥ
10.2.d: असावि सोम इन्द्र ते शविष्ठ धृष्णवा गहि आ त्वा पृणक्त्विन्द्रियꣳ रजः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः
10.2.e: The God declares the deities' generations, like Usana, proclaiming lofty wisdom. With brilliant kin far-ruling, sanctifying, the wild boar, singing with his foot, advances.

10.2.s: ā tiṣṭʰa vr̥trahanratʰaṃ yuktā te brahmaṇā harī arvācīnam̐ su te mano grāvā kr̥ṇotu vagnunā
10.2.d: आ तिष्ठ वृत्रहन्रथं युक्ता ते ब्रह्मणा हरी अर्वाचीनꣳ सु ते मनो ग्रावा कृणोतु वग्नुना
10.2.e: The swans, the Vrishagnas from anear us, restless, have brought their clamour to our dwelling-- Friends come to Pavamana, meet for praises-and sound in concert their resistless music.

10.2.s: indramiddʰarī vahato 'pratidʰr̥ṣṭaśavasam r̥ṣīṇām̐ suṣṭutīrupa yajñaṃ ca mānuṣāṇām
10.2.d: इन्द्रमिद्धरी वहतो ऽप्रतिधृष्टशवसम् ऋषीणाꣳ सुष्टुतीरुप यज्ञं च मानुषाणाम्
10.2.e: He takes the swiftness of the great Far strider: cows low as, 'twere to him who sports at pleasure. He with the sharpened horns brings forth abundance: the silvery shines by night, by day the golden.

10.2.s: jyotiryajñasya pavate madʰu priyaṃ pitā devānāṃ janitā vibʰūvasuḥ dadʰāti ratnam̐ svadʰayorapīcyaṃ madintamo matsara indriyo rasaḥ
10.2.d: ज्योतिर्यज्ञस्य पवते मधु प्रियं पिता देवानां जनिता विभूवसुः दधाति रत्नꣳ स्वधयोरपीच्यं मदिन्तमो मत्सर इन्द्रियो रसः
10.2.e: Like cars that thunder on their way, like coursers eager for renown, Have Soma drops flowed forth for wealth.

10.2.s: abʰikrandankalaśaṃ vājyarṣati patirdivaḥ śatadʰāro vicakṣaṇaḥ harirmitrasya sadaneṣu sīdati marmr̥jāno 'vibʰiḥ sindʰubʰirvr̥ṣā
10.2.d: अभिक्रन्दन्कलशं वाज्यर्षति पतिर्दिवः शतधारो विचक्षणः हरिर्मित्रस्य सदनेषु सीदति मर्मृजानो ऽविभिः सिन्धुभिर्वृषा
10.2.e: Forth have they rushed from holding hands, like chariots that are urged to speed, Like joyful songs of singing-men.

10.2.s: agre sindʰūnāṃ pavamāno arṣatyagre vāco agriyo goṣu gaccʰasi agre vājasya bʰajase mahaddʰanam̐ svāyudʰaḥ sotr̥bʰiḥ soma sūyase
10.2.d: अग्रे सिन्धूनां पवमानो अर्षत्यग्रे वाचो अग्रियो गोषु गच्छसि अग्रे वाजस्य भजसे महद्धनꣳ स्वायुधः सोतृभिः सोम सूयसे
10.2.e: The Somas deck themselves with milk as kings are graced with eulogies, And, with seven priests, the sacrifice.

10.2.s: asr̥kṣata pra vājino gavyā somāso aśvayā śukrāso vīrayāśavaḥ
10.2.d: असृक्षत प्र वाजिनो गव्या सोमासो अश्वया शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः
10.2.e: Pressed for the gladdening draught the drops flow forth abundantly with song, Flow with the stream of savoury juice.

10.2.s: śumbʰamāno r̥tāyubʰirmr̥jyamānā gabʰastyoḥ pavante vāre avyaye
10.2.d: शुम्भमानो ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमाना गभस्त्योः पवन्ते वारे अव्यये
10.2.e: Winning Vivasvan's glory and speeding the light of Dawn, the suns, Pass through the openings of the cloth.

10.2.s: te viśvā dāśuṣe vasu somā divyāni pārtʰivā pavantāmāntarikṣyā
10.2.d: ते विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमा दिव्यानि पार्थिवा पवन्तामान्तरिक्ष्या
10.2.e: The singing-men of ancient time open the doors of sacred songs-- The men who bring the mighty One.

10.2.s: pavasva devavīrati pavitram̐ soma ram̐hyā indramindo vr̥ṣā viśa
10.2.d: पवस्व देववीरति पवित्रꣳ सोम रꣳह्या इन्द्रमिन्दो वृषा विश
10.2.e: In close society have come the priests, the sevenfold brotherhood, Filling the station of the One.

10.2.s: ā vacyasva mahi psaro vr̥ṣendo dyumnavattamaḥ ā yoniṃ dʰarṇasiḥ sadaḥ
10.2.d: आ वच्यस्व महि प्सरो वृषेन्दो द्युम्नवत्तमः आ योनिं धर्णसिः सदः
10.2.e: He makes us kin with Gods, he joins the Sun, for seeing, with mine eye; I milk the Sage's offspring forth.

10.2.s: adʰukṣata priyaṃ madʰu dʰārā sutasya vedʰasaḥ apo vasiṣṭa sukratuḥ
10.2.d: अधुक्षत प्रियं मधु धारा सुतस्य वेधसः अपो वसिष्ट सुक्रतुः
10.2.e: The Sun beholdeth with his eye the heaven's dear quarter which the priests Have set within the sacred cell. II Soma Pavamana

10.2.s: mahāntaṃ tvā mahīranvāpo arṣanti sindʰavaḥ yadgobʰirvāsayiṣyase
10.2.d: महान्तं त्वा महीरन्वापो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे
10.2.e: Forth on their way the glorious drops have flowed for maintenance of Law, Knowing what suits this worshipper.

10.2.s: samudro apsu māmr̥je viṣṭambʰo dʰaruṇo divaḥ somaḥ pavitre asmayuḥ
10.2.d: समुद्रो अप्सु मामृजे विष्टम्भो धरुणो दिवः सोमः पवित्रे अस्मयुः
10.2.e: Down in the mighty waters sinks the stream of Meath, most excellent, Oblation best of all in worth.

10.2.s: acikradadvr̥ṣā harirmahānmitro na darśataḥ sam̐ sūryeṇa didyute
10.2.d: अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिर्महान्मित्रो न दर्शतः सꣳ सूर्येण दिद्युते
10.2.e: About the holy place the Steer, true, guileless, noblest, hath sent forth, Continuous voices in the wood.

10.2.s: girasta inda ojasā marmr̥jyante apasyuvaḥ yābʰirmadāya śumbʰase
10.2.d: गिरस्त इन्द ओजसा मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः याभिर्मदाय शुम्भसे
10.2.e: When the Sage, purging manly deeds and lofty wisdom flows, around,

10.2.s: taṃ tvā madāya gʰr̥ṣvaya u lokakr̥tnumīmahe tava praśastaye mahe
10.2.d: तं त्वा मदाय घृष्वय उ लोककृत्नुमीमहे तव प्रशस्तये महे
10.2.e: When purified, he sits enthroned as King over the warring clans. What time the sages speed him on.

10.2.s: goṣā indo nr̥ṣā asyaśvasā vājasā uta ātmā yajñasya pūrvyaḥ
10.2.d: गोषा इन्दो नृषा अस्यश्वसा वाजसा उत आत्मा यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः
10.2.e: Most dear, gold-coloured, in the fleece he sinks, and settles in the wood: The singer is besieged with song.

10.2.s: asmabʰyamindavindriyaṃ madʰoḥ pavasva dʰārayā parjanyo vr̥ṣṭimām̐ iva
10.2.d: अस्मभ्यमिन्दविन्द्रियं मधोः पवस्व धारया पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाꣳ इव
10.2.e: He goes to Indra, Vayu, and the Asvins with the rapturous joy, To whomsoe'er his power delights.

10.2.s: sanā ca soma jeṣi ca pavamāna mahi śravaḥ atʰā no vasyasaskr̥dʰi
10.2.d: सना च सोम जेषि च पवमान महि श्रवः अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि
10.2.e: The waves of pleasant Soma flow to Bhaga, Mitra, Varuna, Well knowing, through his mighty powers.

10.2.s: sanā jyotiḥ sanā svā3rviśvā ca soma saubʰagā atʰā no vasyasaskr̥dʰi
10.2.d: सना ज्योतिः सना स्वा३र्विश्वा च सोम सौभगा अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि
10.2.e: Gain for us, O ye Heaven and Earth, riches of Meath to win us strength: Gain for us treasures and renown.

10.2.s: sanā dakṣamuta kratumapa soma mr̥dʰo jahi atʰā no vasyasaskr̥dʰi
10.2.d: सना दक्षमुत क्रतुमप सोम मृधो जहि अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि
10.2.e: We choose to-day that chariot-steed of thine, the strong, that brings us bliss, The guardian, the desire of all;

10.2.s: pavītāraḥ punītana somamindrāya pātave atʰā no vasyasaskr̥dʰi
10.2.d: पवीतारः पुनीतन सोममिन्द्राय पातवे अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि
10.2.e: The excellent, the gladdener, the Sage with heart that understands. The guardian, the desire of all;

10.2.s: tvam̐ sūrye na ā bʰaja tava kratvā tavotibʰiḥ atʰā no vasyasaskr̥dʰi
10.2.d: त्वꣳ सूर्ये न आ भज तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिः अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि
10.2.e: Who for ourselves, O thou most wise, is wealth and fair intelligence, The guardian, the desire of all. III Agni

10.2.s: tava kratvā tavotibʰirjyokpaśyema sūryam atʰā no vasyasaskr̥dʰi
10.2.d: तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिर्ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यम् अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि
10.2.e: Agni Vaisvanara, born in course of Order, the messenger of earth, the head of heaven, The Sage, the Sovran, guest of men, our vessel fit for their mouth, the Gods have generated.

10.2.s: abʰyarṣa svāyudʰa soma dvibarhasam̐ rayim atʰā no vasyasaskr̥dʰi
10.2.d: अभ्यर्ष स्वायुध सोम द्विबर्हसꣳ रयिम् अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि
10.2.e: To thee, immortal! when to life thou springest all the Gods sing for joy as to their infant. They by thy mental powers were made immortal, Vaisvdnara when thou shonest from thy parents.

10.2.s: abʰyā3rṣānapacyuto vājintsamatsu sāsahiḥ atʰā no vasyasaskr̥dʰi
10.2.d: अभ्या३र्षानपच्युतो वाजिन्त्समत्सु सासहिः अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि
10.2.e: Him have they praised, mid-point of sacrifices, great cistern of libations, seat of riches. Vaisvanara, conveyer of oblations, ensign of worship, have the Gods engendered. IV Mitra-Varuna

10.2.s: tvāṃ yajñairavīvr̥dʰanpavamāna vidʰarmaṇi atʰā no vasyasaskr̥dʰi
10.2.d: त्वां यज्ञैरवीवृधन्पवमान विधर्मणि अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि
10.2.e: Sing forth unto your Varuna and Mitra with a song inspired: They, mighty Lords, are lofty law.

10.2.s: rayiṃ naścitramaśvinamindo viśvāyumā bʰara atʰā no vasyasaskr̥dʰi
10.2.d: रयिं नश्चित्रमश्विनमिन्दो विश्वायुमा भर अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि
10.2.e: Full springs of fatness, sovran Kings, Mitra and Varuna, the twain, Gods glorified among the Gods,

10.2.s: taratsa mandī dʰāvati dʰārā sutasyāndʰasaḥ taratsa mandī dʰāvati
10.2.d: तरत्स मन्दी धावति धारा सुतस्यान्धसः तरत्स मन्दी धावति
10.2.e: So help ye us to riches, great celestial and terrestrial wealth! Vast is your sway among the Gods. V Indra

10.2.s: usrā veda vasūnāṃ marttasya devyavasaḥ taratsa mandī dʰāvati
10.2.d: उस्रा वेद वसूनां मर्त्तस्य देव्यवसः तरत्स मन्दी धावति
10.2.e: O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, Thus by firie fingers purified!

10.2.s: dʰvasrayoḥ puruṣantyorā sahasrāṇi dadmahe taratsa mandī dʰāvati
10.2.d: ध्वस्रयोः पुरुषन्त्योरा सहस्राणि दद्महे तरत्स मन्दी धावति
10.2.e: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come nigb, O Indra, to The sacrificing suppliant's pravers!

10.2.s: ā yayostrim̐śataṃ tanā sahasrāṇi ca dadmahe taratsa mandī dʰāvati
10.2.d: आ ययोस्त्रिꣳशतं तना सहस्राणि च दद्महे तरत्स मन्दी धावति
10.2.e: Approach, O Indra, basting thee, Lord of bay horses, to our prayers: In our libation t ake delight! VI Indra-Agni

10.2.s: ete somā asr̥kṣata gr̥ṇānāḥ śavase mahe madintamasya dʰārayā
10.2.d: एते सोमा असृक्षत गृणानाः शवसे महे मदिन्तमस्य धारया
10.2.e: Glorify him who compasses all forests with his glowing Dame, And leaves them blackened by his tongue.

10.2.s: abʰi gavyāni vītaye nr̥mṇā punāno arṣasi sanadvājaḥ pari srava
10.2.d: अभि गव्यानि वीतये नृम्णा पुनानो अर्षसि सनद्वाजः परि स्रव
10.2.e: He who gains Indra's grace by fire enkindled, finds as easy way Over the floods to splendid wealth.

10.2.s: uta no gomatīriṣo viśvā arṣa pariṣṭubʰaḥ gr̥ṇāno jamadagninā
10.2.d: उत नो गोमतीरिषो विश्वा अर्ष परिष्टुभः गृणानो जमदग्निना
10.2.e: Give us, ye twain, swift steeds to bring Indra and Agni, and bestow Abundant food with wealth on us. VII Soma Pavamana.

10.2.s: imam̐ stomamarhate jātavedase ratʰamiva saṃ mahemā manīṣayā bʰadrā hi naḥ pramatirasya sam̐sadyagne sakʰye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
10.2.d: इमꣳ स्तोममर्हते जातवेदसे रथमिव सं महेमा मनीषया भद्रा हि नः प्रमतिरस्य सꣳसद्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव
