10.2.e: Indu hath started forth for Indra's settled place, and slights not,. as a friend, the promise of his friend. Soma comes onward like a youth with youthful maids, and gains the beaker by a course of hundred paths.

10.2.s: bʰarāmedʰmaṃ kr̥ṇavāmā havīm̐ṣi te citayantaḥ parvaṇāparvaṇā vayam jīvātave prataram̐ sādʰayā dʰiyo 'gne sakʰye ma riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
10.2.d: भरामेध्मं कृणवामा हवीꣳषि ते चितयन्तः पर्वणापर्वणा वयम् जीवातवे प्रतरꣳ साधया धियो ऽग्ने सख्ये म रिषामा वयं तव
10.2.e: Your hymns of pleasant sound, praiseworthy, fond of lauds, have come into the hall enclosed for sacrifice. Singers have hymned the golden-coloured as he sports, and milchkine have come near to meet him with their milk,

10.2.s: śakema tvā samidʰam̐ sādʰayā dʰiyastve devā haviradantyāhutam tvamādityām̐ ā vaha tānhyū3śmasyagne sakʰye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
10.2.d: शकेम त्वा समिधꣳ साधया धियस्त्वे देवा हविरदन्त्याहुतम् त्वमादित्याꣳ आ वह तान्ह्यू३श्मस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव
10.2.e: O Soma, Indu, while they cleanse thee, with thy wave pour orb us plentiful accumulated food, Which, ceaseless, thrice a day shall yield us hero power enriched. with store of nourishment, and strength, and meath. VIII Indra.

10.2.s: prati vām̐ sūra udite mitraṃ gr̥ṇīṣe varuṇam aryamaṇam̐ riśādasam
10.2.d: प्रति वाꣳ सूर उदिते मित्रं गृणीषे वरुणम् अर्यमणꣳ रिशादसम्
10.2.e: No one by deed attains to him who works and strengthensevermore: No, not by sacrifice, to Indra praised of all, resistless, daring, bold in might;

10.2.s: rāyā hiraṇyayā matiriyamavr̥kāya śavase iyaṃ viprāmedʰasātaye
10.2.d: राया हिरण्यया मतिरियमवृकाय शवसे इयं विप्रामेधसातये
10.2.e: The powerful conqueror, invincible in war, him at whose birth the mighty ones, The kine who spread afar, sent their loud voices out, heavens, earths sent their loud voices out. IX Soma Vaisvanara

10.2.s: te syāma deva varuṇa te mitra sūribʰiḥ saha iṣam̐ svaśca dʰīmahi
10.2.d: ते स्याम देव वरुण ते मित्र सूरिभिः सह इषꣳ स्वश्च धीमहि
10.2.e: Sit down, O friends, and sing aloud to him who purifies himself: Deck him for glory, like a child, with holy rites

10.2.s: bʰindʰi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ pari bādʰo jahī mr̥dʰaḥ vasu spārhaṃ tadā bʰara
10.2.d: भिन्धि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर
10.2.e: Loose him who bringeth household wealth, even as a calf with. mother kine, Him who bath double strength, strong, god-delighting juice!

10.2.s: yasya te viśvamānuṣagbʰūrerdattasya vedati vasu spārhaṃ tadā bʰara
10.2.d: यस्य ते विश्वमानुषग्भूरेर्दत्तस्य वेदति वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर
10.2.e: Purify him who gives us power, most blissful one, that he may be A banquet for the troop, Mitra, and Varuna! X Soma Pavamana

10.2.s: yadvīḍāvindra yatstʰire yatparśāne parābʰr̥tam vasu spārhaṃ tadā bʰara
10.2.d: यद्वीडाविन्द्र यत्स्थिरे यत्पर्शाने पराभृतम् वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर
10.2.e: The Strong hath flowed forth in a thousand streams, flowed through the filter and the sheep's long wool.

10.2.s: yajñasya hi stʰa r̥tvijā sasnī vājeṣu karmasu indrāgnī tasya bodʰatam
10.2.d: यज्ञस्य हि स्थ ऋत्विजा सस्नी वाजेषु कर्मसु इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम्
10.2.e: With ceaseless genial flow the Strong hath run, purified by the waters, blent with milk.

10.2.s: tośāsā ratʰayāvānā vr̥trahaṇāparājitā indrāgnī tasya bodʰatam
10.2.d: तोशासा रथयावाना वृत्रहणापराजिता इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम्
10.2.e: Pressed out with stones, directed by the men, go forth, O Soma, into Indra's throat! XI Soma Pavamana

10.2.s: idaṃ vāṃ madiraṃ madʰvadʰukṣannadribʰirnaraḥ indrāgnī tasya bodʰatam
10.2.d: इदं वां मदिरं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम्
10.2.e: The Soma juices which have been expressed afar or near at hand, Or there on Saryanavan's bank,

10.2.s: indrāyendo marutvate pavasva madʰumattamaḥ arkasya yonimāsadam
10.2.d: इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते पवस्व मधुमत्तमः अर्कस्य योनिमासदम्
10.2.e: Those pressed among Arjikas, pressed among the active, in, men's homes, Or pressed among the Fivefold Tribes--

10.2.s: taṃ tvā viprā vacovidaḥ pariṣkr̥ṇvanti dʰarṇasim saṃ tvā mr̥jantyāyavaḥ
10.2.d: तं त्वा विप्रा वचोविदः परिष्कृण्वन्ति धर्णसिम् सं त्वा मृजन्त्यायवः
10.2.e: May these celestial drops, expressed, pour forth upon us, as they flow, Rain from the heavens and hero strength! XII Agni

10.2.s: rasaṃ te mitro aryamā pibantu varuṇaḥ kave pavamānasya marutaḥ
10.2.d: रसं ते मित्रो अर्यमा पिबन्तु वरुणः कवे पवमानस्य मरुतः
10.2.e: May Vatsa draw thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling-place! Agni, I yearn for thee with song.

10.2.s: mr̥jyamānaḥ suhastya samudre vācaminvasi rayiṃ piśaṅgaṃ bahulaṃ puruspr̥haṃ pavamānābʰyarṣasi
10.2.d: मृज्यमानः सुहस्त्य समुद्रे वाचमिन्वसि रयिं पिशङ्गं बहुलं पुरुस्पृहं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि
10.2.e: Thou art alike in many a place: through all the regions thou art Lord. In fray and fight we call on thee.

10.2.s: punāno vare pavamano avyaye vr̥ṣo acikradadvane devānām̐ soma pavamāna niṣkr̥taṃ gobʰirañjāno arṣasi
10.2.d: पुनानो वरे पवमनो अव्यये वृषो अचिक्रदद्वने देवानाꣳ सोम पवमान निष्कृतं गोभिरञ्जानो अर्षसि
10.2.e: When we are seeking spoil we call Agni to help us in the strife, Giver of wordrous gifts in war. XIII Indra 1, O Indra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, 5atakratu, thou most active, bring A hero conquering in war!

10.2.s: etamu tyaṃ daśa kṣipo mr̥janti sindʰumātaram samādityebʰirakʰyata
10.2.d: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सिन्धुमातरम् समादित्येभिरख्यत
10.2.e: For, gracious Satakratu, thou hast ever been a mother and a sire to us, So now for bliss we pray to thee.

10.2.s: samindreṇota vāyunā suta eti pavitra ā sam̐ sūryasya raśmibʰiḥ
10.2.d: समिन्द्रेणोत वायुना सुत एति पवित्र आ सꣳ सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः
10.2.e: To thee, strong! much-invoked! who showest forth thy strength, made very mighty! do I speak: So grant thou us heroic power! XIV Indra

10.2.s: sa no bʰagāya vāyave pūṣṇe pavasva madʰumān cārurmitre varuṇe ca
10.2.d: स नो भगाय वायवे पूष्णे पवस्व मधुमान् चारुर्मित्रे वरुणे च
10.2.e: Stone-Darting Indra, wonderous God, what wealth thou hast not given me here, That bounty, treasure-finder! bring, filling full both thy hands, to us!

10.2.s: revatīrnaḥ sadʰamāda indre santu tuvivājāḥ kṣumanto yābʰirmadema
10.2.d: रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम
10.2.e: Bring what thou deemest worth the wish, O Indra that which is in heavem! So may we know thee as thou art a giver boundless in thy gifts!

11.1.s: ā gʰa tvāvāṃ tmanā yuktaḥ stotr̥bʰyo dʰr̥ṣṇavīyānaḥ r̥ṇorakṣaṃ na cakryoḥ
11.1.d: आ घ त्वावां त्मना युक्तः स्तोतृभ्यो धृष्णवीयानः ऋणोरक्षं न चक्र्योः
11.1.e: Thy lofty spirit famed in all the regions as appeasable,-- With this thou rendest even things firm, Stone-darter! so to win thee strength. I Soma Pavamana

11.1.s: ā yadduvaḥ śatakratavā kāmaṃ jaritr̥̄ṇām r̥ṇorakṣaṃ na śacībʰiḥ
11.1.d: आ यद्दुवः शतक्रतवा कामं जरितॄणाम् ऋणोरक्षं न शचीभिः
11.1.e: The Maruts with their troop adorn and brighten, even at his birth, the Sage, the lovely infant. By songs a poet, and a Sage by wisdom, Soma goes singing through the cleansing filter.

11.1.s: surūpakr̥tnumūtaye sudugʰāmiva goduhe juhūmasi dyavidyavi
11.1.d: सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि
11.1.e: Light-winner, Rishi-minded, Rishi-maker, hymned in a thousand hymns, leader of sages, Eager to gain his third form, mighty, Soma is, like Viraj, resplendent as a singer.

11.1.s: upa naḥ savanā gahi somasya somapāḥ piba godā idrevato madaḥ
11.1.d: उप नः सवना गहि सोमस्य सोमपाः पिब गोदा इद्रेवतो मदः
11.1.e: Hawk seated in the press, bird wide-extended, the banner seeking kine and wielding weapons, Uniting with the sea, the wave of waters, the mighty tells his fourth form and declares it. II Soma Pavamana

11.1.s: atʰā te antamānāṃ vidyāma sumatīnām mā no ati kʰya ā gahi
11.1.d: अथा ते अन्तमानां विद्याम सुमतीनाम् मा नो अति ख्य आ गहि
11.1.e: Obeying Indra's dear desire these Soma juices have flowed forth Increasing his heroic might.

11.1.s: ubʰe yadindra rodasī āpaprātʰoṣā iva mahāntaṃ tvā mahīnām̐ samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnām devī janitryajījanadbʰadrā janitryajījanat
11.1.d: उभे यदिन्द्र रोदसी आपप्राथोषा इव महान्तं त्वा महीनाꣳ सम्राजं चर्षणीनाम् देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्
11.1.e: Laid in the press and flowing pure to Vayu and the Asvins, may These give us great heroic strength.

11.1.s: dīrgʰam̐ hyaṅkuśaṃ yatʰā śaktiṃ bibʰarṣi mantumaḥ pūrveṇa magʰavanpadā vayāmajo yatʰā yamaḥ devī janitryajījanadbʰadrā janitryajījanat
11.1.d: दीर्घꣳ ह्यङ्कुशं यथा शक्तिं बिभर्षि मन्तुमः पूर्वेण मघवन्पदा वयामजो यथा यमः देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्
11.1.e: Soma, as thou art purified, incite to bounty Indra's heart, To seat him in the shrine of Gods!

11.1.s: ava sma durhr̥ṇāyato marttasya tanuhi stʰiram adʰaspadaṃ tamīṃ kr̥dʰi yo asmām̐ abʰidāsati devī janitryajījanadbʰadrā janitryajījanat
11.1.d: अव स्म दुर्हृणायतो मर्त्तस्य तनुहि स्थिरम् अधस्पदं तमीं कृधि यो अस्माꣳ अभिदासति देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्
11.1.e: The ten swift fingers deck thee forth seven ministers impel thee on, The sages have rejoiced in thee.

11.1.s: pari svāno giriṣṭʰāḥ pavitre somo akṣarat madeṣu sarvadʰā asi
11.1.d: परि स्वानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षरत् मदेषु सर्वधा असि
11.1.e: When through the filter thou art poured we clothe thee with a robe of milk, To be a rapturous feast for Gods.

11.1.s: tvaṃ viprastvaṃ kavirmadʰu pra jātamandʰasaḥ madeṣu sarvadʰā asi
11.1.d: त्वं विप्रस्त्वं कविर्मधु प्र जातमन्धसः मदेषु सर्वधा असि
11.1.e: When purified within the jars, Soma bright-red and golden-hued, Hath veiled him in a milky dress.

11.1.s: tve viśve sajoṣaso devāsaḥ pītimāśata madeṣu sarvadʰā asi
11.1.d: त्वे विश्वे सजोषसो देवासः पीतिमाशत मदेषु सर्वधा असि
11.1.e: Flow onward to our wealthy lords. Drive all our enemies away: O lndu, pass into thy friend!

11.1.s: sa sunve yo vasūnāṃ yo rāyāmānetā ya iḍānām somo yaḥ sukṣitīnām
11.1.d: स सुन्वे यो वसूनां यो रायामानेता य इडानाम् सोमो यः सुक्षितीनाम्
11.1.e: May we obtain thee, Indra's drink, who viewest men and findest light, Gain thee and progeny and food!

11.1.s: yasya ta indraḥ pibādyasya maruto yasya vāryamaṇā bʰagaḥ ā yena mitrāvaruṇā karāmaha endramavase mahe
11.1.d: यस्य त इन्द्रः पिबाद्यस्य मरुतो यस्य वार्यमणा भगः आ येन मित्रावरुणा करामह एन्द्रमवसे महे
11.1.e: Send down the rain from heaven and make splendour upon the earth! Give us, O Soma, victory in war! III Soma Pavamana

11.1.s: taṃ vaḥ sakʰāyo madāya punānamabʰi gāyata śiśuṃ na havyaiḥ svadayanta gūrtibʰiḥ
11.1.d: तं वः सखायो मदाय पुनानमभि गायत शिशुं न हव्यैः स्वदयन्त गूर्तिभिः
11.1.e: Poured through the fleece in thousand streams purified Soma floweth to, Indra's and Vayu's meeting-place.

11.1.s: saṃ vatsa iva mātr̥bʰirindurhinvāno ajyate devāvīrmado matibʰiḥ pariṣkr̥taḥ
11.1.d: सं वत्स इव मातृभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते देवावीर्मदो मतिभिः परिष्कृतः
11.1.e: Sing forth, ye men who long for help, to Pavamana, to the Sage, Effused to entertain the Gods!

11.1.s: ayaṃ dakṣāya sādʰano 'yam̐ śardʰāya vītaye ayaṃ devebʰyo madʰumattaraḥ sutaḥ
11.1.d: अयं दक्षाय साधनो ऽयꣳ शर्धाय वीतये अयं देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तरः सुतः
11.1.e: The Soma drops with thousand powers are purified to win us strength, Hymned to become the feast of Gods.

11.1.s: somāḥ pavanta indavo 'smabʰyaṃ gātuvittamāḥ mitrāḥ suvānā arepasaḥ svādʰyaḥ svarvidaḥ
11.1.d: सोमाः पवन्त इन्दवो ऽस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमाः मित्राः सुवाना अरेपसः स्वाध्यः स्वर्विदः
11.1.e: Yea, as thou flowest bring great store of food that we may win us strength: Indu, bring splendid manly might

11.1.s: te pūtāso vipaścitaḥ somāso dadʰyāśiraḥ sūrāso na darśatāso jigatnavo dʰruvā gʰr̥te
11.1.d: ते पूतासो विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः सूरासो न दर्शतासो जिगत्नवो ध्रुवा घृते
11.1.e: Like coursers by their drivers urged, they were poured forth, to win us strength, Swift through the woollen straining-cloth.

11.1.s: suṣvāṇāso vyadribʰiścitānā goradʰi tvaci iṣamasmabʰyamabʰitaḥ samasvaranvasuvidaḥ
11.1.d: सुष्वाणासो व्यद्रिभिश्चिताना गोरधि त्वचि इषमस्मभ्यमभितः समस्वरन्वसुविदः
11.1.e: May they in flowing give us wealth in thousands, and heroic power,-- These godlike Soma drops effused!

11.1.s: ayā pavā pavasvainā vasūni mām̐ścatva indo sarasi pra dʰanva bragʰnaścidyasya vāto na jūtiṃ purumedʰāścittakave naraṃ dʰāt
11.1.d: अया पवा पवस्वैना वसूनि माꣳश्चत्व इन्दो सरसि प्र धन्व ब्रघ्नश्चिद्यस्य वातो न जूतिं पुरुमेधाश्चित्तकवे नरं धात्
11.1.e: The roaring Soma drops flow on, like milch-kine lowing to, their calves: They have run forth from both the hands.

11.1.s: uta na enā pavayā pavasvādʰi śrute śravāyyasya tīrtʰe ṣaṣṭim̐ sahasrā naiguto vasūni vr̥kṣaṃ na pakvaṃ dʰūnavadraṇāya
11.1.d: उत न एना पवया पवस्वाधि श्रुते श्रवाय्यस्य तीर्थे षष्टिꣳ सहस्रा नैगुतो वसूनि वृक्षं न पक्वं धूनवद्रणाय
11.1.e: Beloved by Indra, bringing joy, roaring as thou art purified, Drive all our enemies away.

11.1.s: mahīme asya vr̥ṣa nāma śūṣe mām̐ścatve vā pr̥śane vā vadʰatre asvāpayannigutaḥ snehayaccāpāmitrām̐ apācito acetaḥ
11.1.d: महीमे अस्य वृष नाम शूषे माꣳश्चत्वे वा पृशने वा वधत्रे अस्वापयन्निगुतः स्नेहयच्चापामित्राꣳ अपाचितो अचेतः
11.1.e: As Pavamanas, driving off the godless, looking on the light, Sit in the place of sacrifice. IV Soma Pavamana

11.1.s: agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bʰuvo varūtʰyaḥ
11.1.d: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भुवो वरूथ्यः
11.1.e: The Soma drops, exceeding rich in sweets, to Indra have been poured, Shed with the stream of sacrifice.

11.1.s: vasuragnirvasuśravā accʰā nakṣi dyumattamo rayiṃ dāḥ
11.1.d: वसुरग्निर्वसुश्रवा अच्छा नक्षि द्युमत्तमो रयिं दाः
11.1.e: Sages have called to Indra, like cows, milch-kine, lowing to their calves, Called him to drink the Soma juice.

11.1.s: taṃ tvā śociṣṭʰa dīdivaḥ sumnāya nūnamīmahe sakʰibʰyaḥ
11.1.d: तं त्वा शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सुम्नाय नूनमीमहे सखिभ्यः
11.1.e: In the stream's wave wise Soma dwells, distilling rapture, in his. seat, Resting upon a wild cow's hide.

11.1.s: imā nu kaṃ bʰuvanā sīṣadʰemendraśca viśve ca devāḥ
11.1.d: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधेमेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः
11.1.e: Far-sighted Soma, Sage and bard, is worshipped in the central point, Of heaven, the straining-cloth of wool.

11.1.s: yajñaṃ ca nastanvaṃ ca prajāṃ cādityairindraḥ saha sīṣadʰātu
11.1.d: यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च प्रजां चादित्यैरिन्द्रः सह सीषधातु
11.1.e: In close embracement Indu holds Soma when poured within the: jars. And on the purifying sieve.

11.1.s: ādityairindraḥ sagaṇo marudbʰirasmabʰyaṃ bʰeṣajā karat
11.1.d: आदित्यैरिन्द्रः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्मभ्यं भेषजा करत्
11.1.e: Indu sends forth a voice on high, up in the region of the sea. Stirring the cask that drops with meath.

11.1.s: pra va indrāya vr̥trahantamāya viprāya gātʰaṃ gāyata yaṃ jujoṣate
11.1.d: प्र व इन्द्राय वृत्रहन्तमाय विप्राय गाथं गायत यं जुजोषते
11.1.e: The tree whose praises never fail dwells in the stream of holy milk, Urged onward by its human friend.

11.1.s: arcantyarkaṃ marutaḥ svarkā ā stobʰati śruto yuvā sa indraḥ
11.1.d: अर्चन्त्यर्कं मरुतः स्वर्का आ स्तोभति श्रुतो युवा स इन्द्रः
11.1.e: O Pavamana bring us wealth bright with a thousand splendours; yea, O Indu, give us ready help!

11.1.s: upa prakṣe madʰumati kṣiyantaḥ puṣyema rayiṃ dʰīmahe ta indra
11.1.d: उप प्रक्षे मधुमति क्षियन्तः पुष्येम रयिं धीमहे त इन्द्र
11.1.e: Sage, poet, poured with all his stream, Soma is driven, far away, To the dear places of the sky. V Soma Pavamana

11.1.s: pra kāvyamuśaneva bruvāṇo devo devānāṃ janimā vivakti mahivrataḥ śucibandʰuḥ pāvakaḥ padā varāho abʰyeti rebʰan
11.1.d: प्र काव्यमुशनेव ब्रुवाणो देवो देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति महिव्रतः शुचिबन्धुः पावकः पदा वराहो अभ्येति रेभन्
11.1.e: Loud as a river's roaring wave thy powers have lifted up themselves: Urge on thine arrow's sharpened point!

11.1.s: pra ham̐sāsastr̥palā vagnumaccʰāmādastaṃ vr̥ṣagaṇā ayāsuḥ āṅgoṣiṇaṃ pavamānam̐ sakʰāyo durmarṣaṃ vāṇaṃ pra vadanti sākam
11.1.d: प्र हꣳसासस्तृपला वग्नुमच्छामादस्तं वृषगणा अयासुः आङ्गोषिणं पवमानꣳ सखायो दुर्मर्षं वाणं प्र वदन्ति साकम्
11.1.e: At thine effusion upward rise three voices fresh and strong, when thou. Flowest upon the fleecy ridge.

11.1.s: sa yojata urugāyasya jūtiṃ vr̥tʰā krīḍantaṃ mimate na gāvaḥ parīṇasaṃ kr̥ṇute tigmaśr̥ṅgo divā harirdadr̥śe naktamr̥jraḥ
11.1.d: स योजत उरुगायस्य जूतिं वृथा क्रीडन्तं मिमते न गावः परीणसं कृणुते तिग्मशृङ्गो दिवा हरिर्ददृशे नक्तमृज्रः
11.1.e: On to the fleece they urge with stones the dear, the goldencoloured one, Even Pavamana dropping meath.

11.1.s: pra svānāso ratʰā ivārvanto na avasyavaḥ somāso rāye akramuḥ
11.1.d: प्र स्वानासो रथा इवार्वन्तो न अवस्यवः सोमासो राये अक्रमुः
11.1.e: Flow with thy current to the sieve, O Sage, best giver of delight, To seat these in the shrine of song!

11.1.s: hinvānāso ratʰā iva dadʰanvire gabʰastyoḥ bʰarāsaḥ kāriṇāmiva
11.1.d: हिन्वानासो रथा इव दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः भरासः कारिणामिव
11.1.e: Best giver of delight, flow on anointed with the milk for balm, And enter into Indra's throat! VI Soma Pavamana

11.1.s: rājāno na praśastibʰiḥ somāso gobʰirañjate yajño na sapta dʰātr̥bʰiḥ
11.1.d: राजानो न प्रशस्तिभिः सोमासो गोभिरञ्जते यज्ञो न सप्त धातृभिः
11.1.e: Flow onward, Indu, with this food for him who in thy wild delights, Battered the nine-and-ninety down.

11.1.s: pari svānāsa indavo madāya barhaṇā girā madʰo arṣanti dʰārayā
11.1.d: परि स्वानास इन्दवो मदाय बर्हणा गिरा मधो अर्षन्ति धारया
11.1.e: Smote swiftly forts, and Sambara, then Yadu and that Turvasa, For pious Divodasa's sake!

11.1.s: āpānāso vivasvato jinvanta uṣaso bʰagam sūrā aṇvaṃ vi tanvate
11.1.d: आपानासो विवस्वतो जिन्वन्त उषसो भगम् सूरा अण्वं वि तन्वते
11.1.e: Finder of horses, pour on us horses and wealth in kine and gold, And Indu, food in boundless store! VII Soma Pavamana

11.1.s: apa dvārā matīnāṃ pratnā r̥ṇvanti kāravaḥ vr̥ṣṇo harasa āyavaḥ
11.1.d: अप द्वारा मतीनां प्रत्ना ऋण्वन्ति कारवः वृष्णो हरस आयवः
11.1.e: Chasing our foemen, driving off the godless, Soma floweth on, Going to Indra's settled place.

11.1.s: samīcīnāsa āśata hotāraḥ saptajānayaḥ padamekasya piprataḥ
11.1.d: समीचीनास आशत होतारः सप्तजानयः पदमेकस्य पिप्रतः
11.1.e: O Pavamana, hither bring great riches, and destroy our foes: O Indu, grant heroic fame!

11.1.s: nābʰā nābʰiṃ na ā dade cakṣuṣā sūrya dr̥śe kaverapatyamā duhe
11.1.d: नाभा नाभिं न आ ददे चक्षुषा सूर्य दृशे कवेरपत्यमा दुहे
11.1.e: A hundred obstacles have ne'er checked thee when rain to give thy boons, When, being cleansed, thou combatest. VIII Soma Pavamana

11.1.s: abʰi priyaṃ divaspadamadʰvaryubʰirguhā hitam sūraḥ pasyati cakṣasā
11.1.d: अभि प्रियं दिवस्पदमध्वर्युभिर्गुहा हितम् सूरः पस्यति चक्षसा
11.1.e: Flow onward with that stream wherewith thou gavest splendour to the sun, Speeding the waters kind to man!

11.1.s: asr̥gramindavaḥ patʰā dʰarmannr̥tasya suśriyaḥ vidānā asya yojanā
11.1.d: असृग्रमिन्दवः पथा धर्मन्नृतस्य सुश्रियः विदाना अस्य योजना
11.1.e: He, Pavamana, high o'er man, yoked the Sun's courser Etasa, To travel through the realm of air.

11.1.s: pra dʰārā madʰo agriyo mahīrapo vi gāhate havirhaviḥṣu vandyaḥ
11.1.d: प्र धारा मधो अग्रियो महीरपो वि गाहते हविर्हविःषु वन्द्यः
11.1.e: Yea, those bay steeds he harnessed to the chariot that the Sun might come: Indu, he said, is Indra's self. IX Agni

11.1.s: pra yujā vāco agriyo vr̥ṣo acikradadvane sadmābʰi satyo adʰvaraḥ
11.1.d: प्र युजा वाचो अग्रियो वृषो अचिक्रदद्वने सद्माभि सत्यो अध्वरः
11.1.e: Associate with fires, make your God Agni envoy at sacrifice, best skilled in worship, Established firm among mankind, the holy flame-crowned and fed with oil, the purifier!

11.1.s: pari yatkāvyā kavirnr̥mṇā punāno arṣati svarvājī siṣāsati
11.1.d: परि यत्काव्या कविर्नृम्णा पुनानो अर्षति स्वर्वाजी सिषासति
11.1.e: Like a steed neighing eager for the pasture, when he hath stepped forth from the great enclosure: Then the wind following blows upon his splendour, and, straight, the path is black which thou hast travelled.

11.1.s: pavamāno abʰi spr̥dʰo viśo rājeva sīdati yadīmr̥ṇvanti vedʰasaḥ
11.1.d: पवमानो अभि स्पृधो विशो राजेव सीदति यदीमृण्वन्ति वेधसः
11.1.e: From thee, a bull but newly born, O Agni, the kindled everlasting flames rise upward. Aloft to heaven as ruddy smoke thou mountest: Agni, thou speedest to the Gods as envoy. X Indra

11.1.s: avyā vāre pari priyo harirvaneṣu sīdati rebʰo vanuṣyate mati
11.1.d: अव्या वारे परि प्रियो हरिर्वनेषु सीदति रेभो वनुष्यते मति
11.1.e: We make this Indra very strong to strike the mighty Vritra dead: A vigorous hero shall he be.

11.1.s: sa vāyumindramaśvinā sākaṃ madena gaccʰati raṇā yo asya dʰarmaṇā
11.1.d: स वायुमिन्द्रमश्विना साकं मदेन गच्छति रणा यो अस्य धर्मणा
11.1.e: This Indra, made for giving gifts, is stablished, mightiest, in strength, Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.

11.1.s: ā mitre varuṇe bʰage madʰoḥ pavanta ūrmayaḥ vidānā asya śakmabʰiḥ
11.1.d: आ मित्रे वरुणे भगे मधोः पवन्त ऊर्मयः विदाना अस्य शक्मभिः
11.1.e: By song, as 'twere' the powerful bolt which none may parry, was prepared: Strong and invincible he grew. XI Soma Pavamana I. Adhvaryu, to the filter lead the Soma-juice expressed with stones: Make thou it pure for Indra's drink!

11.1.s: asmabʰyam̐ rodasī rayiṃ madʰvo vājasya sātaye śravo vasūni sañjitam
11.1.d: अस्मभ्यꣳ रोदसी रयिं मध्वो वाजस्य सातये श्रवो वसूनि सञ्जितम्
11.1.e: These Gods and all the Marut host, Indu! enjoy this juice of thine, This Pavamana's flowing meath.

11.1.s: ā te dakṣaṃ mayobʰuvaṃ vahnimadyā vr̥ṇīmahe pāntamā puruspr̥ham
11.1.d: आ ते दक्षं मयोभुवं वह्निमद्या वृणीमहे पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम्
11.1.e: Pour out for Indra, Thunder-armed, the milk of heaven, the Soma's juice, Most excellent, most rich in sweets! XII Soma Pavamana

11.1.s: ā mandramā vareṇyamā vipramā manīṣiṇam pāntamā puruspr̥ham
11.1.d: आ मन्द्रमा वरेण्यमा विप्रमा मनीषिणम् पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम्
11.1.e: On flows the potent juice, sustainer of the heavens, the strength of Gods, whom men must hail with shouts of joy, Thou, gold-hued, started like a courser by brave men, art lightly showing forth thy splendour in the streams.

11.1.s: ā rayimā sucetunamā sukrato tanūṣvā pāntamā puruspr̥ham
11.1.d: आ रयिमा सुचेतुनमा सुक्रतो तनूष्वा पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम्
11.1.e: He takes his weapons, like a hero, in his hands, fain to win light, car-borne, in forays for the kine. Indu, while stimulating Indra's might, is urged forward and balmed by sages skilful in their task.

11.1.s: mūrdʰānaṃ divo aratiṃ pr̥tʰivyā vaiśvānaramr̥ta ā jātamagnim kavim̐ samrājamatitʰiṃ janānāmāsannaḥ pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ
11.1.d: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निम् कविꣳ सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्नः पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः
11.1.e: Soma, as thou art purified with flowing wave, exhibiting thy strength enter thou Indra's throat. Make both worlds stream for us, as lightning doth the clouds: mete out exhaustless powers for us through this our prayer! XIII Indra

11.1.s: tvāṃ viśve amr̥ta jāyamānam̐ śiśuṃ na devā abʰi saṃ navante tava kratubʰiramr̥tatvamāyanvaiśvānara yatpitroradīdeḥ
11.1.d: त्वां विश्वे अमृत जायमानꣳ शिशुं न देवा अभि सं नवन्ते तव क्रतुभिरमृतत्वमायन्वैश्वानर यत्पित्रोरदीदेः
11.1.e: Though, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and westward, north and south, Thou chiefly art with Anava and Turvasa, brave champion! urged by men to come.

11.1.s: nābʰiṃ yajñānām̐ sadanam̐ rayīṇāṃ mahāmāhāvamabʰi saṃ navanta vaiśvānaram̐ ratʰyamadʰvarāṇāṃ yajñasya ketuṃ janayanta devāḥ
11.1.d: नाभिं यज्ञानाꣳ सदनꣳ रयीणां महामाहावमभि सं नवन्त वैश्वानरꣳ रथ्यमध्वराणां यज्ञस्य केतुं जनयन्त देवाः
11.1.e: Or, Indra, when with Ruma, Rusama, Syavaka, and Kripa thou rejoicest thee, Still do the Kanvas, bringing prayer, with hymns of praise O Indra, draw thee hither: come! XIV Indra

11.1.s: pra vo mitrāya gāyata varuṇāya vipā girā mahikṣatrāvr̥taṃ br̥hat
11.1.d: प्र वो मित्राय गायत वरुणाय विपा गिरा महिक्षत्रावृतं बृहत्
11.1.e: Both boons,-may, Indra, hitherward turned, listen to this prayer of ours. And mightiest Maghavan with thought inclined to us come near to drink to Soma juice!

11.1.s: samrājā yā gʰr̥tayonī mitraścobʰā varuṇaśca devā deveṣu praśastā
11.1.d: सम्राजा या घृतयोनी मित्रश्चोभा वरुणश्च देवा देवेषु प्रशस्ता
11.1.e: For him, strong, independent ruler, Heaven and Earth have fashioned forth with power and might. Thou seatest thee as first among thy peers in place, for thy soul longs for Soma juice. XV Soma Pavamana

11.1.s: tā naḥ śaktaṃ partʰivasya maho rāyo divyasya mahi vāṃ kṣatraṃ deveṣu
11.1.d: ता नः शक्तं पर्थिवस्य महो रायो दिव्यस्य महि वां क्षत्रं देवेषु
11.1.e: God, working with mankind flow on; to Indra go thy gladdening juice: To Vayu mount as Law commands!

11.1.s: indrā yāhi citrabʰāno sutā ime tvāyavaḥ aṇvībʰistanā pūtāsaḥ
11.1.d: इन्द्रा याहि चित्रभानो सुता इमे त्वायवः अण्वीभिस्तना पूतासः
11.1.e: O Soma Pavamana, thou pourest out wealth that may be famed: O Indu, pass into the lake!

11.1.s: indrā yāhi dʰiyeṣito viprajūtaḥ sutāvataḥ upa brahmāṇi vāgʰataḥ
11.1.d: इन्द्रा याहि धियेषितो विप्रजूतः सुतावतः उप ब्रह्माणि वाघतः
11.1.e: Soma, thou flowest chasing foes, finder of wisdom and delight: Drive thou the godless folk afar! XVI Soma Pavamana

11.1.s: indrā yāhi tūtujāna upa brahmāṇi harivaḥ sute dadʰiṣva naścanaḥ
11.1.d: इन्द्रा याहि तूतुजान उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवः सुते दधिष्व नश्चनः
11.1.e: Stream on us riches that are craved by hundreds, best at winning spoil, Riches, O Indu, thousandfold, most splendid, that surpass the light!

11.1.s: tamīḍiṣva yo arciṣā vanā viśvā pariṣvajat kr̥ṣṇā kr̥ṇoti jihvayā
11.1.d: तमीडिष्व यो अर्चिषा वना विश्वा परिष्वजत् कृष्णा कृणोति जिह्वया
11.1.e: May we, O Vasu, be most near to this thy bounty, food, and wealth! Desired by many men, and in thy favour, O resistless one!

11.1.s: ya iddʰa āvivāsati sumnamindrasya martyaḥ dyumnāya sutarā apaḥ
11.1.d: य इद्ध आविवासति सुम्नमिन्द्रस्य मर्त्यः द्युम्नाय सुतरा अपः
11.1.e: Effused, this Indu hath flowed on, distilling rapture, to the fleece. He streams erect to sacrifice, as 'twere with splendour, seeking kine. XVII Soma Pavamana

11.1.s: tā no vājavatīriṣa āśūnpipr̥tamarvataḥ endramagniṃ ca voḍʰave
11.1.d: ता नो वाजवतीरिष आशून्पिपृतमर्वतः एन्द्रमग्निं च वोढवे
11.1.e: Flow onward, Soma, as a mighty sea, as Father of the Gods, to every form!

11.1.s: pro ayāsīdindurindrasya niṣkr̥tam̐ sakʰā sakʰyurna pra mināti saṅgiram marya iva yuvatibʰiḥ samarṣati somaḥ kalaśe śatayāmnā patʰā
11.1.d: प्रो अयासीदिन्दुरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतꣳ सखा सख्युर्न प्र मिनाति सङ्गिरम् मर्य इव युवतिभिः समर्षति सोमः कलशे शतयाम्ना पथा
11.1.e: Flow on, O Soma, radiant for the Gods, blissful to heaven and earth and living things!

11.1.s: pra vo dʰiyo mandrayuvo vipanyuvaḥ panasyuvaḥ saṃvaraṇeṣvakramuḥ hariṃ krīḍantamabʰyanūṣata stubʰo 'bʰi dʰenavaḥ payasedaśiśrayuḥ
11.1.d: प्र वो धियो मन्द्रयुवो विपन्युवः पनस्युवः संवरणेष्वक्रमुः हरिं क्रीडन्तमभ्यनूषत स्तुभो ऽभि धेनवः पयसेदशिश्रयुः
11.1.e: Thou art, bright juice, sustainer of the sky: flow, mighty, in accordance with true law! XVIII Agni I. I laud your most beloved guest, like a dear friend, O Agni, him! Who, like a chariot, wins us wealth.

11.1.s: ā naḥ soma saṃyataṃ pipyuṣīmiṣamindo pavasva pavamāna ūrmiṇā yā no dohate trirahannasaścuṣī kṣumadvājavanmadʰumatsuvīryam
11.1.d: आ नः सोम संयतं पिप्युषीमिषमिन्दो पवस्व पवमान ऊर्मिणा या नो दोहते त्रिरहन्नसश्चुषी क्षुमद्वाजवन्मधुमत्सुवीर्यम्
11.1.e: Whom as a Sage who merits praise the Gods have, from the olden time, Established among mortal men.

11.1.s: na kiṣṭaṃ karmaṇā naśadyaścakāra sadāvr̥dʰam indraṃ na yajñairviśvagūrttamr̥bʰvasamadʰr̥ṣṭaṃ dʰr̥ṣṇumojasā
11.1.d: न किष्टं कर्मणा नशद्यश्चकार सदावृधम् इन्द्रं न यज्ञैर्विश्वगूर्त्तमृभ्वसमधृष्टं धृष्णुमोजसा
11.1.e: Do thou, most youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs, And of thyself preserve their seed! XIX Indra

11.1.s: aṣāḍʰamugraṃ pr̥tanāsu sāsahiṃ yasminmahīrurujrayaḥ saṃ dʰenavo jāyamāne anonavurdyāvaḥ kṣāmīranonavuḥ
11.1.d: अषाढमुग्रं पृतनासु सासहिं यस्मिन्महीरुरुज्रयः सं धेनवो जायमाने अनोनवुर्द्यावः क्षामीरनोनवुः
11.1.e: Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable Wide as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of heaven.

11.1.s: sakʰāya ā ni ṣīdata punānāya pra gāyata śiśuṃ na yajñaiḥ pari bʰūṣata śriye
11.1.d: सखाय आ नि षीदत पुनानाय प्र गायत शिशुं न यज्ञैः परि भूषत श्रिये
11.1.e: O truthful Soma-drinker, thou art mightier than both the worlds. Thou strengthenest him who pours'libation, Lord of heaven.

11.1.s: samī vatsaṃ na mātr̥bʰiḥ sr̥jatā gayasādʰanam devāvyā3ṃ madamabʰi dviśavasam
11.1.d: समी वत्सं न मातृभिः सृजता गयसाधनम् देवाव्या३ं मदमभि द्विशवसम्
11.1.e: For thou art he, O Indra, who upholdeth all our fortresses, The Dasyu's slayer, man's sustainer, Lord of heaven. XX Indra

11.1.s: punātā dakṣasādʰanaṃ yatʰā śardʰāya vītaye yatʰā mitrāya varuṇāya śantamam
11.1.d: पुनाता दक्षसाधनं यथा शर्धाय वीतये यथा मित्राय वरुणाय शन्तमम्
11.1.e: Render of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born, Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much extolled,

11.1.s: pra vājyakṣāḥ sahasradʰārastiraḥ pavitraṃ vi vāramavyam
11.1.d: प्र वाज्यक्षाः सहस्रधारस्तिरः पवित्रं वि वारमव्यम्
11.1.e: Thou wielder of the stone, didst burst the cave of Vala rich in kine. The Gods came pressing to thy side, and free from terror aided thee.

11.2.s: sa vājyakṣāḥ sahasraretā adbʰirmr̥jāno gobʰiḥ śrīṇānaḥ
11.2.d: स वाज्यक्षाः सहस्ररेता अद्भिर्मृजानो गोभिः श्रीणानः
11.2.e: They glorified with hymns of praise Indra who reigneth by his might, Whose bounteous gifts in thousands come, yea, even more abundantly. I Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: pra soma yāhīndrasya kukṣā nr̥bʰiryemāno adribʰiḥ sutaḥ
11.2.d: प्र सोम याहीन्द्रस्य कुक्षा नृभिर्येमानो अद्रिभिः सुतः
11.2.e: Guard of all being, generating creatures, loud roared the sea as highest law commanded. Strong in the filter, on the fleecy summit, pressed from the stone, Soma hath waxen mighty.

11.2.s: ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire ye vādaḥ śaryaṇāvati
11.2.d: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे ये वादः शर्यणावति
11.2.e: Make Vayu glad, for furtherance and bounty: cheer Varuna and Mitra, as they cleanse thee! Gladden the Gods, gladden the host of Maruts: make Heaven and Earth rejoice, O God, O Soma!

11.2.s: ya ārjīkeṣu kr̥tvasu ye madʰye pastyānām ye vā janeṣu pañcasu
11.2.d: य आर्जीकेषु कृत्वसु ये मध्ये पस्त्यानाम् ये वा जनेषु पञ्चसु
11.2.e: Soma, the mighty, when, the water's offspring, he chose the Gods, performed that great achievement. He, Pavamana, granted strength to Indra: he, Indu, generated strength in Surya. II Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: te no vr̥ṣṭiṃ divaspari pavantāmā suvīryam svānā devāsa indavaḥ
11.2.d: ते नो वृष्टिं दिवस्परि पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् स्वाना देवास इन्दवः
11.2.e: Here present this immortal God flies, like a bird upon her wings, To settle in the vats of wood.

11.2.s: ā te vatso mano yamatparamāccitsadʰastʰāt agne tvāṃ kāmaye girā
11.2.d: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् अग्ने त्वां कामये गिरा
11.2.e: Praised by the sacred bards, this God dives into waters, and bestows Rich gifts upon the worshipper.

11.2.s: purutrā hi sadr̥ṅṅasi diśo viśvā anu prabʰuḥ samatsu tvā havāmahe
11.2.d: पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि दिशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः समत्सु त्वा हवामहे
11.2.e: He. like a warrior going forth with heroes, as he flows along. Is fain to win all precious boons.

11.2.s: samatsvagnimavase vājayanto havāmahe vājeṣu citrarādʰasam
11.2.d: समत्स्वग्निमवसे वाजयन्तो हवामहे वाजेषु चित्रराधसम्
11.2.e: This God as he is flowirig on speeds like a car and gives his aid: He lets his voice be heard of all.

11.2.s: tvaṃ na indrā bʰara ojo nr̥mṇam̐ śatakrato vicarṣaṇe ā vīraṃ pr̥tanāsaham
11.2.d: त्वं न इन्द्रा भर ओजो नृम्णꣳ शतक्रतो विचर्षणे आ वीरं पृतनासहम्
11.2.e: This God, while flowing, is adorned, gold-coloured, for the spoil, by men Devout and skilled in holy songs.

11.2.s: tvam̐ hi naḥ pitā vaso tvaṃ mātā śatakrato babʰūvitʰa atʰā te sumnamīmahe
11.2.d: त्वꣳ हि नः पिता वसो त्वं माता शतक्रतो बभूविथ अथा ते सुम्नमीमहे
11.2.e: This God, made ready with the hymn runs swiftly through the winding ways, Inviolable as he flows.

11.2.s: tvām̐ śuṣminpuruhūta vājayantamupa bruve sahaskr̥ta sa no rāsva suvīryam
11.2.d: त्वाꣳ शुष्मिन्पुरुहूत वाजयन्तमुप ब्रुवे सहस्कृत स नो रास्व सुवीर्यम्
11.2.e: A way he rushes with his stream, across the regions, into heaven, And roars as he is flowing on.

11.2.s: yadindra citra ma iha nāsti tvādātamadrivaḥ rādʰastanno vidadvasa ubʰayāhastyā bʰara
11.2.d: यदिन्द्र चित्र म इह नास्ति त्वादातमद्रिवः राधस्तन्नो विदद्वस उभयाहस्त्या भर
11.2.e: While flowing, meet for sacrifice, he hath gone up to heaven, across The regions, never overthrown.

11.2.s: yanmanyase vareṇyamindra dyukṣaṃ tadā bʰara vidyāma tasya te vayamakūpārasya dāvanaḥ
11.2.d: यन्मन्यसे वरेण्यमिन्द्र द्युक्षं तदा भर विद्याम तस्य ते वयमकूपारस्य दावनः
11.2.e: By generation long ago, this God, engendered for the Gods, Flows tawny to the straining-cloth.

11.2.s: yatte dikṣu prarādʰyaṃ mano asti śrutaṃ br̥hat tena dr̥ḍʰā cidadriva ā vājaṃ darṣi sātaye
11.2.d: यत्ते दिक्षु प्रराध्यं मनो अस्ति श्रुतं बृहत् तेन दृढा चिदद्रिव आ वाजं दर्षि सातये
11.2.e: This Lord of many holy laws, even at his birth engendering strength, Effused, flows onward in a stream. III Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: śiśuṃ jajñānam̐ haryataṃ mr̥janti śumbʰanti vipraṃ maruto gaṇena kavirgīrbʰiḥ kāvyenā kaviḥ santsomaḥ pavitramatyeti rebʰan
11.2.d: शिशुं जज्ञानꣳ हर्यतं मृजन्ति शुम्भन्ति विप्रं मरुतो गणेन कविर्गीर्भिः काव्येना कविः सन्त्सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन्
11.2.e: Through the fine fingers, with the song, this hero comes with rapid cars, Going to Indra's settled place.

11.2.s: r̥ṣimanā ya r̥ṣikr̥tsvarṣāḥ sahasranītʰaḥ padavīḥ kavīnām tr̥tīyaṃ dʰāma mahiṣaḥ siṣāsantsomo virājamanu rājati ṣṭup
11.2.d: ऋषिमना य ऋषिकृत्स्वर्षाः सहस्रनीथः पदवीः कवीनाम् तृतीयं धाम महिषः सिषासन्त्सोमो विराजमनु राजति ष्टुप्
11.2.e: In holy thought he ponders much for the great service of theGods, Where the immortals have their seat.

11.2.s: camūṣaccʰyenaḥ śakuno vibʰr̥tvā govindurdrapsa āyudʰāni bibʰrat apāmūrmim̐ sacamānaḥ samudraṃ turīyaṃ dʰāma mahiṣo vivakti
11.2.d: चमूषच्छ्येनः शकुनो विभृत्वा गोविन्दुर्द्रप्स आयुधानि बिभ्रत् अपामूर्मिꣳ सचमानः समुद्रं तुरीयं धाम महिषो विवक्ति
11.2.e: Men beautify him in the vats, him worthy to be beautified, Him who brings forth abundant food.

11.2.s: ete somā abʰi priyamindrasya kāmamakṣaran vardʰanto asya vīryam
11.2.d: एते सोमा अभि प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काममक्षरन् वर्धन्तो अस्य वीर्यम्
11.2.e: He is deposited and led along the consecrated path When zealous men are urging him,
He moves, a vigorous steed, adorned with beauteous rays of shining gold, He who is Sovran of the streams.

11.2.s: indrasya soma rādʰase punāno hārdi codaya devānāṃ yonimāsadam
11.2.d: इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे पुनानो हार्दि चोदय देवानां योनिमासदम्
11.2.e: He brandishes his horns on high, and whets them, bull who leads the herd, Doing with might heroic deeds.

11.2.s: mr̥janti tvā deśa kṣipo hinvanti sapta dʰītayaḥ anu viprā amādiṣuḥ
11.2.d: मृजन्ति त्वा देश क्षिपो हिन्वन्ति सप्त धीतयः अनु विप्रा अमादिषुः
11.2.e: He, over places rough to pass bringing rich treasures, closely pressed. Descends into the reservoirs.

11.2.s: devebʰyastvā madāya kam̐ sr̥jānamati meṣyaḥ sa gobʰirvāsayāmasi
11.2.d: देवेभ्यस्त्वा मदाय कꣳ सृजानमति मेष्यः स गोभिर्वासयामसि
11.2.e: Him, even him the golden-hued, well armed, best giver of delight, Ten fingers urge to run his course. IV Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: punānaḥ kalaśeṣvā vastrāṇyaruṣo hariḥ pari gavyānyavyata
11.2.d: पुनानः कलशेष्वा वस्त्राण्यरुषो हरिः परि गव्यान्यव्यत
11.2.e: This Bull, this chariot robes him in the sheep's long wool as heproceeds. To war that wins a thousand spoils.

11.2.s: magʰona ā pavasva no jahi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ indo sakʰāyamā viśa
11.2.d: मघोन आ पवस्व नो जहि विश्वा अप द्विषः इन्दो सखायमा विश
11.2.e: The dames of Trita with the stones urge forth this goldencoloured one, Indu to Indra for his drink.

11.2.s: nr̥cakṣasaṃ tvā vayamindrapītam̐ svarvidam bʰakṣīmahi prajāmiṣam
11.2.d: नृचक्षसं त्वा वयमिन्द्रपीतꣳ स्वर्विदम् भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषम्
11.2.e: He like a falcon settles down amid the families of men, Like lover speeding to his love.

11.2.s: vr̥ṣṭiṃ divaḥ pari srava dyumnaṃ pr̥tʰivyā adʰi saho naḥ soma pr̥tsu dʰāḥ
11.2.d: वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव द्युम्नं पृथिव्या अधि सहो नः सोम पृत्सु धाः
11.2.e: This young exhilarating juice looks downward from its place in heaven, This Soma drop that pierced the sieve.

11.2.s: somaḥ punāno arṣati sahasradʰāro atyaviḥ vāyorindrasya niṣkr̥tam
11.2.d: सोमः पुनानो अर्षति सहस्रधारो अत्यविः वायोरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम्
11.2.e: Pressed for the draught, this tawny juice flows forth intelligent, calling out, Unto the well-beloved place.

11.2.s: pavamānamavasyavo vipramabʰi pra gāyata suṣvāṇaṃ devavītaye
11.2.d: पवमानमवस्यवो विप्रमभि प्र गायत सुष्वाणं देववीतये
11.2.e: Him, here, the gold-decked skilful ten cleanse carefully, who make him bright. And beauteous for the gladdening draught. V Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: pavante vājasātaye somāḥ sahasrapājasaḥ gr̥ṇānā devavītaye
11.2.d: पवन्ते वाजसातये सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः गृणाना देववीतये
11.2.e: Urged by the men, this vigorous steed, Lord of the mind omniscient, Flies to the long wool of the sheep.

11.2.s: uta no vājasātaye pavasva br̥hatīriṣaḥ dyumadindo suvīryam
11.2.d: उत नो वाजसातये पवस्व बृहतीरिषः द्युमदिन्दो सुवीर्यम्
11.2.e: Within the filter hath he flowed, this Soma for the Gods effused. Entering all their essences.

11.2.s: atyā hiyānā na hetr̥bʰirasr̥graṃ vājasātaye vi vāramavyamāśavaḥ
11.2.d: अत्या हियाना न हेतृभिरसृग्रं वाजसातये वि वारमव्यमाशवः
11.2.e: He shines in beauty there, this God, immortal, in his dwellingplace, Foe-slayer, dearest to the Gods.

11.2.s: te naḥ sahasriṇam̐ rayiṃ pavantāmā suvīryam suvānā devāsa indavaḥ
11.2.d: ते नः सहस्रिणꣳ रयिं पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् सुवाना देवास इन्दवः
11.2.e: Directed by the sisters ten, bellowing on his way this Steer Runs onward to the wooden vats.

11.2.s: vāśrā arṣantīndavo 'bʰi vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ dadʰanvire gabʰastyoḥ
11.2.d: वाश्रा अर्षन्तीन्दवो ऽभि वत्सं न मातरः दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः
11.2.e: This Pavamana, gladdening drink within the purifying sieve, Gave splendour to the Sun in heaven.

11.2.s: juṣṭa indrāya matsaraḥ pavamāna kanikradat viśvā apa dviṣo jahi
11.2.d: जुष्ट इन्द्राय मत्सरः पवमान कनिक्रदत् विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि
11.2.e: Unconquerable Lord of speech, dwelling beside Viavasvan, he Mounts up together with the Sun. VI Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: apagʰnanto arāvṇaḥ pavamānāḥ svardr̥śaḥ yonāvr̥tasya sīdata
11.2.d: अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः पवमानाः स्वर्दृशः योनावृतस्य सीदत
11.2.e: This Sage, exalted by our lands, flows to the purifying sieve, Scattering foes as he is cleansed.

11.2.s: somā asr̥gramindavaḥ sutā r̥tasya dʰārayā indrāya madʰumattamāḥ
11.2.d: सोमा असृग्रमिन्दवः सुता ऋतस्य धारया इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमाः
11.2.e: Giver of strength, winner of light, for Indra and for Vayu he Is poured upon the filtering-cloth.

11.2.s: abʰi viprā anūṣata gāvo vatsaṃ na dʰenavaḥ indram̐ somasya pītaye
11.2.d: अभि विप्रा अनूषत गावो वत्सं न धेनवः इन्द्रꣳ सोमस्य पीतये
11.2.e: The men conduct him, Soma, Steer, omniscient the head of heaven. Effused into the vats of wood.

11.2.s: madacyutkṣeti sādane sindʰorūrmā vipaścit somo gaurī adʰi śritaḥ
11.2.d: मदच्युत्क्षेति सादने सिन्धोरूर्मा विपश्चित् सोमो गौरी अधि श्रितः
11.2.e: Longing for kine, longing for gold hath Indu Pavamana roared, Still conqueror, never overcome.

11.2.s: divo nābʰā vicakṣaṇo 'vyo vāre mahīyate somo yaḥ sukratuḥ kaviḥ
11.2.d: दिवो नाभा विचक्षणो ऽव्यो वारे महीयते सोमो यः सुक्रतुः कविः
11.2.e: To Indra in the firmament this mighty tawny Steer hath flowed This Indu, being purified.

11.2.s: yaḥ somaḥ kalaśeṣvā antaḥ pavitra āhitaḥ taminduḥ pari ṣasvaje
11.2.d: यः सोमः कलशेष्वा अन्तः पवित्र आहितः तमिन्दुः परि षस्वजे
11.2.e: This Soma being purified flows mighty and invincible, Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods. VII Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: pra vācaminduriṣyati samudrasyādʰi viṣṭapi jinvankośaṃ madʰuścutam
11.2.d: प्र वाचमिन्दुरिष्यति समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि जिन्वन्कोशं मधुश्चुतम्
11.2.e: This Soma, strong effused for draught, flows to the purifying sieve, Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.

11.2.s: nityastotro vanaspatirdʰenāmantaḥ sabardugʰām hinvāno mānuṣā yujā
11.2.d: नित्यस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिर्धेनामन्तः सबर्दुघाम् हिन्वानो मानुषा युजा
11.2.e: Far sighted, tawny-coloured, he flows to the sieve intelligent, Bellowing to his place of rest.

11.2.s: ā pavamāna dʰāraya rayim̐ sahasravarcasam asme indo svābʰuvam
11.2.d: आ पवमान धारय रयिꣳ सहस्रवर्चसम् अस्मे इन्दो स्वाभुवम्
11.2.e: This vigorous Pavamana runs forth to the luminous realm of heaven, Fiend-slayer, through the sheep's long wool.

11.2.s: abʰi priyā divaḥ kavirvipraḥ sa dʰārayā sutaḥ somo hinve parāvati
11.2.d: अभि प्रिया दिवः कविर्विप्रः स धारया सुतः सोमो हिन्वे परावति
11.2.e: This Pavamana, up above on Trita's ridge, hath made the Sun, Together with the Sisters, shine.

11.2.s: utte śuṣmāsa īrate sindʰorūrmeriva svanaḥ vāṇasya codayā pavim
11.2.d: उत्ते शुष्मास ईरते सिन्धोरूर्मेरिव स्वनः वाणस्य चोदया पविम्
11.2.e: Effused, this Soma, Steer, who slays Vritra, room-giver, unbeguiled, Hath gone as 'twere to win the spoil.

11.2.s: prasave ta udīrate tisro vāco makʰasyuvaḥ yadavya eṣi sānavi
11.2.d: प्रसवे त उदीरते तिस्रो वाचो मखस्युवः यदव्य एषि सानवि
11.2.e: Urged by the sage upon his way, this God speeds forward to the: vats, Indu to Indra, giving boons. VIII Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: avyā vāraiḥ pari priyam̐ harim̐ hinvantyadribʰiḥ pavamānaṃ madʰuścutam
11.2.d: अव्या वारैः परि प्रियꣳ हरिꣳ हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः पवमानं मधुश्चुतम्
11.2.e: The man who reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamana hymns, Tastes food completely purified, made sweet by Matarisvan's touch.

11.2.s: ā pavasva madintama pavitraṃ dʰārayā kave arkasya yonimāsadam
11.2.d: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे अर्कस्य योनिमासदम्
11.2.e: Whoever reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamana hymns, For him Sarasvat! pours forth water and butter, milk and meath.

11.2.s: sa pavasva madintama gobʰirañjāno aktubʰiḥ endrasya jaṭʰaraṃ viśa
11.2.d: स पवस्व मदिन्तम गोभिरञ्जानो अक्तुभिः एन्द्रस्य जठरं विश
11.2.e: Yea, for the Pavamanas flow richly, drop fatness, bring us weal,-- Amrit deposited among the Brahmans, essence stored by saints.

11.2.s: ayā vītī pari srava yasta indo madeṣvā avāhannavatīrnava
11.2.d: अया वीती परि स्रव यस्त इन्दो मदेष्वा अवाहन्नवतीर्नव
11.2.e: So may the Pavamana hymns bestow on us this world and that, And gratify our hearts' desires'-the Goddesses combined with Gods!
The purifying flood wherewith Gods ever purify themselves,-- With that, in thousand currents, may the Pavamanas make us clean!

11.2.s: puraḥ sadya ittʰādʰiye divodāsāya śaṃbaram adʰa tyaṃ turvaśaṃ yadum 121clsdir pari no aśvamaśvavidgomadindo hiraṇyavat kṣarā sahasriṇīriṣaḥ
11.2.d: पुरः सद्य इत्थाधिये दिवोदासाय शंबरम् अध त्यं तुर्वशं यदुम् १२१च्ल्स्दिर् परि नो अश्वमश्वविद्गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् क्षरा सहस्रिणीरिषः
11.2.e: The Pavamana hymns bring weal: by these man goes to Paradise, And, eating pure and holy food, attains to immortality. IX Agni

11.2.s: apagʰnanpavate mr̥dʰo 'pa somo arāvṇaḥ gaccʰannindrasya niṣkr̥tam
11.2.d: अपघ्नन्पवते मृधो ऽप सोमो अराव्णः गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम्
11.2.e: We with great reverence have approached the Youngest, who hath shone forth well kindled in his dwelling, Wondrously bright between wide earth and heaven, well worshipped, looking forth in all directions.

11.2.s: maho no rāya ā bʰara pavamāna jahī mr̥dʰaḥ rāsvendo vīravadyaśaḥ
11.2.d: महो नो राय आ भर पवमान जही मृधः रास्वेन्दो वीरवद्यशः
11.2.e: Through his great might o'ercoming all misfortunes, praised in the house is Agni Jatavedas. May he preserve us from disgrace and trouble, both us who laud him and our wealthy princes!

11.2.s: na tvā śataṃ ca na hruto rādʰo ditsantamā minan yatpunāno makʰasyase
11.2.d: न त्वा शतं च न ह्रुतो राधो दित्सन्तमा मिनन् यत्पुनानो मखस्यसे
11.2.e: O Agni, thou art Varuna and Mitra: Vasishthas! with their holy hymns exalt thee. With thee be most abundant gain of treasure! Do ye preserve us evermore with blessing! X Indra

11.2.s: ayā pavasva dʰārayā yayā sūryamarocayaḥ hinvāno mānuṣīrapaḥ
11.2.d: अया पवस्व धारया यया सूर्यमरोचयः हिन्वानो मानुषीरपः
11.2.e: Indra, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich in rain. Hath been increased by Vatsa's lauds.

11.2.s: ayukta sūra etaśaṃ pavamāno manāvadʰi antarikṣeṇa yātave
11.2.d: अयुक्त सूर एतशं पवमानो मनावधि अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे
11.2.e: Since Kanvas have with lauds made him completer of the sacrifice, Words are their own appropriate arms.

11.2.s: uta tyā harito ratʰe sūro ayukta yātave indurindra iti bruvan
11.2.d: उत त्या हरितो रथे सूरो अयुक्त यातवे इन्दुरिन्द्र इति ब्रुवन्
11.2.e: When priests who magnify the Son of holy law present their gifts, Sages with Order's hymn of praise. XI Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: agniṃ vo devamagnibʰiḥ sajoṣā yajiṣṭʰaṃ dūtamadʰvare kr̥ṇudʰvam yo martyeṣu nidʰruvirr̥tāvā tapurmūrdʰā gʰr̥tānnaḥ pāvakaḥ
11.2.d: अग्निं वो देवमग्निभिः सजोषा यजिष्ठं दूतमध्वरे कृणुध्वम् यो मर्त्येषु निध्रुविरृतावा तपुर्मूर्धा घृतान्नः पावकः
11.2.e: Of gold-hued Pavamana, great destroyer, radiant streams have flowed, Swift streams of him whose gleams are swift.

11.2.s: protʰadaśvo na yavase 'viṣyanyadā mahaḥ saṃvaraṇādvyastʰāt ādasya vāto anu vāti śociradʰa sma te vrajanaṃ kr̥ṣṇamasti
11.2.d: प्रोथदश्वो न यवसे ऽविष्यन्यदा महः संवरणाद्व्यस्थात् आदस्य वातो अनु वाति शोचिरध स्म ते व्रजनं कृष्णमस्ति
11.2.e: Best rider of the chariot, praised with fairest praise 'mid beauteous ones, Gold gleaming with the Marut host,

11.2.s: udyasya te navajātasya vr̥ṣṇo 'gne carantyajarā idʰānāḥ accʰā dyāmaruṣo dʰūma eṣi saṃ dūto agna īyase hi devān
11.2.d: उद्यस्य ते नवजातस्य वृष्णो ऽग्ने चरन्त्यजरा इधानाः अच्छा द्यामरुषो धूम एषि सं दूतो अग्न ईयसे हि देवान्
11.2.e: Penetrate, Pavamana, best at winning booty, with thy rays, Giving the Singer hero strength! XII Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: tamindraṃ vājayāmasi mahe vr̥trāya hantave sa vr̥ṣā vr̥ṣabʰo bʰuvat
11.2.d: तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे स वृषा वृषभो भुवत्
11.2.e: Hence sprinkle forth the juice effused, Soma, the best of sacred gifts, Who, friend of man, hath run among the water-streams He hath pressed Soma out with stones.

11.2.s: indraḥ sa dāmane kr̥ta ojiṣṭʰaḥ sa bale hitaḥ dyumnī ślokī sa somyaḥ
11.2.d: इन्द्रः स दामने कृत ओजिष्ठः स बले हितः द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सोम्यः
11.2.e: Now, being purified, flow hither through the fleece, invincible and more odorous! We joy in thee in waters when thou art effused, blending thee still with juice and milk.

11.2.s: girā vajro na sambʰr̥taḥ sabalo anapacyutaḥ vavakṣa ugro astr̥taḥ
11.2.d: गिरा वज्रो न सम्भृतः सबलो अनपच्युतः ववक्ष उग्रो अस्तृतः
11.2.e: Pressed out for all to see, delighting Gods, Indu, far-seeing one, is mental power. XIII Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: adʰvaryo adribʰiḥ sutam̐ somaṃ pavitra ā naya punāhīndrāya pātave
11.2.d: अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतꣳ सोमं पवित्र आ नय पुनाहीन्द्राय पातवे
11.2.e: Even as a King hath Soma, red and tawny Bull, been pressed the wondrous one hath bellowed to the kine. While purified thou passest through the filtering fleece to seat thee hawk-like in the place that drops with oil.

11.2.s: tava tya indo andʰaso devā madʰorvyāśata pavamānasya marutaḥ
11.2.d: तव त्य इन्दो अन्धसो देवा मधोर्व्याशत पवमानस्य मरुतः
11.2.e: Parjanya is the sire of the leaf-bearing Bull: on mountains, in earth's centre hath he made his home. The waters have flowed forth, the Sisters, to the kine: he meets the pressing-stones at the beloved rite.

11.2.s: divaḥ pīyūṣamuttamam̐ somamindrāya vajriṇe sunotā madʰumattamam
11.2.d: दिवः पीयूषमुत्तमꣳ सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे सुनोता मधुमत्तमम्
11.2.e: To glory goest thou, a Sage with ordering skill, like a groomed steed thou rushest forward to the prize. Be gracious to us, Soma, driving off distress! Thou goest, clothed in butter, to a robe of state. XIV Indra

11.2.s: dʰarttā divaḥ pavate kr̥tvyo raso dakṣo devānāmanumādyo nr̥bʰiḥ hariḥ sr̥jāno atyo na satvabʰirvr̥tʰā pājām̐si kr̥ṇuṣe nadīṣvā
11.2.d: धर्त्ता दिवः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो दक्षो देवानामनुमाद्यो नृभिः हरिः सृजानो अत्यो न सत्वभिर्वृथा पाजाꣳसि कृणुषे नदीष्वा
11.2.e: Turning as 'twere to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things! When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

11.2.s: śūro na dʰatta āyudʰā gabʰastyoḥ svā3ḥ siṣāsanratʰiro gaviṣṭiṣu indrasya śuṣmamīrayannapasyubʰirindurhinvāno ajyate manīṣibʰiḥ
11.2.d: शूरो न धत्त आयुधा गभस्त्योः स्वा३ः सिषासन्रथिरो गविष्टिषु इन्द्रस्य शुष्ममीरयन्नपस्युभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते मनीषिभिः
11.2.e: Praise him who sends us wealth, prompt with his liberal boons Good 4re the gifts that Indra gives. He is not wroth with one who satisfies his wish: he instigates, his mind to give. XV Indra

11.2.s: indrasya soma pavamāna ūrmiṇā taviṣyamāṇo jaṭʰareṣvā viśa pra naḥ pinva vidyudabʰreva rodasī dʰiyā no vājām̐ upa māhi śaśvataḥ
11.2.d: इन्द्रस्य सोम पवमान ऊर्मिणा तविष्यमाणो जठरेष्वा विश प्र नः पिन्व विद्युदभ्रेव रोदसी धिया नो वाजाꣳ उप माहि शश्वतः
11.2.e: Indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid Help us, O Maghavan, let thy favour aid us thus drive away foes and enemies!

11.2.s: yadindra prāgapāgudaṅnyagvā hūyase nr̥bʰiḥ simā purū nr̥ṣūto asyānave 'si praśardʰa turvaśe
11.2.d: यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवे ऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे
11.2.e: For thou, O liberal Lord of ample bounty, art the ruler of our house and home. So, Indra Maghavan, thou lover of the song, we with pressed Soma call on thee. XVI Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: yadvā rume ruśame śyāvake kr̥pa indra mādayase sacā kaṇvāsastvā stomebʰirbrahmavāhasa indrā yaccʰantyā gahi
11.2.d: यद्वा रुमे रुशमे श्यावके कृप इन्द्र मादयसे सचा कण्वासस्त्वा स्तोमेभिर्ब्रह्मवाहस इन्द्रा यच्छन्त्या गहि
11.2.e: Thou, Soma, hast a running stream, sweet-toned most strong at sacrifice: Flow bounteously bestowing wealth

11.2.s: ubʰayam̐ śr̥ṇavacca na indro arvāgidaṃ vacaḥ satrācyā magʰavāntsomapītaye dʰiyā śaviṣṭʰa ā gamat
11.2.d: उभयꣳ शृणवच्च न इन्द्रो अर्वागिदं वचः सत्राच्या मघवान्त्सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत्
11.2.e: Thou most delightful, when effused, running, the best of gladdeners, art Indu, still conquering, ne'er subdued.

11.2.s: tam̐ hi svarājaṃ vr̥ṣabʰaṃ tamojasā dʰiṣaṇe niṣṭatakṣatuḥ utopamānāṃ pratʰamo ni ṣīdasi somakāmam̐ hi te manaḥ
11.2.d: तꣳ हि स्वराजं वृषभं तमोजसा धिषणे निष्टतक्षतुः उतोपमानां प्रथमो नि षीदसि सोमकामꣳ हि ते मनः
11.2.e: Do thou, poured forth by pressing- stones, flow hither uttering a roar, And bring us brightly-glorious strength! XVII Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: pavasva deva āyuṣagindraṃ gaccʰatu te madaḥ vāyumā roha dʰarmaṇā
11.2.d: पवस्व देव आयुषगिन्द्रं गच्छतु ते मदः वायुमा रोह धर्मणा
11.2.e: In might, O Indu, with thy streams flow for the banquet of the Gods: Rich in meath, Soma, in our beaker take thy seat!

11.2.s: pavamāna ni tośase rayim̐ soma śravāyyam indo samudramā viśa
11.2.d: पवमान नि तोशसे रयिꣳ सोम श्रवाय्यम् इन्दो समुद्रमा विश
11.2.e: Thy drops that swim in water have exalted Indra to delight The Gods have drunk thee up for immortality.

11.2.s: apagʰnanpavase mr̥dʰaḥ kratuvitsoma matsaraḥ nudasvādevayuṃ janam
11.2.d: अपघ्नन्पवसे मृधः क्रतुवित्सोम मत्सरः नुदस्वादेवयुं जनम्
11.2.e: Stream opulence to us, ye drops of Soma, pressed and purified Pouring down rain from heaven in floods, and finding light! XVIII Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: abʰī no vājasātamam̐ rayimarṣa śataspr̥ham indo sahasrabʰarṇasaṃ tuvidyumnaṃ vibʰāsaham
11.2.d: अभी नो वाजसातमꣳ रयिमर्ष शतस्पृहम् इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसं तुविद्युम्नं विभासहम्
11.2.e: Him with the fleece they purify, brown, golden-hued beloved of all, Who with exhilarating juice goes forth to all the deities

11.2.s: vayaṃ te asya rādʰaso vasorvaso puruspr̥haḥ ni nediṣṭʰatamā iṣaḥ syāma sumne te ādʰrigo
11.2.d: वयं ते अस्य राधसो वसोर्वसो पुरुस्पृहः नि नेदिष्ठतमा इषः स्याम सुम्ने ते आध्रिगो
11.2.e: Whom, bright with native splendour, crushed between the preesing-stones, a friend. Whom Indra dearly loves, the waves and ten companions dip and bathe

11.2.s: pari sya svāno akṣaridinduravye madacyutaḥ dʰārā ya ūrdʰvo adʰvare bʰrājā na yāti gavyayuḥ
11.2.d: परि स्य स्वानो अक्षरिदिन्दुरव्ये मदच्युतः धारा य ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरे भ्राजा न याति गव्ययुः
11.2.e: For Vritra-slaying Indra, thou, Soma, art poured that he may drink, And for the guerdon-giving man, the hero sitting in his seat. XIX Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: pavasva soma mahāntsamudraḥ pitā devānāṃ viśvābʰi dʰāma
11.2.d: पवस्व सोम महान्त्समुद्रः पिता देवानां विश्वाभि धाम
11.2.e: Flow onward Soma, flow for mighty strength, as a strong courser, bathed, to win the prize.

11.2.s: śukraḥ pavasva devebʰyaḥ soma dive pr̥tʰivyai śaṃ ca prajābʰyaḥ
11.2.d: शुक्रः पवस्व देवेभ्यः सोम दिवे पृथिव्यै शं च प्रजाभ्यः
11.2.e: The pressers clarify this juice of thine, the Soma for delight and lofty fame.

11.2.s: divo dʰarttāsi śukraḥ pīyūṣaḥ satye vidʰarmanvājī pavasva
11.2.d: दिवो धर्त्तासि शुक्रः पीयूषः सत्ये विधर्मन्वाजी पवस्व
11.2.e: They deck the gold-hued infant, newly-born, even Soma, Indu, in the sieve, for Gods. XX Soma Pavamana

11.2.s: preṣṭʰaṃ vo atirtʰim̐ stuṣe mitramiva priyam agne ratʰaṃ na vedyam
11.2.d: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिर्थिꣳ स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियम् अग्ने रथं न वेद्यम्
11.2.e: The Gods have come to Indu well-descended, beautified with milk, The active crusher of the foe.

11.2.s: kavimiva praśam̐syaṃ yaṃ devāsa iti dvitā ni martyeṣvādadʰuḥ
11.2.d: कविमिव प्रशꣳस्यं यं देवास इति द्विता नि मर्त्येष्वादधुः
11.2.e: Even as mother cows their calf, so let our praise-songs strengthen him, Yea, him who winneth Indra's heart!

11.2.s: tvaṃ yaviṣṭʰa dāśuṣo nr̥̄m̐pāhi śr̥ṇuhī giraḥ rakṣā tokamuta tmanā
11.2.d: त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄꣳपाहि शृणुही गिरः रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना
11.2.e: Soma, pour blessings on our kine, pour forth the food that streams with milk: Increase the sea, praiseworthy one! XXI Indra

11.2.s: endra no gadʰi priya satrājidagohya girirna viśvataḥ pr̥tʰuḥ patirdivaḥ
11.2.d: एन्द्र नो गधि प्रिय सत्राजिदगोह्य गिरिर्न विश्वतः पृथुः पतिर्दिवः
11.2.e: Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway trim the sacred grass, Whose friend is Indra ever young.

11.2.s: abʰi hi satya somapā ubʰe babʰūtʰa rodasī indrāsi sunvato vr̥dʰaḥ patirdivaḥ
11.2.d: अभि हि सत्य सोमपा उभे बभूथ रोदसी इन्द्रासि सुन्वतो वृधः पतिर्दिवः
11.2.e: Large is their fuel, much their laud, wide is their splinter from the stake, Whose friend is Indra ever young.

11.2.s: tvam̐ hi śaśvatīnāmindra dʰarttā purāmasi hantā dasyormanorvr̥dʰaḥ patirdivaḥ
11.2.d: त्वꣳ हि शश्वतीनामिन्द्र धर्त्ता पुरामसि हन्ता दस्योर्मनोर्वृधः पतिर्दिवः
11.2.e: Unquelled in fight the hero leads his army with the warrior chiefs, Whose friend is Indra ever young. XXII Indra

11.2.s: purāṃ bʰinduryuvā kaviramitaujā ajāyata indro viśvasya karmaṇo dʰarttā vajrī puruṣṭutaḥ
11.2.d: पुरां भिन्दुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत इन्द्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्त्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः
11.2.e: He who alone bestoweth wealth on mortal man who offereth gifts, Is Indra only, potent Lord whom none resist.

11.2.s: tvaṃ valasya gomato 'pāvaradrivo bilam tvāṃ devā abibʰyuṣastujyamānāsa āviṣuḥ
11.2.d: त्वं वलस्य गोमतो ऽपावरद्रिवो बिलम् त्वां देवा अबिभ्युषस्तुज्यमानास आविषुः
11.2.e: Whoever with the Soma pressed draws thee away from many men,- Verily Indra gains thereby tremendous power.

11.2.s: indramīśānamojasābʰi stomairanūṣata sahasraṃ yasya rātaya uta vā santi bʰūyasīḥ
11.2.d: इन्द्रमीशानमोजसाभि स्तोमैरनूषत सहस्रं यस्य रातय उत वा सन्ति भूयसीः
11.2.e: When willhe trample, like a weed, the man who hath no gift for him? When, verily, will Indra hear our songs of praise? XXIII Indra

11.2.s: akrāntsamudraḥ pratʰame vidʰarmaṃ janayanprajā bʰuvanasya gopāḥ vr̥ṣā pavitre adʰi sāno avye br̥hatsomo vāvr̥dʰe svāno adriḥ
11.2.d: अक्रान्त्समुद्रः प्रथमे विधर्मं जनयन्प्रजा भुवनस्य गोपाः वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्ये बृहत्सोमो वावृधे स्वानो अद्रिः
11.2.e: The singers hymn thee, they who chant the psalm of praise are lauding thee. The Brahmans have exalted thee, O Satakratu, like a pole. 2, When thou wast climbing ridge from ridge, he looked upon the toilsome task: Indra takes notice of that wish, and the Ram hastens with his troop.

12.1.s: matsi vāyumiṣṭaye rādʰase ca matsi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ matsi śardʰo mārutaṃ matsi devānmatsi dyāvāpr̥tʰivī deva soma
12.1.d: मत्सि वायुमिष्टये राधसे च मत्सि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान्मत्सि द्यावापृथिवी देव सोम
12.1.e: Harness thy pair of strong bay steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths. And, Indra, Soma drinker, come to listen to our songs Of praise! I Agni

12.1.s: mahattatsomo mahiṣaścakārāpāṃ yadgarbʰo 'vr̥ṇīta devān adadʰādindre pavamāna ojo 'janayatsūrye jyotirinduḥ
12.1.d: महत्तत्सोमो महिषश्चकारापां यद्गर्भो ऽवृणीत देवान् अदधादिन्द्रे पवमान ओजो ऽजनयत्सूर्ये ज्योतिरिन्दुः
12.1.e: Agni,well kindled bring the Gods for him who offers holy gifts; And worship them, pure Hotar-priest!

12.1.s: eṣa devo amartyaḥ parṇavīriva dīyate abʰi droṇānyāsadam
12.1.d: एष देवो अमर्त्यः पर्णवीरिव दीयते अभि द्रोणान्यासदम्
12.1.e: O Sage, Tanunapat, present our sacrifice to Gods to-day, Sweet to the taste, that they may help!

12.1.s: eṣa viprairabʰiṣṭuto 'po devo vi gāhate dadʰadratnāni dāśuṣe
12.1.d: एष विप्रैरभिष्टुतो ऽपो देवो वि गाहते दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे
12.1.e: Dear Narasansa, sweet of tongue, presenter of oblations, I Invoke to this our sacrifice.

12.1.s: eṣa viśvāni vāryā śūro yanniva satvabʰiḥ pavamānaḥ siṣāsati
12.1.d: एष विश्वानि वार्या शूरो यन्निव सत्वभिः पवमानः सिषासति
12.1.e: Agni, on thy most easy car, entreated, hither bring the Gods! Manus-appointed Priest art thou. II Adityas

12.1.s: eṣa devo ratʰaryati pavamāno diśasyati āviṣkr̥ṇoti vagvanum
12.1.d: एष देवो रथर्यति पवमानो दिशस्यति आविष्कृणोति वग्वनुम्
12.1.e: So when the Sun hath risen to-day may sinless Mitra, Aryaman, Bhaga, and Savitar send us forth!

12.1.s: eṣa devo vipanyubʰiḥ pavamāna r̥tāyubʰiḥ harirvājāya mr̥jyate
12.1.d: एष देवो विपन्युभिः पवमान ऋतायुभिः हरिर्वाजाय मृज्यते
12.1.e: May this our home be guarded well: forward, ye bounteous, on the way, Who bear us safely o'er distress!

12.1.s: eṣa devo vipā kr̥to 'ti hvarām̐si dʰāvati pavamāno adābʰyaḥ
12.1.d: एष देवो विपा कृतो ऽति ह्वराꣳसि धावति पवमानो अदाभ्यः
12.1.e: Yea, Aditi, and those great Kings whose statute is inviolate, Are sovrans of a vast domain. III Indra

12.1.s: eṣa divaṃ vi dʰāvati tiro rajām̐si dʰārayā pavamānaḥ kanikradat
12.1.d: एष दिवं वि धावति तिरो रजाꣳसि धारया पवमानः कनिक्रदत्
12.1.e: Let Soma juices make thee glad! Display thy bounty, Thunderer: Drive off the enemies of prayer!

12.1.s: eṣa divaṃ vyāsarattiro rajām̐syaspr̥taḥ pavamānaḥ svadʰvaraḥ
12.1.d: एष दिवं व्यासरत्तिरो रजाꣳस्यस्पृतः पवमानः स्वध्वरः
12.1.e: Crush with thy foot the niggard churls who bring no gifts! mighty art thou: There is not one to equal thee.

12.1.s: eṣa pratnena janmanā devo devebʰyaḥ sutaḥ hariḥ pavitre arṣati
12.1.d: एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः हरिः पवित्रे अर्षति
12.1.e: Thou art the Lord of Somas pressed, Somas unpressed are also thine: Thou art the Sovran of the folk. IV Soma Pavamana

12.1.s: eṣa u sya puruvrato jajñāno janayanniṣaḥ dʰārayā pavate sutaḥ
12.1.d: एष उ स्य पुरुव्रतो जज्ञानो जनयन्निषः धारया पवते सुतः
12.1.e: True object of our hymns, Sage, watchful Soma hath settled in the press as they refine him. Him the Adhvaryus, paired and eager, follow, leaders of sacrifice and skilful-handed.

12.1.s: eṣa dʰiyā yātyaṇvya śūro ratʰebʰirāśubʰiḥ gaccʰannindrasya niṣkr̥tam
12.1.d: एष धिया यात्यण्व्य शूरो रथेभिराशुभिः गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम्
12.1.e: He, purified and bringing gifts to Surya, hath filled full heaven and earth, and hath disclosed them. He by whose dear help heroes gain their wishes will yield the precious meed as to a victor.

12.1.s: eṣa purū dʰiyāyate br̥hate devatātaye yatrāmr̥tāsa āśata
12.1.d: एष पुरू धियायते बृहते देवतातये यत्रामृतास आशत
12.1.e: He, being cleansed, the strengthener and increaser, bountiful Soma helped us his lustre, Wherein our sires of old who knew the footsteps found light and sought the kine within the mountain. V Indra

12.1.s: etaṃ mr̥janti marjyamupa droṇeṣvāyavaḥ pracakrāṇaṃ mahīriṣaḥ
12.1.d: एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यमुप द्रोणेष्वायवः प्रचक्राणं महीरिषः
12.1.e: Glorify naught besides, O friends, so shall no sorrow trouble you! Praise only mighty Indra, when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly!

12.1.s: eṣa hito vi nīyate 'ntaḥ śundʰyāvatā patʰā yadī tuñjanti bʰūrṇayaḥ
12.1.d: एष हितो वि नीयते ऽन्तः शुन्ध्यावता पथा यदी तुञ्जन्ति भूर्णयः
12.1.e: Even him, the swift one, like a bull who rushes down men's conqueror, bounteous like a cow; Him who is cause of both, of enmity and peace, to both sides most munificent. VI Indra

12.1.s: eṣa rukmibʰirīyate vāji śubʰrebʰiram̐śubʰiḥ patiḥ sindʰūnāṃ bʰavan
12.1.d: एष रुक्मिभिरीयते वाजि शुभ्रेभिरꣳशुभिः पतिः सिन्धूनां भवन्
12.1.e: These songs of our exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength, gain wealth and give unfailing help.

12.1.s: eṣa śr̥ṅgāṇi dodʰuvaccʰiśīte yūtʰyo3 vr̥ṣā nr̥mṇā dadʰāna ojasā
12.1.d: एष शृङ्गाणि दोधुवच्छिशीते यूथ्यो३ वृषा नृम्णा दधान ओजसा
12.1.e: The Bhrigus are like suns, like Kanvas, and have gained each thing whereon their thought was bent. The living men of Priyamedha's race have sun g exalting Indra with their lauds. VII Soma Pavamana

12.1.s: eṣa vasūni pibdanaḥ paruṣā yayivām̐ ati ava śādeṣu gaccʰati
12.1.d: एष वसूनि पिब्दनः परुषा ययिवाꣳ अति अव शादेषु गच्छति
12.1.e: Run forth to battle conquering the Vritras! thou Speedest to quell the foe like one exacting debts.

12.1.s: etamu tyaṃ daśa kṣipo harim̐ hivanti yātave svāyudʰaṃ madintamam
12.1.d: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो हरिꣳ हिवन्ति यातवे स्वायुधं मदिन्तमम्
12.1.e: Thou Pavamana, didst beget the Sun with might, and rain in the supporting sky, Hasting to us with plenty vivified with milk.

12.1.s: eṣa u sya vr̥ṣā ratʰo 'vyā vārebʰiravyata gaccʰanvājam̐ sahasriṇam
12.1.d: एष उ स्य वृषा रथो ऽव्या वारेभिरव्यत गच्छन्वाजꣳ सहस्रिणम्
12.1.e: For, Soma, we rejoice ourselves in thee effused for great supremacy in fight; Thou, Pavamana, enterest into mighty deeds. VIII Soma Pavamana

12.1.s: etaṃ tritasya yoṣaṇo harim̐ hinvantyadribʰiḥ indumindrāya pītaye
12.1.d: एतं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिꣳ हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये
12.1.e: Flow forth, O Soma, flow thou onward, sweet to Indra's, Mitra's, Pushan's, Bhaga's taste!

12.1.s: eṣa sya mānuṣīṣvā śyeno na vikṣu sīdati gaccʰaṃ jāro na yoṣitam
12.1.d: एष स्य मानुषीष्वा श्येनो न विक्षु सीदति गच्छं जारो न योषितम्
12.1.e: So flow thou on as bright celestial juice, flow to the vast immortal dwelling-place!

12.1.s: eṣa sya madyo raso 'va caṣṭe divaḥ śiśuḥ ya indurvāramāviśat
12.1.d: एष स्य मद्यो रसो ऽव चष्टे दिवः शिशुः य इन्दुर्वारमाविशत्
12.1.e: Let Indra drink, O Soma, of thy juice for wisdom, and all deities for strength! IX Soma Pavamana

12.1.s: eṣa sya pītaye suto harirarṣati dʰarṇasiḥ krandanyonimabʰi priyam
12.1.d: एष स्य पीतये सुतो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः क्रन्दन्योनिमभि प्रियम्
12.1.e: Even as the beams of Surya, urging men to speed, they issue forth together, gladdening as they flow, These swift outpourings in long course of holy rites: no form save only Indra shows itself so pure.

12.1.s: etaṃ tyam̐ harito daśa marmr̥jyante apasyuvaḥ yābʰirmadāya śumbʰate
12.1.d: एतं त्यꣳ हरितो दश मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः याभिर्मदाय शुम्भते
12.1.e: The thought is deeply fixed, the savoury juice is shed; the tongue with joyous sound is stirring in the mouth: And Pavamana, like the shout of those who press, the drop, rich in sweet juice, is flowing through the fleece.

12.1.s: eṣa vājī hito nr̥bʰirviśvavinmanasaspatiḥ avyo vāraṃ vi dʰāvati
12.1.d: एष वाजी हितो नृभिर्विश्वविन्मनसस्पतिः अव्यो वारं वि धावति
12.1.e: The bull is bellowing; the cows are coming nigh: the Goddesses approach the God's own resting-place. Onward hath Soma pressed through the sheep's fair bright fleece, and hath, as 'twere, endued a garment newly washed. X Agni

12.1.s: eṣa pavitre akṣaratsomo devebʰyaḥ sutaḥ viśvā dʰāmānyāviśan
12.1.d: एष पवित्रे अक्षरत्सोमो देवेभ्यः सुतः विश्वा धामान्याविशन्
12.1.e: From the two fire-sticks have the men engendered, with thought, urged by the hand, the glorious Agni, Far-seen, with pointed flame, Lord of the Homestead.

12.1.s: eṣa devaḥ śubʰāyate 'dʰi yonāvamartyaḥ vr̥trahā devavītamaḥ
12.1.d: एष देवः शुभायते ऽधि योनावमर्त्यः वृत्रहा देववीतमः
12.1.e: The Vasus set that Agni in the dwelling, fair to behold, for help, from every quarter: Who, in the house for ever, must be honoured.

12.1.s: eṣa vr̥ṣā kanikradaddaśabʰirjāmibʰiryataḥ abʰi droṇāni dʰāvati
12.1.d: एष वृषा कनिक्रदद्दशभिर्जामिभिर्यतः अभि द्रोणानि धावति
12.1.e: Shine thou before us, Agni, well-enkindled, with flame, most youthful God, that never fadeth! To thee come goods and treasures all together. XI Surya

12.1.s: eṣa sūryamarocayatpavamāno adʰi dyavi pavitre matsaro madaḥ
12.1.d: एष सूर्यमरोचयत्पवमानो अधि द्यवि पवित्रे मत्सरो मदः
12.1.e: This spotted Bull hath come and sat before the mother in the east, Advancing to his father heaven.

12.1.s: eṣa sūryeṇa hāsate saṃvasāno vivasvatā patirvāco adābʰyaḥ
12.1.d: एष सूर्येण हासते संवसानो विवस्वता पतिर्वाचो अदाभ्यः
12.1.e: As expiration from his breath, his radiance penetrates within The Bull shines out through all the sky.

12.2.s: eṣa kavirabʰiṣṭutaḥ pavitre adʰi tośate punāno gʰnannapa dviṣaḥ
12.2.d: एष कविरभिष्टुतः पवित्रे अधि तोशते पुनानो घ्नन्नप द्विषः
12.2.e: Song is bestowed upon the Bird: it reigns supreme through thirty realms. Throughout the days at break of morn. I Agni

12.2.s: eṣa indrāya vāyave svarjitpari ṣicyate pavitre dakṣasādʰanaḥ
12.2.d: एष इन्द्राय वायवे स्वर्जित्परि षिच्यते पवित्रे दक्षसाधनः
12.2.e: Chant we a hymn to Agni while we go to sacrifice, to him Who hears us even from afar!

12.2.s: eṣa nr̥bʰirvi nīyate divo mūrdʰā vr̥ṣā sutaḥ somo vaneṣu viśvavit
12.2.d: एष नृभिर्वि नीयते दिवो मूर्धा वृषा सुतः सोमो वनेषु विश्ववित्
12.2.e: Who from of old, in carnage, when the folk were gathered, hath preserved. His household for the worshipper.

12.2.s: eṣa gavyuracikradatpavamāno hiraṇyayuḥ induḥ satrājidastr̥taḥ
12.2.d: एष गव्युरचिक्रदत्पवमानो हिरण्ययुः इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः
12.2.e: May that most blissful Agni guard our wealth and all ourfamily. And keep us safe from pain and grief

12.2.s: eṣa śuṣmyasiṣyadadantarikṣe vr̥ṣā hariḥ punāna indurindramā
12.2.d: एष शुष्म्यसिष्यददन्तरिक्षे वृषा हरिः पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा
12.2.e: Yea, let men say, Agni is born, even he who slayeth Vritra, he, Who winneth wealth in every fight! II Agni

12.2.s: eṣa śuṣmyadābʰyaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati devāvīragʰaśam̐sahā
12.2.d: एष शुष्म्यदाभ्यः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति देवावीरघशꣳसहा
12.2.e: Harness, O Agni, O thou God, thy steeds which are most excellent! The fleet ones bring the rapidly.

12.2.s: sa sutaḥ pītaye vr̥ṣā somaḥ pavitre arṣati vigʰnanrakṣām̐si devayuḥ
12.2.d: स सुतः पीतये वृषा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति विघ्नन्रक्षाꣳसि देवयुः
12.2.e: Come hither, bring the Gods to us to taste the sacrificial feast, To drink the draught of Soma juice!

12.2.s: sa pavitre vicakṣaṇo harirarṣati dʰarṇasiḥ abʰi yoniṃ kanikradat
12.2.d: स पवित्रे विचक्षणो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः अभि योनिं कनिक्रदत्
12.2.e: O Agni of the Bharatas, flame splendid with unfading might Shine forth and gleam, eternal one! III Soma Pavamana

12.2.s: sa vājī rocanā divaḥ pavamāno vi dʰāvati rakṣohā vāramavyayam
12.2.d: स वाजी रोचना दिवः पवमानो वि धावति रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम्
12.2.e: Let him, as mortal, crave this speech for him who presses of the juice! As Bhrigu's sons chased Makha, so drive ye the niggard hound away.

12.2.s: sa tritasyādʰi sānavi pavamāno arocayat jāmibʰiḥ sūryam̐ saha
12.2.d: स त्रितस्याधि सानवि पवमानो अरोचयत् जामिभिः सूर्यꣳ सह
12.2.e: The kinsman hath endued his robe even as a son is clasped in arms. He went, as lover to a dame, to take his station suitor-like.

12.2.s: sa vr̥trahā vr̥ṣā suto varivovidadābʰyaḥ somo vājamivāsarat
12.2.d: स वृत्रहा वृषा सुतो वरिवोविददाभ्यः सोमो वाजमिवासरत्
12.2.e: That hero who produces strength, he who hath propped both worlds apart, Gold-hued, hath wrapped him in the sieve to settle, priest-like, in his place. IV Indra

12.2.s: sa devaḥ kavineṣito3 'bʰi droṇāni dʰāvati indurindrāya mam̐hayan
12.2.d: स देवः कविनेषितो३ ऽभि द्रोणानि धावति इन्दुरिन्द्राय मꣳहयन्
12.2.e: Still, Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou: Thou seekest friendship but in war.

12.2.s: yaḥ pāvamānīradʰyetyr̥ṣibʰiḥ sambʰr̥tam̐ rasam sarvam̐ sa pūtamaśnāti svaditaṃ mātariśvanā
12.2.d: यः पावमानीरध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतꣳ रसम् सर्वꣳ स पूतमश्नाति स्वदितं मातरिश्वना
12.2.e: Thou findest not the wealthy man to be thy friend: those scorn thee who are flown with wine. What time thou thunderest and gatherest, then thou, even as a father, art invoked. V Indra

12.2.s: pāvamānīryo adʰyetyr̥ṣibʰiḥ sambʰr̥tam̐ rasam tasmai sarasvatī duhe kṣīram̐ sarpirmadʰūdakam
12.2.d: पावमानीर्यो अध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतꣳ रसम् तस्मै सरस्वती दुहे क्षीरꣳ सर्पिर्मधूदकम्
12.2.e: A thousand and a hundred steeds are harnessed to thy golden car: Yoked by devotion, Indra, let the long-maned bays bring thee to drink the Soma juice!

12.2.s: pāvamānīḥ svastyayanīḥ sudugʰā hi gʰr̥taścutaḥ r̥ṣibʰiḥ saṃbʰr̥to raso brāhmaṇeṣvamr̥tam̐ hitam
12.2.d: पावमानीः स्वस्त्ययनीः सुदुघा हि घृतश्चुतः ऋषिभिः संभृतो रसो ब्राह्मणेष्वमृतꣳ हितम्
12.2.e: Yoked to thy chariot wrought of gold, may thy two bays with, peacock tails. Convey thee hither, steeds with their white backs, to quaff sweet juice that makes us eloquent!

12.2.s: pāvamānīrdadʰantu na imaṃ lokamatʰo amum kāmāntsamardʰayantu no devīrdevaiḥ samāhr̥tāḥ
12.2.d: पावमानीर्दधन्तु न इमं लोकमथो अमुम् कामान्त्समर्धयन्तु नो देवीर्देवैः समाहृताः
12.2.e: So drink, thou lover of the song, as the first drinker, of this juice. This the outpouring of the savoury sap prepared is good and meet to gladden thee. VI Soma Pavamana

12.2.s: yena devāḥ pavitreṇātmānaṃ punate sadā tena sahasradʰāreṇa pāvamānīḥ punantu naḥ
12.2.d: येन देवाः पवित्रेणात्मानं पुनते सदा तेन सहस्रधारेण पावमानीः पुनन्तु नः
12.2.e: Press ye and pour him, like a steed, laud-worthy, speeding through the region and the flood, Who swims in water, dwells in wood

12.2.s: pāvamānīḥ svastyayanīstābʰirgaccʰati nāndanam puṇyām̐śca bʰakṣānbʰakṣayatyamr̥tatvaṃ ca gaccʰati
12.2.d: पावमानीः स्वस्त्ययनीस्ताभिर्गच्छति नान्दनम् पुण्याꣳश्च भक्षान्भक्षयत्यमृतत्वं च गच्छति
12.2.e: The Steer with thousand streams who poureth out the rain, dear to the race of deities; Who, born in Law, hath waxen mighty by the Law, King, God, and lofty ordinance. VII Agni

12.2.s: aganma mahā namasā yaviṣṭʰaṃ yo dīdāya samiddʰaḥ sve duroṇe citrabʰānum̐ rodasī antarurvī svāhutaṃ viśvataḥ pratyañcam
12.2.d: अगन्म महा नमसा यविष्ठं यो दीदाय समिद्धः स्वे दुरोणे चित्रभानुꣳ रोदसी अन्तरुर्वी स्वाहुतं विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चम्
12.2.e: Served with oblation, kindled, bright, through love of song, may Agni, bent On riches, smite the Vritras dead

12.2.s: sa mahnā viśvā duritāni sāhvānagni ṣṭave dama ā jātavedāḥ sa no rakṣiṣadduritādavadyādasmāngr̥ṇata uta no magʰonaḥ
12.2.d: स मह्ना विश्वा दुरितानि साह्वानग्नि ष्टवे दम आ जातवेदाः स नो रक्षिषद्दुरितादवद्यादस्मान्गृणत उत नो मघोनः
12.2.e: His father's father, shining in his mother's ever-lasting side, Set on the seat of sacrifice!

12.2.s: tvaṃ varuṇa uta mitro agne tvāṃ vardʰanti matibʰirvasiṣṭʰāḥ tve vasu suṣaṇanāni santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibʰiḥ sadā naḥ
12.2.d: त्वं वरुण उत मित्रो अग्ने त्वां वर्धन्ति मतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः त्वे वसु सुषणनानि सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः
12.2.e: O active Jatavedas, bring devotion that wins progeny, Agni, that it may shine to heaven! VIII Soma Pavamana

12.2.s: mahām̐ indro ya ojasā parjanyo vr̥ṣṭimām̐ iva stomairvatsasya vāvr̥dʰe
12.2.d: महाꣳ इन्द्रो य ओजसा पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाꣳ इव स्तोमैर्वत्सस्य वावृधे
12.2.e: Made pure by this man's urgent zeal and impulse, the God hath with his juice the Gods pervaded. Pressed, singing, to the sieve he goes, as passes the Hotar to enclosures hoiding cattle.

12.2.s: kaṇvā indraṃ yadakrata stomairyajñasya sādʰanam jāmi bruvata āyudʰā
12.2.d: कण्वा इन्द्रं यदक्रत स्तोमैर्यज्ञस्य साधनम् जामि ब्रुवत आयुधा
12.2.e: Robed in fair raiment meet to wear in combat, a mighty Sage pronouncing invocations, Roll onward to the press-boards as they cleanse thee, far-seeing at the feast of Gods and watchful!

12.2.s: prajāmr̥tasya piprataḥ pra yadbʰaranta vahnayaḥ viprā r̥tasya vāhasā
12.2.d: प्रजामृतस्य पिप्रतः प्र यद्भरन्त वह्नयः विप्रा ऋतस्य वाहसा
12.2.e: Dear, he is brightened on the fleecy summit, a prince among us, nobler than the noble. Roar out as thou art purified, run forward! Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings! IX Indra

12.2.s: pavamānasya jigʰnato hareścandrā asr̥kṣata jīrā ajiraśociṣaḥ
12.2.d: पवमानस्य जिघ्नतो हरेश्चन्द्रा असृक्षत जीरा अजिरशोचिषः
12.2.e: Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sama hymn! Let milk-blent juice delight him made stronger with pure, pure songs of praise!

12.2.s: pavamāno ratʰītamaḥ śubʰrebʰiḥ śubʰraśastamaḥ hariścandro marudgaṇaḥ
12.2.d: पवमानो रथीतमः शुभ्रेभिः शुभ्रशस्तमः हरिश्चन्द्रो मरुद्गणः
12.2.e: O Indra, come thou pure to us, with pure assistance pure thyself! Pure, send thou riches down to us, and, meet for Soma! pure, rejoice!

12.2.s: pavamān vyaśnuhi raśmibʰirvājasātamaḥ dadʰatstotre suvīryam
12.2.d: पवमान् व्यश्नुहि रश्मिभिर्वाजसातमः दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम्
12.2.e: O Indra, pure, vouchsafe us wealth, and, pure enrich the worshipper! Pure, thou dost strike the Vritras dead, and strivest pure, to win the spoil. X Agni

12.2.s: parīto ṣiñcatā sutam̐ somo ya uttamam̐ haviḥ dadʰanvām̐ yo naryo apsvā3ntarā suṣāva somamadribʰiḥ
12.2.d: परीतो षिञ्चता सुतꣳ सोमो य उत्तमꣳ हविः दधन्वाꣳ यो नर्यो अप्स्वा३न्तरा सुषाव सोममद्रिभिः
12.2.e: Eager for wealth we meditate Agni's effectual laud to-day, Laud of the God who touches heaven.

12.2.s: nūnaṃ punāno 'vibʰiḥ pari sravādabdʰaḥ surabʰintaraḥ sute citvāpsu madāmo andʰasā śrīṇanto gobʰiruttaram
12.2.d: नूनं पुनानो ऽविभिः परि स्रवादब्धः सुरभिन्तरः सुते चित्वाप्सु मदामो अन्धसा श्रीणन्तो गोभिरुत्तरम्
12.2.e: May Agni who is Hotar-priest among mankind accept our songs, And worship the celestial folk!

12.2.s: pari svānaścakṣase devamādanaḥ kraturindurvicakṣaṇaḥ
12.2.d: परि स्वानश्चक्षसे देवमादनः क्रतुरिन्दुर्विचक्षणः
12.2.e: Thou, Agni, art spread widely forth, Priest dear and excellent through thee Men make the sacrifice complete. XI Soma Pavamana

12.2.s: asāvi somo aruṣo vr̥ṣā harī rājeva dasmo abʰi gā acikradat punāno vāramatyeṣyavyayam̐ śyeno na yoniṃ gʰr̥tavantamāsadat
12.2.d: असावि सोमो अरुषो वृषा हरी राजेव दस्मो अभि गा अचिक्रदत् पुनानो वारमत्येष्यव्ययꣳ श्येनो न योनिं घृतवन्तमासदत्
12.2.e: To him, praiseworthy, sacred tones have sounded, Steer of the triple height, the life-bestower. Dwelling in wood, like Varuna, a river, lavishing treasure, he distributes blessings.

12.2.s: parjanyaḥ pitā mahiṣasya parṇino nābʰā pr̥tʰivyā giriṣu kṣayaṃ dadʰe svasāra āpo abʰi gā udāsarantsaṃ grāvabʰirvasate vīte adʰvare
12.2.d: पर्जन्यः पिता महिषस्य पर्णिनो नाभा पृथिव्या गिरिषु क्षयं दधे स्वसार आपो अभि गा उदासरन्त्सं ग्रावभिर्वसते वीते अध्वरे
12.2.e: Great conqueror, warrior girt, Lord of all heroes, flow on thy way as he who winneth riches: With sharpened arms, with swift bow, never vanquished in battle, vanquishing in fight the foemen!

12.2.s: kavirvedʰasyā paryeṣi māhinamatyo na mr̥ṣṭo abʰi vājamarṣasi apasedʰanduritā soma no mr̥ḍa gʰr̥tā vasānaḥ pari yāsi nirṇijam
12.2.d: कविर्वेधस्या पर्येषि माहिनमत्यो न मृष्टो अभि वाजमर्षसि अपसेधन्दुरिता सोम नो मृड घृता वसानः परि यासि निर्णिजम्
12.2.e: Giving security, Lord of wide dominion, send us both heaven and earth with all their fulness! Striving to win the Dawns, the light, the waters, and cattle, call to us abundant booty! XII Indra

12.2.s: śrāyanta iva sūryaṃ viśvedindrasya bʰakṣata vasūni jāto janimānyojasā prati bʰāgaṃ na dīdʰimaḥ
12.2.d: श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत वसूनि जातो जनिमान्योजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिमः
12.2.e: O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous Lord of power and might. Alone, the never-conquered guardian of mankind, thou smitest down resistless foes.

12.2.s: alarṣirātiṃ vasudāmupa stuhi bʰadrā indrasya rātayaḥ yo asya kāmaṃ vidʰato na roṣati mano dānāya codayan
12.2.d: अलर्षिरातिं वसुदामुप स्तुहि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः यो अस्य कामं विधतो न रोषति मनो दानाय चोदयन्
12.2.e: As such we seek thee now, O Asura, the most wise, craving thy bounty as our share Thy sheltering defence is like an ample cloak. So may thy favours reach to us. XIII Agni

12.2.s: yata indra bʰayāmahe tato no abʰyaṃ kr̥dʰi magʰavancʰagdʰi tava tanna ūtaye vi dviṣo vi mr̥dʰo jahi
12.2.d: यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभ्यं कृधि मघवन्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतये वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि
12.2.e: Thee have we chosen, skilfullest in sacrifice, immortal, Priest, among the Gods, Best finisher of this holy rite:

12.2.s: tvam̐ hi rādʰaspate rādʰaso mahaḥ kṣayasyāsi vidʰrattā taṃ tvā vayaṃ magʰavannindra girvaṇaḥ sutāvanto havāmahe
12.2.d: त्वꣳ हि राधस्पते राधसो महः क्षयस्यासि विध्रत्ता तं त्वा वयं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सुतावन्तो हवामहे
12.2.e: The Waters' Child, the blessed brightly-shining one, Agni whose, light is excellent. May he by sacrifice win us in heaven the grace of Mitra, Varuna, and the Floods! XIV Agni

12.2.s: tvam̐ somāsi dʰārayurmandra ojiṣṭʰo adʰvare pavasva mam̐hayadrayiḥ
12.2.d: त्वꣳ सोमासि धारयुर्मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो अध्वरे पवस्व मꣳहयद्रयिः
12.2.e: Lord of all food is he, the man whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, and urgest to the fray.

12.2.s: tvam̐ suto madintamo dadʰanvānmatsarintamaḥ induḥ satrājidastr̥taḥ
12.2.d: त्वꣳ सुतो मदिन्तमो दधन्वान्मत्सरिन्तमः इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः
12.2.e: Him, whosoever he may be, no one may vanquish, mighty one! Nay, very glorious wealth is his.

12.2.s: tvam̐ suṣvāṇo adribʰirabʰyarṣa kanikradat dyumantam̐ śuṣmā bʰara
12.2.d: त्वꣳ सुष्वाणो अद्रिभिरभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् द्युमन्तꣳ शुष्मा भर
12.2.e: May he who dwells with all mankind conquer in fight with steeds of war, With sages may he win the spoil. XV Soma Pavamana

12.2.s: pavasva devavītaya indo dʰārābʰirojasā ā kalaśaṃ madʰumāntsoma naḥ sadaḥ
12.2.d: पवस्व देववीतय इन्दो धाराभिरोजसा आ कलशं मधुमान्त्सोम नः सदः
12.2.e: Ten sisters, pouring out the rain together, the sage's quickly moving thoughts, adorn him. Hither hath run the gold-hued Child of Surya, and reached the vat like a fleet vigorous courser.

12.2.s: tava drapsā udapruta indraṃ madāya vāvr̥dʰuḥ tvāṃ devāso amr̥tāya kaṃ papuḥ
12.2.d: तव द्रप्सा उदप्रुत इन्द्रं मदाय वावृधुः त्वां देवासो अमृताय कं पपुः
12.2.e: Even as a youngling shouting with his mothers, the bounteous Steer hath flowed along with waters. As youth to damsel, so with milk he hastens on to the settled meeting-place, the beaker.

12.2.s: ā naḥ sutāsa indavaḥ punānā dʰāvatā rayim vr̥ṣṭidyāvo rītyāpaḥ svarvidaḥ
12.2.d: आ नः सुतास इन्दवः पुनाना धावता रयिम् वृष्टिद्यावो रीत्यापः स्वर्विदः
12.2.e: Yea, swollen is the udder of the milch-cow; thither in streams. comes very sapient Indu. The kine make ready, as with new-washed treasures, the head and chief with milk within the vessels. XVI Indra

12.2.s: pari tyam̐ haryatam̐ hariṃ babʰruṃ punanti vāreṇa yo devānviśvām̐ itpari madena saha gaccʰati
12.2.d: परि त्यꣳ हर्यतꣳ हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण यो देवान्विश्वाꣳ इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति
12.2.e: Drink, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee, with our milky draught! Be, for our weal, our friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well!

12.2.s: dviryaṃ pañca svayaśasam̐ sakʰāyo adrisam̐hatam priyamindrasya kāmyaṃ prasnāpayanta ūrmayaḥ
12.2.d: द्विर्यं पञ्च स्वयशसꣳ सखायो अद्रिसꣳहतम् प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यं प्रस्नापयन्त ऊर्मयः
12.2.e: In thy kind grace and favour may we still be strong: cast us not down before the foe! With manifold assistance guard and succour us, and stablish us in thy good-will! XVII Soma Pavamana

12.2.s: indrāya soma pātave vr̥tragʰne pari ṣicyase nare ca dakṣiṇāvate vīrāya sadanāsade
12.2.d: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे वृत्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे नरे च दक्षिणावते वीराय सदनासदे
12.2.e: The three-times seven milch-kine in the loftiest heaven have for this Soma poured the genuine milky draught. Four other beauteous creatures hath he made for his adornment when he waxed in strength through holy rites.

12.2.s: pavasva soma mahe dakṣāyāśvo na nikto vājī dʰanāya
12.2.d: पवस्व सोम महे दक्षायाश्वो न निक्तो वाजी धनाय
