12.2.e: Enjoying lovely Amrit by his wisdom he divided, each apart from other, earth and heaven. He gladly wrapped himself in the most lucid floods, when through their glory they-found the God's resting-place.

12.2.s: pra te sotāro rasaṃ madāya punanti somaṃ mahe dyumnāya
12.2.d: प्र ते सोतारो रसं मदाय पुनन्ति सोमं महे द्युम्नाय
12.2.e: May those his brilliant rays be ever free from death, inviolate for both classes of created things-- Rays wherewith powers of men and Gods are purified! Yea, even for this have sages welcomed him as King. XVIII Soma Pavamana

12.2.s: śiśuṃ jajñānam̐ hariṃ mr̥janti pavitre somaṃ devebʰya indum
12.2.d: शिशुं जज्ञानꣳ हरिं मृजन्ति पवित्रे सोमं देवेभ्य इन्दुम्
12.2.e: Lauded with song, to feast him, flow to Vayu, flow purified to Varuna and Mitra! Flow to the song inspiring car-borne hero, to mighty Indra, him who wields the thunder!

12.2.s: uṣo ṣu jātamapturaṃ gobʰirbʰaṅgaṃ pariṣkr̥tam induṃ devā ayāsiṣuḥ
12.2.d: उषो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङ्गं परिष्कृतम् इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः
12.2.e: Pour on us garments that shall clothe us meetly, send, purified, milch-kine, abundant yielders! God Soma, send us cbariot-drawing horses that they may bring us treasures bright and golden!

12.2.s: tamidvardʰantu no giro vatsam̐ sam̐śiśvarīriva ya indrasya hr̥dam̐saniḥ
12.2.d: तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरो वत्सꣳ सꣳशिश्वरीरिव य इन्द्रस्य हृदꣳसनिः
12.2.e: Send to us in a stream celestial riches, send us when thou art cleansed, what earth containeth, So that thereby we may acquire possessions and Rishihood in Jamadagni's manner! XIX Indra

12.2.s: arṣā naḥ soma śaṃ gave dʰukṣasva pipyuṣīmiṣam vardʰā samudramuktʰyam
12.2.d: अर्षा नः सोम शं गवे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषम् वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम्
12.2.e: When thou, unequalled Maghavan, wast born to smite the Vritras dead, Thou spreadest out the spacious earth and didst support and prop the heavens.

12.2.s: ā gʰā ye agnimindʰate str̥ṇanti barhirānuṣak yeṣāmindro yuvā sakʰā
12.2.d: आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक् येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा
12.2.e: Then was the sacrifice produced for thee, the laud, and song of joy. In might thou art above this All, all that now is and yet shall be.

12.2.s: br̥hannididʰma eṣāṃ bʰūri śastraṃ pr̥tʰuḥ svaruḥ yeṣāmindro yuvā sakʰā
12.2.d: बृहन्निदिध्म एषां भूरि शस्त्रं पृथुः स्वरुः येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा
12.2.e: Raw kine thou filledst with ripe milk. Thou madest Surya rise to heaven. Heat him as milk is heated with pure Sdma hymns, great joy to him who loves the song! XX Indra

12.2.s: ayuddʰa idyudʰā vr̥tam̐ śūra ājati satvabʰiḥ yeṣāmindro yuvā sakʰā
12.2.d: अयुद्ध इद्युधा वृतꣳ शूर आजति सत्वभिः येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा
12.2.e: Rejoice: thy glory hath been quaffed, Lord of bay steeds! as 'twere the bowl's enlivening mead. Thine, Steer, is Indu, Steer, the Strong, best winner of a thousand spoils.

12.2.s: ya eka idvidayate vasu marttāya dāśuṣe īśāno apratiṣkuta indro aṅga
12.2.d: य एक इद्विदयते वसु मर्त्ताय दाशुषे ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रो अङ्ग
12.2.e: Let our strong drink, most excellent, exhilarating, come to thee, Victorious, Indra! bringing gain, immortal conquering in fight!

12.3.s: yaściddʰi tvā bahubʰya ā sutāvām̐ āvivāsati ugraṃ tatpatyate śava indro aṅga
12.3.d: यश्चिद्धि त्वा बहुभ्य आ सुतावाꣳ आविवासति उग्रं तत्पत्यते शव इन्द्रो अङ्ग
12.3.e: Thou, hero, winner of the spoil, urgest to speed the car of man. Burn, like a vessel with the flame, the riteless Dasyu, conqueror! I Soma Pavamana

12.3.s: kadā marttamarādʰasaṃ padā kṣumpamiva spʰurat kadā naḥ śuśravadgira indro aṅga
12.3.d: कदा मर्त्तमराधसं पदा क्षुम्पमिव स्फुरत् कदा नः शुश्रवद्गिर इन्द्रो अङ्ग
12.3.e: Pour down the rain upon us, pour a wave of waters from the sky. And plenteous store of wholesome foood!

12.3.s: gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇo 'rcantyarkamarkiṇaḥ brahmāṇastvā śatakrata udvam̐śamiva yemire
12.3.d: गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणो ऽर्चन्त्यर्कमर्किणः ब्रह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद्वꣳशमिव येमिरे
12.3.e: Flow onward with that stream of thine, whereby the cows have come to us. The kine of strangers to our home.

12.3.s: yatsānoḥ sānvāruho bʰūryaspaṣṭa karttvam tadindro artʰaṃ cetati yūtʰena vr̥ṣṇirejati
12.3.d: यत्सानोः सान्वारुहो भूर्यस्पष्ट कर्त्त्वम् तदिन्द्रो अर्थं चेतति यूथेन वृष्णिरेजति
12.3.e: Dearest to Gods in sacred rites, pour on us fatness with thy stream, Pour down on us a flood of rain!

12.3.s: yuṅkṣvā hi keśinā harī vr̥ṣaṇā kakṣyaprā atʰā na indra somapā girāmupaśrutiṃ cara
12.3.d: युङ्क्ष्वा हि केशिना हरी वृषणा कक्ष्यप्रा अथा न इन्द्र सोमपा गिरामुपश्रुतिं चर
12.3.e: To give as vigour, with thy stream run through the fleecy straining-cloth! For verily the Gods will hear.

12.3.s: suṣamiddʰo na ā vaha devām̐ agne haviṣmate hotaḥ pāvaka yakṣi ca
12.3.d: सुषमिद्धो न आ वह देवाꣳ अग्ने हविष्मते होतः पावक यक्षि च
12.3.e: Onward hath Pavamana flowed and beaten off the Rakshasas. Flashing out splendour as of old. II Indra

12.3.s: madʰumantaṃ tanūnapādyajñaṃ deveṣu naḥ kave adyā kr̥ṇuyhūtaye
12.3.d: मधुमन्तं तनूनपाद्यज्ञं देवेषु नः कवे अद्या कृणुय्हूतये
12.3.e: Bring forth oblations to the God who knoweth all, who fain would drink. The wanderer, lagging not behind the hero, coming nigh with, speed!

12.3.s: narāśam̐samiha priyamasminyajña upa hvaye madʰujihvam̐ haviṣkr̥tam
12.3.d: नराशꣳसमिह प्रियमस्मिन्यज्ञ उप ह्वये मधुजिह्वꣳ हविष्कृतम्
12.3.e: With Somas go ye nigh to him chief drinker of the Soma's. juice: With beakers to the impetuous God, to Indra with the flowing, drops!

12.3.s: agne sukʰatame ratʰe devām̐ īḍita ā vaha asi hotā manurhitaḥ
12.3.d: अग्ने सुखतमे रथे देवाꣳ ईडित आ वह असि होता मनुर्हितः
12.3.e: What time with Somas, with the drops effused,, ye come beforethe God, Full wise, he knows the hope of each, and, bold one strikes this. foe and that.

12.3.s: yadadya sūra udite 'nāgā mitro aryamā suvāti savitā bʰagaḥ
12.3.d: यदद्य सूर उदिते ऽनागा मित्रो अर्यमा सुवाति सविता भगः
12.3.e: To him, Adhvaryu! yea, to him give offerings of the juiceexpressed! Will he not keep us safely from the spiteful curse of each, presumptuous high-born foe? III Soma Pavamana

12.3.s: suprāvīrastu sa kṣayaḥ pra nu yāmantsudānavaḥ ye no am̐ho 'tipiprati
12.3.d: सुप्रावीरस्तु स क्षयः प्र नु यामन्त्सुदानवः ये नो अꣳहो ऽतिपिप्रति
12.3.e: Sing ye a song to Soma brown of hue, of independent might, The Red, who reaches up to heaven!

12.3.s: uta svarājo aditiradabdʰasya vratasya ye maho rājāna īśate
12.3.d: उत स्वराजो अदितिरदब्धस्य व्रतस्य ये महो राजान ईशते
12.3.e: Purify Soma when effused with stones which hands move rapidly, And pour the sweet milk in the meath.

12.3.s: u tvā mandantu somāḥ kr̥ṇuṣva rādʰo adrivaḥ ava brahmadviṣo jahi
12.3.d: उ त्वा मन्दन्तु सोमाः कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः अव ब्रह्मद्विषो जहि
12.3.e: With humble homage draw ye nigh; blend the libation with the curds: To Indra offer Indu up

12.3.s: padā paṇīnarādʰaso ni bādʰasva mahām̐ asi na hi tvā kaśca na prati
12.3.d: पदा पणीनराधसो नि बाधस्व महाꣳ असि न हि त्वा कश्च न प्रति
12.3.e: Soma, foe-queller, strong and swift, doing the will of Gods, pour forth, Prosperity upon our kine

12.3.s: tvamīśiṣe sutānāmindra tvamasutānām tvam̐ rājā janānām
12.3.d: त्वमीशिषे सुतानामिन्द्र त्वमसुतानाम् त्वꣳ राजा जनानाम्
12.3.e: Heart-knower, Sovran of the heart, thou art effused, O Soma, Tthat, Indra. may drink thee and rejoice.

12.3.s: ā jāgr̥virvipra r̥tāṃ matīnām̐ somaḥ punāno asadaccamūṣu sapanti yaṃ mitʰunāso nikāmā adʰvaryavo ratʰirāsaḥ suhastāḥ
12.3.d: आ जागृविर्विप्र ऋतां मतीनाꣳ सोमः पुनानो असदच्चमूषु सपन्ति यं मिथुनासो निकामा अध्वर्यवो रथिरासः सुहस्ताः
12.3.e: O Soma Pavamana, give us riches and heroic strength, Indu, with Indra. our ally! IV Indra I. Surya, thou mountest up to meet the hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for men;

12.3.s: sa punāna upa sūre dadʰāna obe aprā rodasī vi ṣa āvaḥ priyā cidyasya priyasāsa ūtī sato dʰanaṃ kāriṇe na pra yam̐sat
12.3.d: स पुनान उप सूरे दधान ओबे अप्रा रोदसी वि ष आवः प्रिया चिद्यस्य प्रियसास ऊती सतो धनं कारिणे न प्र यꣳसत्
12.3.e: Him who with might of both his arms broke nine-and-ninety castles down, Slew Vritra and smote Ahi dead.

12.3.s: sa vardʰitā vardʰanaḥ pūyamānaḥ somo mīḍʰvām̐ abʰi no jyotiṣāvīt yatra naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ padajñāḥ svarvido abʰi gā adrimiṣṇan
12.3.d: स वर्धिता वर्धनः पूयमानः सोमो मीढ्वाꣳ अभि नो ज्योतिषावीत् यत्र नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञाः स्वर्विदो अभि गा अद्रिमिष्णन्
12.3.e: This Indra is our gracious friend. He sends, like a full-streaming cow, Riches in horses, kine, and corn. V Surya

12.3.s: mā cidanyadvi śam̐sata sakʰāyo mā riṣaṇyata indramitstotā vr̥ṣaṇam̐ sacā sute muhuruktʰā ca śam̐sata
12.3.d: मा चिदन्यद्वि शꣳसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत इन्द्रमित्स्तोता वृषणꣳ सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शꣳसत
12.3.e: May the bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled meath, giving the sacrifices lord unbroken life He who, wind-urged, in person guards our offspring well, nourishes them with food and shines o'er many a land.

12.3.s: avakrakṣiṇaṃ vr̥ṣabʰaṃ yatʰā juvaṃ gāṃ na carṣaṇīsaham vidveṣaṇam̐ saṃvananamubʰayaṅkaraṃ mam̐hiṣṭʰamubʰayāvinam
12.3.d: अवक्रक्षिणं वृषभं यथा जुवं गां न चर्षणीसहम् विद्वेषणꣳ संवननमुभयङ्करं मꣳहिष्ठमुभयाविनम्
12.3.e: Radiant, as high Truth, cherished, best at winning strength, Truth based upon the statute that supports the heavens, He rose, a light that kills Vritras and enemies, best slayer of the Dasyus, Asuras, and foes.

12.3.s: udu tye madʰumattamā gira stomāsa īrate satrājito dʰanasā akṣitotayo vājanto ratʰā iva
12.3.d: उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिर स्तोमास ईरते सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजन्तो रथा इव
12.3.e: This light, the best of lights, supreme, all conquering, winner of riches, is exalted with high laud. All-lighting, radiant, mighty as the Sun to see, he spreadeth wide unshaken victory and strength. VI Indra

12.3.s: kaṇvā iva bʰr̥gavaḥ sūryā iva viśvamiddʰītamāśata indram̐ stomebʰirmahayanta āyavaḥ priyamedʰāso asvaran
12.3.d: कण्वा इव भृगवः सूर्या इव विश्वमिद्धीतमाशत इन्द्रꣳ स्तोमेभिर्महयन्त आयवः प्रियमेधासो अस्वरन्
12.3.e: O Indra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons, Guide us, O much-invoked, in this our way: may we still livc and look upon the light!

12.3.s: paryū ṣu pra dʰanva vājasātaye pari vr̥trāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ dviṣastaradʰyā r̥ṇayā na īrase
12.3.d: पर्यू षु प्र धन्व वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः द्विषस्तरध्या ऋणया न ईरसे
12.3.e: Grant that no mighty foes, unknown, malevolent unhallowed, tread us to the ground! With thine assistance, hero, may we pass through all the waters that are rushing down! VII Indra

12.3.s: ajījano hi pavamāna sūryaṃ vidʰāre śakmanā payaḥ gojīrayā ram̐hamānaḥ purandʰyā
12.3.d: अजीजनो हि पवमान सूर्यं विधारे शक्मना पयः गोजीरया रꣳहमानः पुरन्ध्या
12.3.e: Protect us, Indra, each to-day, each to morrow, and each following day! Through all the days shalt thou, Lord of the brave, preserve our singers both by day and night!

12.3.s: anu hi tvā sutam̐ soma madāmasi mahe samaryarājye vājām̐ abʰi pavamāna pra gāhase
12.3.d: अनु हि त्वा सुतꣳ सोम मदामसि महे समर्यराज्ये वाजाꣳ अभि पवमान प्र गाहसे
12.3.e: A crushing warrior, passing rich, is Maghavan, endowed with all heroic strength. Thine arms, O Satakratu, are exceeding strong, those arms, which grasp the thunderbolt. VIII Sarasvan

12.3.s: pari pra dʰanvendrāya soma svādurmitrāya pūṣṇe bʰagāya
12.3.d: परि प्र धन्वेन्द्राय सोम स्वादुर्मित्राय पूष्णे भगाय
12.3.e: We call upon Sarasvan as unmarried men who long for wives, As bounteous men who yearn for sons. IX Sarasvati

12.3.s: evāmr̥tāya mahe kṣayāya sa śukro arṣa divyaḥ pīyūṣaḥ
12.3.d: एवामृताय महे क्षयाय स शुक्रो अर्ष दिव्यः पीयूषः
12.3.e: Yea, she most dear amid dear streams-seven-sistered, loved with foundest love. Sarasvati, hath earned our praise. X Svitar. Brahmapaspati. Agni

12.3.s: indraste soma sutasya peyātkratve dakṣāya viśve ca devāḥ
12.3.d: इन्द्रस्ते सोम सुतस्य पेयात्क्रत्वे दक्षाय विश्वे च देवाः
12.3.e: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers!

12.3.s: sūryasyeva raśmayo drāvayitnavo matsarāsaḥ prasutaḥ sākamīrate tantuṃ tataṃ pari sargāsa āśavo nendrādr̥te pavate dʰāma kiṃ cana
12.3.d: सूर्यस्येव रश्मयो द्रावयित्नवो मत्सरासः प्रसुतः साकमीरते तन्तुं ततं परि सर्गास आशवो नेन्द्रादृते पवते धाम किं चन
12.3.e: O Brahmanaspati, make thou Kakshivan Ausija a loud Chanter of flowing Soma juice!

12.3.s: upo matiḥ pr̥cyate sicyate madʰu mandrājanī codate antarāsani pavamānaḥ santaniḥ sunvatāmiva madʰumāndrapsaḥ pari vāramarṣati
12.3.d: उपो मतिः पृच्यते सिच्यते मधु मन्द्राजनी चोदते अन्तरासनि पवमानः सन्तनिः सुन्वतामिव मधुमान्द्रप्सः परि वारमर्षति
12.3.e: Agni, thou pourest life: send down upon us food and vigorous strength; Drive thou misfortune far away! XI Mitra-Varuva

12.3.s: ukṣā mimeti prati yanti dʰenavo devasya devīrupa yanti niṣkr̥tam atyakramīdarjunaṃ vāramavyayamatkaṃ na niktaṃ pari somo avyata
12.3.d: उक्षा मिमेति प्रति यन्ति धेनवो देवस्य देवीरुप यन्ति निष्कृतम् अत्यक्रमीदर्जुनं वारमव्ययमत्कं न निक्तं परि सोमो अव्यत
12.3.e: So help ye us to riches, great celestial and terrestrial wealth Vast is your sway among the Gods!

12.3.s: agniṃ naro dīdʰitibʰiraraṇyorhastacyutaṃ janayata praśastam dūredr̥śaṃ gr̥hapatimatʰavyum
12.3.d: अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिररण्योर्हस्तच्युतं जनयत प्रशस्तम् दूरेदृशं गृहपतिमथव्युम्
12.3.e: Carefully tending Law with law they have attained their vigorous might: Both Gods, devoid of guile, wax strong.

12.3.s: tamagnimaste vasavo nyr̥ṇvantsupraticakṣamavase kutaścit dakṣāyyo yo dama āsa nityaḥ
12.3.d: तमग्निमस्ते वसवो न्यृण्वन्त्सुप्रतिचक्षमवसे कुतश्चित् दक्षाय्यो यो दम आस नित्यः
12.3.e: With rainy skies and streaming floods, Lords of the food that falls in dew, A lofty seat have they attained. XII Indra I. They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy steed: The lights shining in the sky.

12.3.s: preddʰo agne dīdihi puro no 'jasrayā sūrmyā yaviṣṭʰa tvām̐ śaśvanta upa yanti vājāḥ
12.3.d: प्रेद्धो अग्ने दीदिहि पुरो नो ऽजस्रया सूर्म्या यविष्ठ त्वाꣳ शश्वन्त उप यन्ति वाजाः
12.3.e: On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Brown, bold, who bear the hero on.

12.3.s: āyaṃ gauḥ pr̥śnirakramīdasadanmātaraṃ puraḥ pitaraṃ ca prayantsvaḥ
12.3.d: आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीदसदन्मातरं पुरः पितरं च प्रयन्त्स्वः
12.3.e: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns. XIII Soma Pavamana

12.3.s: antaścarati rocanāsya prāṇādapānatī vyakʰyanmahiṣo divam
12.3.d: अन्तश्चरति रोचनास्य प्राणादपानती व्यख्यन्महिषो दिवम्
12.3.e: For thee this Soma is effused. O Indra: drink of this j uice; for thee the stream is flowing-- Soma, which thou thyself hast made and chosen, even Indu for thy special drink to cheer thee!

12.3.s: trim̐śaddʰāma vi rājati vākpataṅgāya dʰīyate prati vastoraha dyubʰiḥ
12.3.d: त्रिꣳशद्धाम वि राजति वाक्पतङ्गाय धीयते प्रति वस्तोरह द्युभिः
12.3.e: Like a capacious car hath it been harnessed, the mighty, to acquire abundant treasures. Then in the sacrifice they shouted lauding all triumphs won by Nahus in the battle.

12.3.s: upaprayanto adʰvaraṃ mantraṃ vocemāgnaye āre asme ca śr̥ṇvate
12.3.d: उपप्रयन्तो अध्वरं मन्त्रं वोचेमाग्नये आरे अस्मे च शृण्वते
12.3.e: Flow onward like the potent band of Maruts, like that celestial host which none revileth! Quickly be gracious unto us like waters, like sacrifice victorious, thousand-fashioned! XIV Agni

12.3.s: yaḥ snīhitīṣu pūrvyaḥ saṃjagmānāsu kr̥ṣṭiṣu arakṣaddāśuṣe gayam
12.3.d: यः स्नीहितीषु पूर्व्यः संजग्मानासु कृष्टिषु अरक्षद्दाशुषे गयम्
12.3.e: O Agni, thou hast been ordained Hotar of every sacrifice, By Gods, among the race of men. So with sweet-sounding tongues for us sacrifice nobly in this rite: Bring thou the Gods and worship them

12.3.s: sa no vedo amātyamagnī rakṣatu śantamaḥ utāsmānpātvam̐hasaḥ
12.3.d: स नो वेदो अमात्यमग्नी रक्षतु शन्तमः उतास्मान्पात्वꣳहसः
12.3.e: For, as disposer, Agni, God, most wise in sacrifices, thou Knowest straightway the roads and paths. XV Agni

12.3.s: uta bruvantu jantava udagnirvr̥trahājani dʰanañjayo raṇeraṇe
12.3.d: उत ब्रुवन्तु जन्तव उदग्निर्वृत्रहाजनि धनञ्जयो रणेरणे
12.3.e: Immortal, Hotar-priest, and God, with wondrous power heleads the way, Urging the congregations on.

12.3.s: agne yuṅkṣvā hi ye tavāśvāso deva sādʰavaḥ araṃ vahantyāśavaḥ
12.3.d: अग्ने युङ्क्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वासो देव साधवः अरं वहन्त्याशवः
12.3.e: Strong, he is set on deeds of strength. He is led forth in holy rites, Sage who completes the sacrifice.

12.3.s: accʰā no yāhyā vahābʰi prayām̐si vītaye ā devāntsomapītaye
12.3.d: अच्छा नो याह्या वहाभि प्रयाꣳसि वीतये आ देवान्त्सोमपीतये
12.3.e: Excellent, he was made by thought. The germ of beings have gained. Yea, and the Sire of active power. XVI Agni

12.3.s: udagne bʰārata dyumadajasreṇa davidyutat śocā vi bʰāhyajara
12.3.d: उदग्ने भारत द्युमदजस्रेण दविद्युतत् शोचा वि भाह्यजर
12.3.e: Pour on the juice the heated milk which hasteneth to heaven and. earth; Bestow the liquid on the Bull!

12.3.s: pra sunvānāyāndʰaso martto na vaṣṭa tadvacaḥ apa śvānamarādʰasam̐ hatā makʰaṃ na bʰr̥gavaḥ
12.3.d: प्र सुन्वानायान्धसो मर्त्तो न वष्ट तद्वचः अप श्वानमराधसꣳ हता मखं न भृगवः
12.3.e: These know their own abiding-place: like calves beside themother cows, They come together with their kin.

12.3.s: ā jāmiratke avyata bʰuje na putra oṇyoḥ sarajjāro na yoṣaṇāṃ varo na yonimāsadam
12.3.d: आ जामिरत्के अव्यत भुजे न पुत्र ओण्योः सरज्जारो न योषणां वरो न योनिमासदम्
12.3.e: Devouring in their greedy jaws, they make sustaining food irb heaven, For Indra, Agni, homage, light. XVII Indra

12.3.s: sa vīro dakṣasādʰano vi yastastambʰa rodasī hariḥ pavitre avyata vedʰā na yonimāsadam
12.3.d: स वीरो दक्षसाधनो वि यस्तस्तम्भ रोदसी हरिः पवित्रे अव्यत वेधा न योनिमासदम्
12.3.e: In all the worlds That was the best and highest whence sprang the mighty one, of splendid valour, As soon as he is born he smites his foemen, he in whom all who lend him aid are joyful foe

12.3.s: abʰrātr̥vyo anā tvamanāpirindra januṣā sanādasi yudʰedāpitvamiccʰase
12.3.d: अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे
12.3.e: Grown mighty in his strength, of ample vigour, he as a strikes fear into the Dasa, Eager to win the breathing and the breathless. All sang thy praise at banquet and oblation.

12.3.s: na kī revantam̐ sakʰyāya vindase pīyanti te surāśvaḥ yadā kr̥ṇoṣi nadanum̐ samūhasyāditpiteva hūyase
12.3.d: न की रेवन्तꣳ सख्याय विन्दसे पीयन्ति ते सुराश्वः यदा कृणोषि नदनुꣳ समूहस्यादित्पितेव हूयसे
12.3.e: All concentrate on thee their mental vigour, what time these, once or twice, are thine assistants. Blend what is sweeter than the sweet with sweetness: win quickly with our meath that meath in battle. XVIII Indra

12.3.s: ā tvā sahasramā śataṃ yuktā ratʰe hiraṇyaye brahmayujo haraya indra keśino vahantu somapītaye
12.3.d: आ त्वा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये ब्रह्मयुजो हरय इन्द्र केशिनो वहन्तु सोमपीतये
12.3.e: At the Trikadrukas the great and strong enjoyed the barley-brew. With Vishnu did he drink the pressed-out Soma juice, even as he would. That hath so heightened him the great, the wide, to do his mighty work. So may the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true!

12.3.s: ā tvā ratʰe hiraṇyaye harī mayūraśepyā śitipr̥ṣṭʰā vahatāṃ madʰvo andʰaso vivakṣaṇasya pītaye
12.3.d: आ त्वा रथे हिरण्यये हरी मयूरशेप्या शितिपृष्ठा वहतां मध्वो अन्धसो विवक्षणस्य पीतये
12.3.e: Brought forth together with wisdom and potent strength thou grewest great: with hero deeds subduing the malevolent, most swift in act; Giving prosperity and lovely wealth to him who praiseth thee. So may the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true!

13.1.s: pibā tvā3sya girvaṇaḥ sutasya pūrvapā iva pariṣkr̥tasya rasina iyamāsutiścārurmadāya patyate
13.1.d: पिबा त्वा३स्य गिर्वणः सुतस्य पूर्वपा इव परिष्कृतस्य रसिन इयमासुतिश्चारुर्मदाय पत्यते
13.1.e: So he resplendent in the battle overcame Krivi by might. He with his majesty bath filled the earth and heaven, and waxen strong. One share of the libation bath he swallowed down: one share he left. Enlighten us! So may the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true! I Indra

13.1.s: ā sotā pari ṣiñcatāśvaṃ na stomamapturam̐ rajasturam vanaprakṣamudaprutam
13.1.d: आ सोता परि षिञ्चताश्वं न स्तोममप्तुरꣳ रजस्तुरम् वनप्रक्षमुदप्रुतम्
13.1.e: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave,

13.1.s: sahasradʰāraṃ vr̥ṣabʰaṃ payoduhaṃ priyaṃ devāya janmane r̥tena ya r̥tajāto vivāvr̥dʰe rājā deva r̥taṃ br̥hat
13.1.d: सहस्रधारं वृषभं पयोदुहं प्रियं देवाय जन्मने ऋतेन य ऋतजातो विवावृधे राजा देव ऋतं बृहत्
13.1.e: Hither have his bay steeds been sent, red steeds are on the sacred grass Where we in concert sing our songs.
For Indra, thunder-armed, the kine have yielded mingled milk and meath, What time he found them in the vault. II Indra

13.1.s: agnirvr̥trāṇi jaṅgʰanaddraviṇasyurvipanyayā samiddʰaḥ śukra āhutaḥ ՙ compare saṃmiddʰaḥ garbʰe mātuḥ pituṣpitā vididyutāno akṣare sīdannr̥tasya yonimā
13.1.d: अग्निर्वृत्राणि जङ्घनद्द्रविणस्युर्विपन्यया समिद्धः शुक्र आहुतः ՙ चोम्परे संमिद्धः गर्भे मातुः पितुष्पिता विदिद्युतानो अक्षरे सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा
13.1.e: Draw near unto our Indra who must be invoked in every fight! Come, thou most mighty Vritra-slayer, meet for praise come to libations and to hymns.

13.1.s: brahma prajāvadā bʰara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe agne yaddīdayaddivi
13.1.d: ब्रह्म प्रजावदा भर जातवेदो विचर्षणे अग्ने यद्दीदयद्दिवि
13.1.e: Thou art the best of all in sending bounteous gyifts, true art thou,, lordly in thine act. We claim alliance with the very glorious one, yea, with the mighty Son of Strength. III Soma Pavamana I. They have drained forth from out the great depth of the sky the old divine primeval milk that claims the laud: They lifted up their voice to Indra at his birth.

13.1.s: asya preṣā hemanā pūyamāno devo devebʰiḥ samapr̥kta rasam sutaḥ pavitraṃ paryeti rebʰanmiteva sadma paśumanti hotā
13.1.d: अस्य प्रेषा हेमना पूयमानो देवो देवेभिः समपृक्त रसम् सुतः पवित्रं पर्येति रेभन्मितेव सद्म पशुमन्ति होता
13.1.e: Then, beautifully radiant, certain heavenly ones proclaimed their kinship with him as they looked thereon: Savitar opens, as it were, the fold of heaven.

13.1.s: bʰadrā vastrā samanyā ' '3 vasāno mahānkavirnivacanāni śam̐san ā vacyasva camvoḥ pūyamāno vicakṣaṇo jāgr̥virdevavītau
13.1.d: भद्रा वस्त्रा समन्या ऽ ऽ३ वसानो महान्कविर्निवचनानि शꣳसन् आ वच्यस्व चम्वोः पूयमानो विचक्षणो जागृविर्देववीतौ
13.1.e: And now that thou, O Pavamana, art above this earth and heaven and all existence in thy might, Thou shinest like a bull supreme among the herd. IV Agni

13.1.s: samu priyo mr̥jyate sāno avye yaśastaro yaśasāṃ kṣaito asme abʰi svara dʰanvā pūyamāno yūyaṃ pāta svastibʰiḥ sadā naḥ
13.1.d: समु प्रियो मृज्यते सानो अव्ये यशस्तरो यशसां क्षैतो अस्मे अभि स्वर धन्वा पूयमानो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः
13.1.e: O Agni, graciously announce this our good fortune to the Gods, And this our newest hymn of praise!

13.1.s: eto nvindram̐ stavāma śuddʰam̐ śuddʰena sāmnā śuddʰairuktʰairvāvr̥dʰvām̐sam̐ śuddʰairāśīrvānmamattu
13.1.d: एतो न्विन्द्रꣳ स्तवाम शुद्धꣳ शुद्धेन साम्ना शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वाꣳसꣳ शुद्धैराशीर्वान्ममत्तु
13.1.e: Thou dealest gifts, resplendent one! nigh, as with wave of Sindhu, thou Swift strearnest to the worshipper.

13.1.s: indra śuddʰo na ā gahi śuddʰaḥ śuddʰābʰirūtibʰiḥ śuddʰo rayiṃ ni dʰāraya śuddʰo mamaddʰi somya
13.1.d: इन्द्र शुद्धो न आ गहि शुद्धः शुद्धाभिरूतिभिः शुद्धो रयिं नि धारय शुद्धो ममद्धि सोम्य
13.1.e: Give us a share of wealth most high, a share of wealth most near to us, A share of wealth that is between. V Indra

13.1.s: indra śuddʰo hi no rayim̐ śuddʰo ratnāni dāśuṣe śuddʰo vr̥trāṇi jigʰnase śuddʰo vājam̐ siṣāsasi
13.1.d: इन्द्र शुद्धो हि नो रयिꣳ शुद्धो रत्नानि दाशुषे शुद्धो वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे शुद्धो वाजꣳ सिषाससि
13.1.e: I from my Father have obtained deep knowledge of eternal Law; I was born like unto the Sun.

13.1.s: agne stomaṃ manāmahe sidʰramadya divispr̥śaḥ devasya draviṇasyavaḥ
13.1.d: अग्ने स्तोमं मनामहे सिध्रमद्य दिविस्पृशः देवस्य द्रविणस्यवः
13.1.e: After the ancient manner I, like Kanva, beautify my songs, And Indra's self gains power thereby.

13.1.s: agnirjuṣata no giro hotā yo mānuṣeṣvā sa yakṣaddaivyaṃ janam
13.1.d: अग्निर्जुषत नो गिरो होता यो मानुषेष्वा स यक्षद्दैव्यं जनम्
13.1.e: Whatever gishis have not praised thee, Indra, or have praised thee, wax Mighty indeed when praised by me! VI Agni

13.1.s: tvamagne sapratʰā asi juṣṭo hotā vareṇyaḥ tvayā yajñaṃ vi tanvate
13.1.d: त्वमग्ने सप्रथा असि जुष्टो होता वरेण्यः त्वया यज्ञं वि तन्वते
13.1.e: Agni, produced by strength, do thou with all thy fires accept our prayer: With those that are with Gods, with those that are with men exalt our songs!

13.1.s: abʰi tripr̥ṣṭʰaṃ vr̥ṣaṇaṃ vayodʰāmāṅgoṣiṇamavāvaśaṃta vāṇīḥ vanā vasāno varuṇo na sindʰūrvi ratnadʰā dayate vāryāṇi
13.1.d: अभि त्रिपृष्ठं वृषणं वयोधामाङ्गोषिणमवावशंत वाणीः वना वसानो वरुणो न सिन्धूर्वि रत्नधा दयते वार्याणि
13.1.e: Forth come to us with all his fires that Agni, whose the mighty are, Come, fully girt about with wealth for us and for our kith and kin!

13.1.s: śūragrāmaḥ sarvavīraḥ sahāvānjetā pavasva sanitā dʰanāni tigmāyudʰaḥ kṣipradʰanvā samatsvaṣāḍʰaḥ sāhvānpr̥tanāsu śatrūn
13.1.d: शूरग्रामः सर्ववीरः सहावान्जेता पवस्व सनिता धनानि तिग्मायुधः क्षिप्रधन्वा समत्स्वषाढः साह्वान्पृतनासु शत्रून्
13.1.e: Do thou, O Agni, with thy fires strengthen our prayer and sacrifices: Incite them to bestow their wealth to aid our service of the Gods! VII Soma Pavamana

13.1.s: urugavyūtirabʰayāni kr̥ṇvantsamīcīne ā pavasvā purandʰī apaḥ siṣāsannuṣasaḥ svā3rgāḥ saṃ cikrado maho asmabʰyaṃ vājān
13.1.d: उरुगव्यूतिरभयानि कृण्वन्त्समीचीने आ पवस्वा पुरन्धी अपः सिषासन्नुषसः स्वा३र्गाः सं चिक्रदो महो अस्मभ्यं वाजान्
13.1.e: Some, the men of old whose grass was trimmed addressed the hymn to thee for mighty strength and for renown: So, hero, urge us onward to heroic power'

13.1.s: tvamindra yaśā asyr̥jīṣī śavasaspatiḥ tvaṃ vr̥trāṇi ham̐syapratīnyeka itpurvanuttaścarṣaṇīdʰr̥tiḥ
13.1.d: त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पतिः त्वं वृत्राणि हꣳस्यप्रतीन्येक इत्पुर्वनुत्तश्चर्षणीधृतिः
13.1.e: All round about hast thou with glory pierced for us as 'twere a never-failing well for men to drink, Borne on thy way as 'twere in fragments from both arms.

13.1.s: tamu tvā nūnamasura pracetasam̐ rādʰo bʰāgamivemahe mahīva kr̥ttiḥ śaraṇā ta indra pra te sumnā no aśnavan
13.1.d: तमु त्वा नूनमसुर प्रचेतसꣳ राधो भागमिवेमहे महीव कृत्तिः शरणा त इन्द्र प्र ते सुम्ना नो अश्नवन्
13.1.e: Thou didst produce him, deathless one! for mortal man, for maintenance of Law and lovely Amrita: Thou evermore hast moved making wealth flow to us. VIII Indra

13.1.s: yajiṣṭʰaṃ tvā vavr̥mahe devaṃ devatrā hotāramamartyam asya yajñasya sukratum
13.1.d: यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यम् अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम्
13.1.e: Pour out the drops f or Indra; let him drink the meath of Soma Juice! He through his majesty sends forth his bounteous gifts.

13.1.s: apāṃ napātam̐ subʰagam̐ sudīditimagnimu śreṣṭʰaśociṣam sa no mitrasya varuṇasya so apāmā sumnaṃ yakṣate divi
13.1.d: अपां नपातꣳ सुभगꣳ सुदीदितिमग्निमु श्रेष्ठशोचिषम् स नो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य सो अपामा सुम्नं यक्षते दिवि
13.1.e: I spake to the bay coursers' Lord, to him who grants the boon. of wealth: Now hear the son of Asva as he praises thee?

13.1.s: yamagne pr̥tsu martyamavā vājeṣu yaṃ junāḥ sa yantā śaśvatīriṣaḥ
13.1.d: यमग्ने पृत्सु मर्त्यमवा वाजेषु यं जुनाः स यन्ता शश्वतीरिषः
13.1.e: Never was any hero born before thee mightier than thou: None certainly like thee in riches and in praise. IX Indra

13.1.s: na kirasya sahantya paryetā kayasya cit vājo asti śravāyyaḥ
13.1.d: न किरस्य सहन्त्य पर्येता कयस्य चित् वाजो अस्ति श्रवाय्यः
13.1.e: Thou wishest for thy kine a bull, lord of thy cows whom none may kill, For those who long for his approach, for those who turn away from him. X Agni

13.1.s: sa vājaṃ viśvacarṣaṇirarvadbʰirastu tarutā viprebʰirastu sanitā
13.1.d: स वाजं विश्वचर्षणिरर्वद्भिरस्तु तरुता विप्रेभिरस्तु सनिता
13.1.e: The God who giveth wealth accept the full libation poured to him! Pour ye it out, then fill the vessel full again, for so the God regardeth you!

13.1.s: sākamukṣo marjayanta svasāro daśa dʰīrasya dʰītayo dʰanutrīḥ hariḥ paryadravajjāḥ sūryasya droṇaṃ nanakṣe atyo na vājī
13.1.d: साकमुक्षो मर्जयन्त स्वसारो दश धीरस्य धीतयो धनुत्रीः हरिः पर्यद्रवज्जाः सूर्यस्य द्रोणं ननक्षे अत्यो न वाजी
13.1.e: The Gods made him the Hotar-priest of sacrifice, oblationbearer, passing wise. Agni gives wealth and valour to the worshipper, to man who offers up his gifts. XI Agni

13.1.s: saṃ mātr̥bʰirna śiśurvāvaśāno vr̥ṣā dadʰanve puruvāro adbʰiḥ maryo na yoṣāmabʰi niṣkr̥taṃ yantsaṃ gaccʰate kalaśa usriyābʰiḥ
13.1.d: सं मातृभिर्न शिशुर्वावशानो वृषा दधन्वे पुरुवारो अद्भिः मर्यो न योषामभि निष्कृतं यन्त्सं गच्छते कलश उस्रियाभिः
13.1.e: He hath appeared, best prosperer, in whom men lay their holy acts: So may our songs of praise come nigh to Agni who was born to give the Arya strength.

13.1.s: uta pra pipya ūdʰaragʰnyāyā indurdʰārābʰiḥ sacate sumedʰāḥ mūrdʰānaṃ gāvaḥ payasā camūṣvabʰi śrīṇanti vasubʰirna niktaiḥ
13.1.d: उत प्र पिप्य ऊधरघ्न्याया इन्दुर्धाराभिः सचते सुमेधाः मूर्धानं गावः पयसा चमूष्वभि श्रीणन्ति वसुभिर्न निक्तैः
13.1.e: Him before whom the people shrink when he performs his glorious deeds, Him who wins thousands at the sacrifice, himself, that Agni, reverence with songs!

13.1.s: pibā sutasya rasino matsvā na indra gomataḥ āpirno bodʰi sadʰamādye vr̥dʰe3 'smām̐ avantu te dʰiyaḥ
13.1.d: पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्ये वृधे३ ऽस्माꣳ अवन्तु ते धियः
13.1.e: Agni of Divoddsa, God, comes forth like Indra in his might. Rapidly hath he moved along his mother earth; he stands in high heaven's dwelling-place. XII Agni

13.1.s: bʰūyāma te sumatau vājino vayaṃ mā na starabʰimātaye asmāṃ citrābʰiravatādabʰiṣṭibʰirā naḥ sumneṣu yāmaya
13.1.d: भूयाम ते सुमतौ वाजिनो वयं मा न स्तरभिमातये अस्मां चित्राभिरवतादभिष्टिभिरा नः सुम्नेषु यामय
13.1.e: Agni, thou pourest life: send down upon us food and vigorous strength: Drive thou misfortune far away!

13.1.s: trirasmai sapta dʰenavo duduhrire satyāmāśiraṃ parame vyomani catvāryanyā bʰuvanāni nirṇije cārūṇi cakre yadr̥tairavardʰata
13.1.d: त्रिरस्मै सप्त धेनवो दुदुह्रिरे सत्यामाशिरं परमे व्योमनि चत्वार्यन्या भुवनानि निर्णिजे चारूणि चक्रे यदृतैरवर्धत
13.1.e: Agni is Pavamana, Sage, Chief Priest of all the fivefold tribes; To him whose wealth is great we pray.

13.1.s: sa bʰakṣamāṇo amr̥tasya cāruṇa ubʰe dyāvā kāvyenā vi śaśratʰe tejiṣṭʰā apo mam̐hanā pari vyata yadī devasya śravasā sado viduḥ
13.1.d: स भक्षमाणो अमृतस्य चारुण उभे द्यावा काव्येना वि शश्रथे तेजिष्ठा अपो मꣳहना परि व्यत यदी देवस्य श्रवसा सदो विदुः
13.1.e: Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour splendour with hero strength on us, Granting me wealth that nourishes! XIII Agni

13.1.s: te asya santu ketavo 'mr̥tyavo 'dābʰyāso januṣī ubʰe anu yebʰirnr̥mṇā ca devyā ca punata ādidrājānaṃ mananā agr̥bʰṇata
13.1.d: ते अस्य सन्तु केतवो ऽमृत्यवो ऽदाभ्यासो जनुषी उभे अनु येभिर्नृम्णा च देव्या च पुनत आदिद्राजानं मनना अगृभ्णत
13.1.e: O Agni, holy and divine with splendour and thy pleasant tongue. Bring thou the Gods and worship them!

13.1.s: abʰi vāyuṃ vītyarṣā gr̥ṇāno3 'bʰi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ abʰī naraṃ dʰījavanam̐ ratʰeṣṭʰāmabʰīndraṃ vr̥ṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhum
13.1.d: अभि वायुं वीत्यर्षा गृणानो३ ऽभि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः अभी नरं धीजवनꣳ रथेष्ठामभीन्द्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुम्
13.1.e: We pray thee bathed in butter, O bright-rayed! who lookest on the sun, Bring the Gods hither to the feast!

13.1.s: abʰi vastrā suvasanānyarṣābʰi dʰenūḥ sudugʰāḥ pūyamānaḥ abʰi candrā bʰarttave no hiraṇyābʰyaśvānratʰino deva soma
13.1.d: अभि वस्त्रा सुवसनान्यर्षाभि धेनूः सुदुघाः पूयमानः अभि चन्द्रा भर्त्तवे नो हिरण्याभ्यश्वान्रथिनो देव सोम
13.1.e: Sage, we have kindled thee, the bright, the feaster on oblation, thee, O Agni, great in sacrifice! XIV Agni I. Adorable in all our prayers, favour us, Agni, with thine aid. What time the psalm is chanted forth!

13.1.s: abʰī no arṣa divyā vasūnyabʰi viśvā pārtʰivā pūyamānaḥ abʰi yena draviṇamaśnavāmābʰyārṣeyaṃ jamadagnivannaḥ
13.1.d: अभी नो अर्ष दिव्या वसून्यभि विश्वा पार्थिवा पूयमानः अभि येन द्रविणमश्नवामाभ्यार्षेयं जमदग्निवन्नः
13.1.e: Bring to us ever-conquering wealth, wealth, Agni, worthy of our choice, Invincible in all our frays!

13.1.s: yajjāyatʰā apūrvya magʰavanvr̥trahatyāya tatpr̥tʰivīmapratʰayastadastabʰnā uto divam
13.1.d: यज्जायथा अपूर्व्य मघवन्वृत्रहत्याय तत्पृथिवीमप्रथयस्तदस्तभ्ना उतो दिवम्
13.1.e: Grant us, O Agni, through thy grace wealth to support us evermore, Thy favour so that we may live! XV Agni

13.1.s: tatte yajño ajāyata tadarka uta haskr̥tiḥ tadviśvamabʰibʰūrasi yajjātaṃ yacca jantvam
13.1.d: तत्ते यज्ञो अजायत तदर्क उत हस्कृतिः तद्विश्वमभिभूरसि यज्जातं यच्च जन्त्वम्
13.1.e: Let songs of ours speed Agni forth like a fleet courser in the race, And we will win each prize through him

13.1.s: āmāsu pakvamairaya ā sūryam̐ rohayo divi gʰarmaṃ na sāmaṃ tapatā suvr̥ktibʰirjuṣṭaṃ girvaṇase br̥hat
13.1.d: आमासु पक्वमैरय आ सूर्यꣳ रोहयो दिवि घर्मं न सामं तपता सुवृक्तिभिर्जुष्टं गिर्वणसे बृहत्
13.1.e: Agni! the host whereby we gain kine for ourselves with help from thee,- That send us for the gain of wealth!

13.1.s: matsyapāyi te mahaḥ pātrasyeva harivo matsaro madaḥ vr̥ṣā te vr̥ṣṇa indurvājī sahasrasātamaḥ
13.1.d: मत्स्यपायि ते महः पात्रस्येव हरिवो मत्सरो मदः वृषा ते वृष्ण इन्दुर्वाजी सहस्रसातमः
13.1.e: O Agni, bring us wealth secure, vast wealth in horses and in kine: Oil thou the socket, turn the wheel!

13.1.s: ā naste gantu matsaro vr̥ṣā mado vareṇyaḥ sahāvām̐ indra sānasiḥ pr̥tanaṣāḍamartyaḥ
13.1.d: आ नस्ते गन्तु मत्सरो वृषा मदो वरेण्यः सहावाꣳ इन्द्र सानसिः पृतनषाडमर्त्यः
13.1.e: O Agni, thou hast made the Sun, the eternal star, to mount the sky, Giving the boon of light to men.

13.1.s: tvam̐ hi śūraḥ sanitā codayo manuṣo ratʰam sahāvāndasyumavratamoṣaḥ pātraṃ na śociṣā
13.1.d: त्वꣳ हि शूरः सनिता चोदयो मनुषो रथम् सहावान्दस्युमव्रतमोषः पात्रं न शोचिषा
13.1.e: Thou, Agni, art the people's light, best, dearest, seated in thy shrine Watch for the singer, give him life! XVI Agni

13.1.s: pavasva vr̥ṣṭimā su no 'pāmūrmiṃ divaspari ayakṣmā br̥hatīriṣaḥ
13.1.d: पवस्व वृष्टिमा सु नो ऽपामूर्मिं दिवस्परि अयक्ष्मा बृहतीरिषः
13.1.e: Agni is head and height of heaven, the master of the earth is he: He quickeneth the waters' seed.

13.1.s: tayā pavasva dʰārayā yayā gāva ihāgaman janyāsa upa no gr̥ham
13.1.d: तया पवस्व धारया यया गाव इहागमन् जन्यास उप नो गृहम्
13.1.e: Yea, Agni, thou as Lord of light rulest o'er choicest gifts may I, Thy singer, find defence in thee

13.2.s: gʰr̥taṃ pavasva dʰārayā yajñeṣu devavītamaḥ asmabʰyaṃ vr̥ṣṭimā pava
13.2.d: घृतं पवस्व धारया यज्ञेषु देववीतमः अस्मभ्यं वृष्टिमा पव
13.2.e: Upward, O Agni, rise thy flames, pure and resplendent, blazing high, Thy lustres, fair effulgences. I Agni

13.2.s: sa na ūrje vyā3vyayaṃ pavitraṃ dʰāva dʰārayā devāsaḥ śr̥ṇavanhi kam
13.2.d: स न ऊर्जे व्या३व्ययं पवित्रं धाव धारया देवासः शृणवन्हि कम्
13.2.e: Who, Agni, is thy kin, of men? who honours thee with sacrifice? On whom dependent? who art thou?

13.2.s: pavamāno asiṣyadadrakṣām̐syapajaṅgʰanat pratnavadrocayanrucaḥ
13.2.d: पवमानो असिष्यदद्रक्षाꣳस्यपजङ्घनत् प्रत्नवद्रोचयन्रुचः
13.2.e: The kinsman, Agni! of mankind, their well-beiaved friend art thou, A friend whom friends may supplicate.

13.2.s: pratyasmai pipīṣate viśvāni viduṣe bʰara araṅgamāya jagmaye 'paścādadʰvane naraḥ
13.2.d: प्रत्यस्मै पिपीषते विश्वानि विदुषे भर अरङ्गमाय जग्मये ऽपश्चादध्वने नरः
13.2.e: Bring Mitra, Varukia, bring the Gods hither to. our great sacrifice: Bring them, O Agni, to thine home II Agni

13.2.s: emenaṃ pratyetana somebʰiḥ somapātamam amatrebʰirr̥jīṣiṇamindram̐ sutebʰirindubʰiḥ
13.2.d: एमेनं प्रत्येतन सोमेभिः सोमपातमम् अमत्रेभिरृजीषिणमिन्द्रꣳ सुतेभिरिन्दुभिः
13.2.e: Meet to be worshipped and implored, showing in beauty through the gloom, Agni, the strong, is kindled well.

13.2.s: yadī sutebʰirindubʰiḥ somebʰiḥ pratibʰūṣatʰa vedā viśvasya medʰiro dʰr̥ṣattantamideṣate
13.2.d: यदी सुतेभिरिन्दुभिः सोमेभिः प्रतिभूषथ वेदा विश्वस्य मेधिरो धृषत्तन्तमिदेषते
13.2.e: Strong Agni is enkindled well, even as the horse that brings the Gods: Men with oblations pray to him.

13.2.s: asmāasmā idandʰaso 'dʰvaryo pra bʰarā sutam kuvitsamasya jenyasya śardʰato 'bʰiśasteravasvarat
13.2.d: अस्माअस्मा इदन्धसो ऽध्वर्यो प्र भरा सुतम् कुवित्समस्य जेन्यस्य शर्धतो ऽभिशस्तेरवस्वरत्
13.2.e: We will enkindle thee, the strong, we, hero! who axe strong ourselves, III Agni

13.2.s: babʰrave nu svatavase 'ruṇāya divispr̥śe somāya gātʰamarcata
13.2.d: बभ्रवे नु स्वतवसे ऽरुणाय दिविस्पृशे सोमाय गाथमर्चत
13.2.e: Thy mighty flames, O Agni, when thou art enkindled, rise on high, Thy bright flames, thou refulgent one

13.2.s: hastacyutebʰiradribʰiḥ sutam̐ somaṃ punītana madʰāvā dʰāvatā madʰu
13.2.d: हस्तच्युतेभिरद्रिभिः सुतꣳ सोमं पुनीतन मधावा धावता मधु
13.2.e: Beloved! let my ladies full of sacred oil come nigh to thee. Agni, accept our offerings!

13.2.s: namasedupa sīdata dadʰnedabʰi śrīṇītana indumindre dadʰātana
13.2.d: नमसेदुप सीदत दध्नेदभि श्रीणीतन इन्दुमिन्द्रे दधातन
13.2.e: I pray to Agni--may he hear!--the Hotar with sweet tones, the Priest, Wondrously splendid, rich in light, V Agni

13.2.s: amitrahā vicarṣaṇiḥ pavasva soma śaṃ gave devebʰyo anukāmakr̥t
13.2.d: अमित्रहा विचर्षणिः पवस्व सोम शं गवे देवेभ्यो अनुकामकृत्
13.2.e: O King, the potent and terrific envoy, kindled for strength, is manifest in beauty. He shines, observant, with his lofty splendour; chasing black night he comes with white-rayed morning.

13.2.s: indrāya soma pātave madāya pari ṣicyase manaścinmanasaspatiḥ
13.2.d: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे मदाय परि षिच्यसे मनश्चिन्मनसस्पतिः
13.2.e: Having o'ercome the glimmering Black with beauty, and bringing forth the Dame, the great Sire's daughter, Holding aloft the radiant lights of Surya, as messenger of heaven he shines with treasures.

13.2.s: pavamāna suvīryam̐ rayim̐ soma rirīhi naḥ indavindreṇa no yujā
13.2.d: पवमान सुवीर्यꣳ रयिꣳ सोम रिरीहि नः इन्दविन्द्रेण नो युजा
13.2.e: Attendant on the blessed Dame the blessed hath come: the lover followeth his sister. Agni, far-spreading with conspicuous lustre, hath covered night with whitely-shining garments. VI Agni

13.2.s: uddʰedabʰi śrutāmagʰaṃ vr̥ṣamaṃ naryāpasam astārameṣi sūrya
13.2.d: उद्धेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषमं नर्यापसम् अस्तारमेषि सूर्य
13.2.e: What is the praise wherewith, O God, Angiras, Agni, Son of Strength, We, after thine own wish and thought,

13.2.s: nava yo navatiṃ puro bibʰeda bāhvojasā ahiṃ ca vr̥trahāvadʰīt
13.2.d: नव यो नवतिं पुरो बिभेद बाह्वोजसा अहिं च वृत्रहावधीत्
13.2.e: May serve thee, O thou Child of Power, and with what sacrifice's plan? What reverent word shall I speak here? VII Agni

13.2.s: sa na indraḥ śivaḥ sakʰāśvāvadgomadyavamat urudʰāreva dohate
13.2.d: स न इन्द्रः शिवः सखाश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत् उरुधारेव दोहते
13.2.e: Agni, come hither with thy fires; we choose thee as our Hotar; let The proffered ladle filled with offerings balm thee, best of priests, to sit on sacred grass!

13.2.s: vibʰrāḍ br̥hatpibatu somyaṃ madʰvāyurdadʰadyajñapatāvavihrutam vātajūto yo abʰirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ piparti bahudʰā vi rājati
13.2.d: विभ्राड् बृहत्पिबतु सोम्यं मध्वायुर्दधद्यज्ञपतावविह्रुतम् वातजूतो यो अभिरक्षति त्मना प्रजाः पिपर्ति बहुधा वि राजति
13.2.e: For unto thee, O Angiras, O Son of Strength, move ladles in the sacrifice. We pray to Agni, Child of Force, whose locks drop oil, foremost in sacrificial rites. VIII Agni

13.2.s: vibʰrāḍ br̥hatsubʰr̥taṃ vājasātamaṃ dʰarmaṃ divo dʰaruṇe satyamarpitam amitrahā vr̥trahā dasyuhantamaṃ jyotirjajñe asurahā sapatnahā
13.2.d: विभ्राड् बृहत्सुभृतं वाजसातमं धर्मं दिवो धरुणे सत्यमर्पितम् अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहन्तमं ज्योतिर्जज्ञे असुरहा सपत्नहा
13.2.e: Let our songs come anear to him beauteous and bright with piercing flame, Our sacrifices with our homage unto him much-lauded, very rich, for help:

13.2.s: idam̐ śreṣṭʰaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiruttamaṃ viśvajiddʰanajiducyate br̥hat viśvabʰrāḍ bʰrājo mahi sūryo dr̥śa uru papratʰe saha ojo acyutam
13.2.d: इदꣳ श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरुत्तमं विश्वजिद्धनजिदुच्यते बृहत् विश्वभ्राड् भ्राजो महि सूर्यो दृश उरु पप्रथे सह ओजो अच्युतम्
13.2.e: To Agni Jatavedas, to the Son of Strength, that he may give us precious gifts,

13.2.s: indra kratuṃ na ā bʰara pitā putrebʰyo yatʰā śikṣā ṇo asminpuruhūta yāmani jīva jyotiraśīmahi
13.2.d: इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा शिक्षा णो अस्मिन्पुरुहूत यामनि जीव ज्योतिरशीमहि
13.2.e: Immortal, from of old Priest among mortal men, whose tones are sweetest in the house! X Agni

13.2.s: mā no ajñātā vr̥janā durādʰyo3 māśivāso 'va kramuḥ tvayā vayaṃ pravataḥ śaśvatīrapo 'ti śūra tarāmasi
13.2.d: मा नो अज्ञाता वृजना दुराध्यो३ माशिवासो ऽव क्रमुः त्वया वयं प्रवतः शश्वतीरपो ऽति शूर तरामसि
13.2.e: Invincible is Agni, he who goes before the tribes of men, A chariot swift and ever new.

13.2.s: adyādyā śvaḥśva indra trāsva pare ca naḥ viśvā ca no jaritr̥̄ntsatpate ahā divā naktaṃ ca rakṣiṣaḥ
13.2.d: अद्याद्या श्वःश्व इन्द्र त्रास्व परे च नः विश्वा च नो जरितॄन्त्सत्पते अहा दिवा नक्तं च रक्षिषः
13.2.e: By bringing offerings unto him the mortal worshipper obtains A home from him whose light is pure.

13.2.s: prabʰaṅgī śūro magʰavā tuvīmagʰaḥ sammiślo viryāya kam ubʰā te bāhū vr̥ṣaṇā śatakrato ni yā vajraṃ mimikṣatuḥ
13.2.d: प्रभङ्गी शूरो मघवा तुवीमघः सम्मिश्लो विर्याय कम् उभा ते बाहू वृषणा शतक्रतो नि या वज्रं मिमिक्षतुः
13.2.e: Inviolable power of Gods, subduing all his enemies, Agni is mightiest in fame. XI Agni

13.2.s: janīyanto nvagravaḥ putrīyantaḥ sudānavaḥ sarasvantam̐ havāmahe
13.2.d: जनीयन्तो न्वग्रवः पुत्रीयन्तः सुदानवः सरस्वन्तꣳ हवामहे
13.2.e: May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss: may the gift, blessed one! and sacrifice bring bliss, Yea, may our eulogies bring bliss

13.2.s: uta naḥ priyā priyāsu saptasvasā sujuṣṭā sarasvatī stomyā bʰūt
13.2.d: उत नः प्रिया प्रियासु सप्तस्वसा सुजुष्टा सरस्वती स्तोम्या भूत्
13.2.e: Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fight! Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and for thy victory let us win! XII Agni

13.2.s: tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bʰargo devasya dʰīmahi dʰiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt
13.2.d: तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्
13.2.e: O Agni thou who art the Lord of wealth in kine, thou Son of Strength, Bestow on us, O Jatavedas, high renown

13.2.s: somānām̐ svaraṇaṃ kr̥ṇuhi brahmaṇaspate kakṣīvantam̐ ya auśijaḥ
13.2.d: सोमानाꣳ स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते कक्षीवन्तꣳ य औशिजः
13.2.e: He, Agni, kindled, good and wise, must be entreated with a. song; Shine, thou of many forms, shine thou with wealth on us

13.2.s: agna āyūm̐ṣi pavase ā suvorjaṃ iṣaṃ ca naḥ āre bādʰasva duccʰunām
13.2.d: अग्न आयूꣳषि पवसे आ सुवोर्जं इषं च नः आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम्
13.2.e: And, Agni, shining of thyself by night and when the morning breaks, Burn, thou whose teeth are sharp, against the Rakshasas XIII Agni

13.2.s: tā naḥ śaktaṃ pārtʰivasya maho rāyo divyasya mahi vā kṣatraṃ deveṣu
13.2.d: ता नः शक्तं पार्थिवस्य महो रायो दिव्यस्य महि वा क्षत्रं देवेषु
13.2.e: Exerting all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech, Agni, your dear familiar friend, the darling guest of every house:

13.2.s: r̥tamr̥tena sapanteṣiraṃ dakṣamāśāte adruhā devau vardʰete
13.2.d: ऋतमृतेन सपन्तेषिरं दक्षमाशाते अद्रुहा देवौ वर्धेते
13.2.e: Whom, served with sacrificial oil, like Mitra, men presenting gifts, Glorify with their songs of praise

13.2.s: vr̥ṣṭidyāvā rītyāpeṣaspatī dānumatyāḥ br̥hantaṃ garttamāśāte
13.2.d: वृष्टिद्यावा रीत्यापेषस्पती दानुमत्याः बृहन्तं गर्त्तमाशाते
13.2.e: Much-lauded Jatavedas, him who sends oblations up to heaven, Prepared in service of the Gods. XIV Agni

13.2.s: yuñjanti bradʰnamaruṣaṃ carantaṃ pari tastʰuṣaḥ rocante rocanā divi
13.2.d: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमरुषं चरन्तं परि तस्थुषः रोचन्ते रोचना दिवि
13.2.e: Agni, inflamed with fuel, in my song I sing, pure bright, and stedfast set in front at sacrifice. Wise Jatavedas we implore with prayers for grace, the Sage, the Hotar-priest, bounteous, and void of guile.

13.2.s: yuñjantyasya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā ratʰe śoṇā dʰr̥ṣṇū nr̥vāhasā
13.2.d: युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसा
13.2.e: Men, Agni, in each age, have made thee, deathless one, their envoy, offering-bearer, guard adorable. With reverence Gods and mortals have established thee as everwatchful and almighty household Lord.

13.2.s: ketuṃ kr̥ṇvannaketave peśo maryā apeśase samuṣadbʰirajāyatʰāḥ
13.2.d: केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे समुषद्भिरजायथाः
13.2.e: Though, Agni ordering the works and ways of both, as envoy of the Gods traversest both the realms. When we lay claim to thy regard and gracious care, be thou to us a th rice- protecting friendly guard? XV Agni

13.2.s: ayam̐ soma indra tubʰyam̐ sunve tubʰyaṃ pavate tvamasya pāhi tvam̐ ha yaṃ cakr̥ṣe tvaṃ vavr̥ṣa induṃ madāya yujyāya somam
13.2.d: अयꣳ सोम इन्द्र तुभ्यꣳ सुन्वे तुभ्यं पवते त्वमस्य पाहि त्वꣳ ह यं चकृषे त्वं ववृष इन्दुं मदाय युज्याय सोमम्
13.2.e: Still turning to their aim in thee the sacrificer's sister hymns Have come to thee before the wind.

13.2.s: sa īm̐ ratʰo na bʰuriṣāḍayoji mahaḥ purūṇi sātaye vasūni ādīṃ viśvā nahuṣyāṇi jātā svarṣātā vana ūrdʰvā navanta
13.2.d: स ईꣳ रथो न भुरिषाडयोजि महः पुरूणि सातये वसूनि आदीं विश्वा नहुष्याणि जाता स्वर्षाता वन ऊर्ध्वा नवन्त
13.2.e: Even the waters find their place in him whose three fold sacred grass Is spread unbound, unlimited.

13.3.s: śuṣmī śardʰo na mārutaṃ pavasvānabʰiśastā divyā yatʰā viṭ āpo na makṣū sumatirbʰavā naḥ sahasrāpsāḥ pr̥tanāṣāṇna yajñaḥ
13.3.d: शुष्मी शर्धो न मारुतं पवस्वानभिशस्ता दिव्या यथा विट् आपो न मक्षू सुमतिर्भवा नः सहस्राप्साः पृतनाषाण्न यज्ञः
13.3.e: The station of the bounteous God, by his unconquerable aid, Hath a fair aspect like the Sun. I Indra

13.3.s: tvamagne yajñānām̐ hotā viśveṣām̐ hitaḥ devebʰirmānuṣe jane
13.3.d: त्वमग्ने यज्ञानाꣳ होता विश्वेषाꣳ हितः देवेभिर्मानुषे जने
13.3.e: Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first. The Ribhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first.

13.3.s: sa no mandrābʰiradʰvare jihvābʰiryajā mahaḥ ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca
13.3.d: स नो मन्द्राभिरध्वरे जिह्वाभिर्यजा महः आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च
13.3.e: Indra, at sacrifice, increased his manly strength, in the wild rapture of this juice: And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their praises to his majesty. II Indra-Agni

13.3.s: vettʰā hi vedʰo adʰvanaḥ patʰaśca devāñjasā agne yajñeṣu sukrato
13.3.d: वेत्था हि वेधो अध्वनः पथश्च देवाञ्जसा अग्ने यज्ञेषु सुक्रतो
13.3.e: Indra and Agni! singers skilled in melody, with lauds, hymn you: I choose you both to bring me food.

13.3.s: hotā devo amartyaḥ purastādeti māyayā vidatʰāni pracodayan
13.3.d: होता देवो अमर्त्यः पुरस्तादेति मायया विदथानि प्रचोदयन्
13.3.e: Indra and Agni! ye shook down, together, with one mightyr deed, The ninety forts which Dasas held.

13.3.s: vājī vājeṣu dʰīyate 'dʰvareṣu pra ṇīyate vipro yajñasya sādʰanaḥ
13.3.d: वाजी वाजेषु धीयते ऽध्वरेषु प्र णीयते विप्रो यज्ञस्य साधनः
13.3.e: To Indra and to Agni prayers go forward from the holy task, Along the path of sacred Law.

13.3.s: dʰiyā cakre vareṇyo bʰūtānāṃ garbʰamā dadʰe dakṣasya pitaraṃ tanā
13.3.d: धिया चक्रे वरेण्यो भूतानां गर्भमा दधे दक्षस्य पितरं तना
13.3.e: Indra and Agni, powers are yours, yours are oblations ano abodes: Good is your zealous energy. III Indra

13.3.s: ā sute siñcata śriyam̐ rodasyorabʰiśriyam rasā dadʰīta vr̥ṣabʰam
13.3.d: आ सुते सिञ्चत श्रियꣳ रोदस्योरभिश्रियम् रसा दधीत वृषभम्
13.3.e: Indra, with all thy saving helps assist us, Lord of power and might! For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, hero, finder-out of wealth!

13.3.s: te jānata svamokyā3m̐ saṃ vatsāso na mātr̥bʰiḥ mitʰo nasanta jāmibʰiḥ
13.3.d: ते जानत स्वमोक्या३ꣳ सं वत्सासो न मातृभिः मिथो नसन्त जामिभिः
13.3.e: Increaser of our steeds and multiplying kine, a golden well, G God, art thou, For no one may impair the gift laid up in thee. Bring me whatever thing I ask! IV Indra

13.3.s: upa srakveṣu bapsataḥ kr̥ṇvate dʰaruṇaṃ divi indre agnā namaḥ svaḥ
13.3.d: उप स्रक्वेषु बप्सतः कृण्वते धरुणं दिवि इन्द्रे अग्ना नमः स्वः
13.3.e: For thou--come to the worshipper!--wilt find great wealth to make us rich. Fill thyself full, O Maghavan, for gain of kine, full, Indra, forthe gain of steeds!

13.3.s: tadidāsa bʰuvaneṣu jyeṣṭaṃ yato jajñā ugrastveṣanr̥mṇaḥ sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yaṃ viśve madantyūmāḥ
13.3.d: तदिदास भुवनेषु ज्येष्टं यतो जज्ञा उग्रस्त्वेषनृम्णः सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रूननु यं विश्वे मदन्त्यूमाः
13.3.e: Thou as thy gift bestowest many hundred herds, yea, many thou-sands dost thou give. With singers' hymns have we brought the fortrender near, singing to Indra for his grace. V Agni

13.3.s: vāvr̥dʰānaḥ śavasā bʰūryojāḥ śatrurdāsāya bʰiyasaṃ dadʰāti avyanacca vyanacca sasni saṃ te navanta prabʰr̥tā madeṣu
13.3.d: वावृधानः शवसा भूर्योजाः शत्रुर्दासाय भियसं दधाति अव्यनच्च व्यनच्च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेषु
13.3.e: To him who dealeth out all wealth, the sweet-toned Hotar-priest of men, To him, like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni let the lauds go forth!

13.3.s: tve kratumapi vr̥ñjanti viśve dviryadete trirbʰavantyūmāḥ svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sr̥jā samadaḥ su madʰu madʰunābʰi yodʰīḥ
13.3.d: त्वे क्रतुमपि वृञ्जन्ति विश्वे द्विर्यदेते त्रिर्भवन्त्यूमाः स्वादोः स्वादीयः स्वादुना सृजा समदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीः
13.3.e: Votaries, bounteous givers, deck him with their songs, even as the steed who draws the car. To both, strong Lord of men! to kith and kin convey the bounties of our wealthy lords! VI Varuna

13.3.s: trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiraṃ tuviśuṣmastr̥mpatsomamapibadviṣṇunā sutaṃ yatʰāvaśam sa īṃ mamāda mahi karma kartave mahāmurum̐ sainam̐ saścaddevo devam̐ satya induḥ satyamindram
13.3.d: त्रिकद्रुकेषु महिषो यवाशिरं तुविशुष्मस्तृम्पत्सोममपिबद्विष्णुना सुतं यथावशम् स ईं ममाद महि कर्म कर्तवे महामुरुꣳ सैनꣳ सश्चद्देवो देवꣳ सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम्
13.3.e: Hear this my call, O Varuna, and show thy gracious love today: Desiring help I long for thee! VII Indra

13.3.s: sākaṃ jātaḥ kratunā sākamojasā vavakṣitʰa sākaṃ vr̥ddʰo vīryaiḥ sāsahirmr̥dʰo vicarṣaṇiḥ dātā rādʰa stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu pracetana sainam̐ saścaddevo devam̐ satya induḥ satyamindram
13.3.d: साकं जातः क्रतुना साकमोजसा ववक्षिथ साकं वृद्धो वीर्यैः सासहिर्मृधो विचर्षणिः दाता राध स्तुवते काम्यं वसु प्रचेतन सैनꣳ सश्चद्देवो देवꣳ सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम्
13.3.e: O Hero, with what aid dost thou delight us, with what succour bring, Riches to those who worship thee? VIII Indra

13.3.s: adʰa tviṣīmām̐ abʰyojasā kr̥viṃ yudʰābʰavadā rodasī apr̥ṇadasya majmanā pra vāvr̥dʰe adʰattānyaṃ jaṭʰare premaricyata pra cetaya sainam̐ saścaddevo devam̐ satya induḥ satyamindram
13.3.d: अध त्विषीमाꣳ अभ्योजसा कृविं युधाभवदा रोदसी अपृणदस्य मज्मना प्र वावृधे अधत्तान्यं जठरे प्रेमरिच्यत प्र चेतय सैनꣳ सश्चद्देवो देवꣳ सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम्
13.3.e: Indra, for service of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds, Indra, as worshippers, in battle-shock we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.

13.3.s: abʰi pra gopatiṃ girendramarca yatʰā vide mūnum̐ satyasya satpatim
13.3.d: अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे मूनुꣳ सत्यस्य सत्पतिम्
13.3.e: With might hath Indra spread out heaven and earth, with power hath indra lighten up the Sun. In Indra are all creatures closely held; in him meet the distilling Soma-drops. IX Visvakarman

13.3.s: ā harayaḥ sasr̥jrire 'ruṣīradʰi barhiṣi yatrābʰi saṃnavāmahe
13.3.d: आ हरयः ससृज्रिरे ऽरुषीरधि बर्हिषि यत्राभि संनवामहे
13.3.e: Bring, Visvakarman strengthened by oblation, thyself, thy body-'tis thine own-for worship Let other men around us live in folly here let us have', a rich and liberal patron! X Soma Pavamana

13.3.s: indrāya gāva āśiraṃ duduhre vajriṇe madʰu yatsīmupahvare vidat
13.3.d: इन्द्राय गाव आशिरं दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु यत्सीमुपह्वरे विदत्
13.3.e: With this his golden splendour purifying him, he with his own allies subdues all enemies. as Sura with his own allies. Cleansing himself with stream of juice he shines forth yellow-hued and red, when with his praisers he encompasses all forms, with praisers having seven mouths.

13.3.s: ā no viśvāsu havyamindram̐ samatsu bʰūṣata upa brahmāṇi savanāni vr̥trahanparamajyā r̥cīṣama
13.3.d: आ नो विश्वासु हव्यमिन्द्रꣳ समत्सु भूषत उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहन्परमज्या ऋचीषम
13.3.e: He moves intelligent directed to the east. The every beauteous car rivals the beams of light, the beautiful celestial car. Hymns, lauding manly valour, came inciting Indra to success, that ye may be unconquered, both thy bolt and thou, both be unconquered in the war.

13.3.s: tvaṃ dātā pratʰamo rādʰasāmasyasi satya īśānakr̥t tuvidyumnasya yujyā vr̥ṇīmahe putrasya śavaso mahaḥ
13.3.d: त्वं दाता प्रथमो राधसामस्यसि सत्य ईशानकृत् तुविद्युम्नस्य युज्या वृणीमहे पुत्रस्य शवसो महः
13.3.e: That treasure of the Panis thou discoveredst. Thou with the Mothers deckest thee in thine abode, with, songs of worship in thine home. As 'twere from far away is heard the psalm where hymns resound in joy. He, with the triple Dames red-hued, hath won life-power, he, gleaming, hath won vital strength. XI Pusan

13.3.s: pratnaṃ pīyūṣaṃ pūrvyaṃ yaduktʰyaṃ maho gāhaddiva ā niradʰukṣata indramabʰi jāyamānam̐ samasvaran
13.3.d: प्रत्नं पीयूषं पूर्व्यं यदुक्थ्यं महो गाहद्दिव आ निरधुक्षत इन्द्रमभि जायमानꣳ समस्वरन्
13.3.e: Yea, cause our hymn to gain for us cattle and steeds and store of wealth, That it may help us manfully! XII Maruts

13.3.s: ādīṃ ke citpaśyamānāsa āpyaṃ vasuruco divyā abʰyanūṣata divo na vāram̐ savitā vyūrṇute
13.3.d: आदीं के चित्पश्यमानास आप्यं वसुरुचो दिव्या अभ्यनूषत दिवो न वारꣳ सविता व्यूर्णुते
13.3.e: Heroes of real strength, ye mark either the sweat of him who toils, Or his desire who supplicates. XIII Visvedevas

13.3.s: adʰa yadime pavamāna rodasī imā ca viśvā bʰuvanābʰi majmanā yūtʰe na niṣṭʰā vr̥ṣabʰo vi rājasi
13.3.d: अध यदिमे पवमान रोदसी इमा च विश्वा भुवनाभि मज्मना यूथे न निष्ठा वृषभो वि राजसि
13.3.e: The Sons of immortality shall listen to our songs of praise, And be exceeding kind to us. XIV Heaven and Earth

13.3.s: imamū ṣu tvamasmākam̐ saniṃ gāyatraṃ navyām̐sam agne deveṣu pra vocaḥ
13.3.d: इममू षु त्वमस्माकꣳ सनिं गायत्रं नव्याꣳसम् अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः
13.3.e: To both of you, O Heaven and Earth, we bring our lofty song of praise, Pure pair! to glorify you both.

13.3.s: vibʰaktāsi citrabʰāno sindʰorūrmā upāka ā sadyo dāśuṣe kṣarasi
13.3.d: विभक्तासि चित्रभानो सिन्धोरूर्मा उपाक आ सद्यो दाशुषे क्षरसि
13.3.e: Ye sanctify each other's form by your own proper strength ye rule: Further the sacrifice evermore!

13.3.s: ā no bʰaja parameṣvā vājeṣu madʰyameṣu śikṣā vasvo antamasya
13.3.d: आ नो भज परमेष्वा वाजेषु मध्यमेषु शिक्षा वस्वो अन्तमस्य
13.3.e: Promoting and fulfilling, ye, mighty ones, perfect Mitra's law: Ye sit around our sacrifice. XV Indra

13.3.s: ahamiddʰi pituṣpari medʰāmr̥tasya jagraha aham̐ sūrya ivājani
13.3.d: अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रह अहꣳ सूर्य इवाजनि
13.3.e: This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest, too, for this our prayer.

13.3.s: ahaṃ pratnena janmanā giraḥ śumbʰāmi kaṇvavat yenendraḥ śuṣmamiddadʰe
13.3.d: अहं प्रत्नेन जन्मना गिरः शुम्भामि कण्ववत् येनेन्द्रः शुष्ममिद्दधे
13.3.e: O hero, Lord of bounties, praised in hymns, may glorious fame and might Be his who sings the laud to thee

13.3.s: ye tvāmindra na tuṣṭuvurr̥ṣayo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ mamedvardʰasva suṣṭutaḥ
13.3.d: ये त्वामिन्द्र न तुष्टुवुरृषयो ये च तुष्टुवुः ममेद्वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः
13.3.e: Lord of a Hundred Powers, rise up to be our succour in this fight: In other fights let us agree XVI Oblations

13.3.s: agne viśvebʰiragnibʰirjoṣi brahma sahaskr̥ta ye devatrā ya āyuṣu tebʰirno mahayā giraḥ
13.3.d: अग्ने विश्वेभिरग्निभिर्जोषि ब्रह्म सहस्कृत ये देवत्रा य आयुषु तेभिर्नो महया गिरः
13.3.e: Ye cows, protect the fount: the two mighty ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.

13.3.s: pra sa viśvebʰiragnibʰiragniḥ sa yasya vājinaḥ tanaye toke asmadā samyaṅvājaiḥ parīvr̥taḥ
13.3.d: प्र स विश्वेभिरग्निभिरग्निः स यस्य वाजिनः तनये तोके अस्मदा सम्यङ्वाजैः परीवृतः
13.3.e: The pressing-stones are set at work: the meath is poured into the tank At the out-shedding of the fount.

13.3.s: tvaṃ no agne agnibʰirbrahma yajñaṃ ca vardʰaya tvaṃ no devatātaye rāyo dānāya codaya
13.3.d: त्वं नो अग्ने अग्निभिर्ब्रह्म यज्ञं च वर्धय त्वं नो देवतातये रायो दानाय चोदय
13.3.e: With reverence they drain the fount that circles with its wheel above. Exhaustless, with the mouth below. XVII Indra

13.3.s: tve soma pratʰamā vr̥ktabarhiṣo mahe vājāya śravase dʰiyan dadʰuḥ sa tvaṃ no vīra vīryāya codaya
13.3.d: त्वे सोम प्रथमा वृक्तबर्हिषो महे वाजाय श्रवसे धियन् दधुः स त्वं नो वीर वीर्याय चोदय
13.3.e: Let us not tire or be afraid with thee, the mighty, for our friend! May we see Turvasa and Yadu! thy great deed, O hero, must be glorified.

13.3.s: abʰyabʰi hi śravasā tatarditʰotsaṃ na kaṃ cijjanapānamakṣitam śaryābʰirna bʰaramāṇo gabʰastyoḥ
13.3.d: अभ्यभि हि श्रवसा ततर्दिथोत्सं न कं चिज्जनपानमक्षितम् शर्याभिर्न भरमाणो गभस्त्योः
13.3.e: On his left hip the hero hath reclined himself: the proffered feast offends him not. The milk is blended with the honey of the bee: quickly come hither, haste, and drink! XVIII Indra

13.3.s: ajījano amr̥ta martyāya amr̥tasya dʰarmannamr̥tasya cāruṇaḥ sadāsaro vājamaccʰā saniṣyadat
13.3.d: अजीजनो अमृत मर्त्याय अमृतस्य धर्मन्नमृतस्य चारुणः सदासरो वाजमच्छा सनिष्यदत्
13.3.e: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth! Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.

13.3.s: endumindrāya siñcata pibāti somyaṃ madʰu pra rādʰām̐si codayate mahitvanā
13.3.d: एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु प्र राधाꣳसि चोदयते महित्वना
13.3.e: He, when a thousand Rishis have enhanced his might, hath like an ocean spread himself. His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule. XIX Indra

13.3.s: upo harīṇāṃ patim̐ rādʰaḥ pr̥ñcantamabravam nūnam̐ śrudʰi stuvato aśvyasya
13.3.d: उपो हरीणां पतिꣳ राधः पृञ्चन्तमब्रवम् नूनꣳ श्रुधि स्तुवतो अश्व्यस्य
13.3.e: Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Aryas, Dasas here belong. Directly unto thee, the pious Rusama Paviru, is that wealth brought nigh.

13.3.s: na hyāṅ3ga purā ca na jajñe vīratarastvat na kī rāyā naivatʰā na bʰandanā
13.3.d: न ह्याङ्३ग पुरा च न जज्ञे वीरतरस्त्वत् न की राया नैवथा न भन्दना
13.3.e: In zealous haste the singers have sung forth a song distilling fatness, rich in sweets. Riches have spread among us and heroic strength, with us are flowing Soma-drops. XX Soma Pavamana

13.3.s: nadaṃ va odatīnāṃ nadaṃ yoyuvatīnām patiṃ vo agʰnyānāṃ dʰenūnāmiṣudʰyasi
13.3.d: नदं व ओदतीनां नदं योयुवतीनाम् पतिं वो अघ्न्यानां धेनूनामिषुध्यसि
13.3.e: Flow to us, Indu, very strong, effused, with wealth of kine and steeds, And do thou lay above the milk thy radiant hue

13.3.s: devo vo draviṇodāḥ pūrṇāṃ vivaṣṭvāsicam udvā siñcadʰvamupa vā pr̥ṇadʰvamādidvo deva ohate
13.3.d: देवो वो द्रविणोदाः पूर्णां विवष्ट्वासिचम् उद्वा सिञ्चध्वमुप वा पृणध्वमादिद्वो देव ओहते
13.3.e: Lord of the tawny, Indu, thou who art the Gods' most special food, As friend to friend, for splendour be thou good to men!

13.3.s: tam̐ hotāramadʰvarasya pracetasaṃ vahniṃ devā akr̥ṇvata dadʰāti ratnaṃ vidʰate suvīryamagnirjanāya dāśuṣe
13.3.d: तꣳ होतारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं वह्निं देवा अकृण्वत दधाति रत्नं विधते सुवीर्यमग्निर्जनाय दाशुषे
13.3.e: Drive utterly, far away from us each godless, each voracious; foe; O Indu, overcome and drive the false afar! XXI Soma Pavamana.

13.3.s: adarśi gātuvittamo yasminvratānyādadʰuḥ upoṣu jātamāryasya vardʰanamagniṃ nakṣantu no giraḥ
13.3.d: अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः उपोषु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्तु नो गिरः
13.3.e: They balm him, balm him over, balm him thoroughly, caress. the mighty strength and balm it with the meath. They seize the flying Steer at the stream's breathing place cleansing with gold they grasp the animal herein.

13.3.s: yasmādrejanta kr̥ṣṭayaścarkr̥tyāni kr̥ṇvataḥ sahasrasāṃ medʰasātāviva tmanāgniṃ dʰībʰirnamasyata
13.3.d: यस्माद्रेजन्त कृष्टयश्चर्कृत्यानि कृण्वतः सहस्रसां मेधसाताविव त्मनाग्निं धीभिर्नमस्यत
13.3.e: Sing forth to Pavamana skilled in holy song! the juice is flowing onward like a mighty stream. He glideth like a serpent from his ancient skin, and like a. playful horse the tawny Steer hath run.

14.1.s: pra daivodāso agnirdeva indro na majmanā anu mātaraṃ pr̥tʰivīṃ vi vāvr̥te tastʰau nākasya śarmaṇi
14.1.d: प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देव इन्द्रो न मज्मना अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य शर्मणि
14.1.e: Dweller in floods, King, foremost, he displays his might, set among living things as measure of days. Distilling oil he flows, fair, billowy, golden-hued, borne on car of light, sharing on home with wealth. I Agni

14.1.s: agna āyūm̐ṣi pavase āsuvorjamiṣaṃ ca naḥ āre bādʰasva duccʰunām
14.1.d: अग्न आयूꣳषि पवसे आसुवोर्जमिषं च नः आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम्
14.1.e: With all thy fires, O Agni, find pleasure in this our sacrifice, And this our speech, O son of Strength!

14.1.s: agnirr̥ṣiḥ pavamānaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ purohitaḥ tamīmahe mahāgayam
14.1.d: अग्निरृषिः पवमानः पाञ्चजन्यः पुरोहितः तमीमहे महागयम्
14.1.e: Whate'er, in this perpetual course, we sacrifice to God and God, That gift is offered but in thee.

14.1.s: agne pavasva svapā asme varcaḥ suvīryam dadʰadrayiṃ mayi yoṣam
14.1.d: अग्ने पवस्व स्वपा अस्मे वर्चः सुवीर्यम् दधद्रयिं मयि योषम्
14.1.e: May he be our beloved King and excellent sweet-toned Hotar may We with bright fires be dear to him II Indra

14.1.s: agne pāvaka rociṣā mandrayā deva jihvayā ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca
14.1.d: अग्ने पावक रोचिषा मन्द्रया देव जिह्वया आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च
14.1.e: For you from every side we call Indra away from other men Ours, and none others, may he be!

14.1.s: taṃ tvā gʰr̥tasnavīmahe citrabʰāno svardr̥śam devām̐ ā vītaye vaha
14.1.d: तं त्वा घृतस्नवीमहे चित्रभानो स्वर्दृशम् देवाꣳ आ वीतये वह
14.1.e: Unclose, our manly hero! thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud For us, thou irresistible

14.1.s: vītihotraṃ tvā kave dyumantam̐ samidʰīmahi agne br̥hantamadʰvare
14.1.d: वीतिहोत्रं त्वा कवे द्युमन्तꣳ समिधीमहि अग्ने बृहन्तमध्वरे
14.1.e: As the strong bull leads on the herds, he stirs the people with his might, The ruler irresistible. III Agni

14.1.s: avā no agna ūtibʰirgāyatrasya prabʰarmaṇi viśvāsu dʰīṣu vandya
14.1.d: अवा नो अग्न ऊतिभिर्गायत्रस्य प्रभर्मणि विश्वासु धीषु वन्द्य
14.1.e: Wonderful, with thy saving help, send us thy bounties, gracious Lord! Thou art the charioteer, Agni, of earthly wealth: find rest and safety for our seed!

14.1.s: ā no agne rayiṃ bʰara satrāsāhaṃ vareṇyam viśvāsu pr̥tsu duṣṭaram
14.1.d: आ नो अग्ने रयिं भर सत्रासाहं वरेण्यम् विश्वासु पृत्सु दुष्टरम्
14.1.e: Prosper our kith and kin with thy protecting powers inviolate, never negligent! Keep far from us, O Agni, all celestial wrath. and wickedness of godless men! IV Vishnu

14.1.s: ā no agne sucetunā rayiṃ viśvāyupoṣasam mārḍīkaṃ dʰehi jīvase
14.1.d: आ नो अग्ने सुचेतुना रयिं विश्वायुपोषसम् मार्डीकं धेहि जीवसे
14.1.e: What, Vishnu, is the name that thou proclaimest when thou declaredst, I am Sipivishta? Hide not this form from us, nor keep it secret, since thou didst wear another shape in battle.

14.1.s: agnim̐ hinvantu no dʰiyaḥ saptimāśumivājiṣu tena jeṣma dʰanaṃdʰanam
14.1.d: अग्निꣳ हिन्वन्तु नो धियः सप्तिमाशुमिवाजिषु तेन जेष्म धनंधनम्
14.1.e: This offering to-day, O Sipivishta, I, skilled in rules, extol, to thee the noble. Yea, I, the poor and weak, praise thee, the mighty, who dwellest in the realm beyond this region.

14.1.s: yayā gā ākarāmahai senayāgne tavotyā tāṃ no hinva magʰattaye
14.1.d: यया गा आकरामहै सेनयाग्ने तवोत्या तां नो हिन्व मघत्तये
14.1.e: O Vishnu, unto thee my lips cry Vashat! Let this mine offering, Sipivishta, please thee! May these my songs of eulogy exalt thee! Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings! V Vayu, Indra and Vayu I. Vayu, the bright is offered thee, best of the meath, at morning rites. Come thou to drink the Soma juice, God, longed for on thy team-drawn car!

14.1.s: āgne stʰūram̐ rayiṃ bʰara pr̥tʰuṃ gomantamaśvinam aṅdʰi kʰaṃ varttayā pavim
14.1.d: आग्ने स्थूरꣳ रयिं भर पृथुं गोमन्तमश्विनम् अङ्धि खं वर्त्तया पविम्
14.1.e: O Vayu, thou and Indra are meet drinkers of these Soma draughts, For unto you the drops proceed like waters gathering to the vale.

14.1.s: agne nakṣatramajaramā sūryam̐ rohayo divi dadʰajjyotirjanebʰyaḥ
14.1.d: अग्ने नक्षत्रमजरमा सूर्यꣳ रोहयो दिवि दधज्ज्योतिर्जनेभ्यः
14.1.e: Vayu and Indra, mighty twain, borne on one chariot, Lords of strength, Come to ouf succour with your steeds, that ye may drink the Soma juice! VI Soma Pavamana

14.1.s: agne keturviśāmasi preṣṭʰaḥ śreṣṭʰa upastʰasat bodʰā stotre vayo dadʰat
14.1.d: अग्ने केतुर्विशामसि प्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठ उपस्थसत् बोधा स्तोत्रे वयो दधत्
14.1.e: Then thou, made beautiful by night, enterest into mighty deeds, When prayers impel the golden-hued to hasten from Vivasvan's place.

14.1.s: agnirmūrdʰā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pr̥tʰivyā ayam apām̐ retām̐si jinvati
14.1.d: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम् अपाꣳ रेताꣳसि जिन्वति
14.1.e: We cleanse this gladdening drink of his, the juice which Indra chiefly drinks, That which kine took into their mouths, oF old, and princes take it now.

14.1.s: īśiṣe vāryasya hi dātrasyāgne svaḥpatiḥ stotā syāṃ tava śarmaṇi
14.1.d: ईशिषे वार्यस्य हि दात्रस्याग्ने स्वःपतिः स्तोता स्यां तव शर्मणि
14.1.e: Thy with the ancient psalm have sung to him as he is purified, And sacred songs which bear the Dames of Gods have supplicated him. VI Agni

14.1.s: udagne śucayastava śukrā bʰrājanta īrate tava jyotīm̐ṣyarcayaḥ
14.1.d: उदग्ने शुचयस्तव शुक्रा भ्राजन्त ईरते तव ज्योतीꣳष्यर्चयः
14.1.e: With homage will I reverence thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial Lord of holy rites.

14.1.s: kaste jāmirjanānāmagne ko dāśvadʰvaraḥ ko ha kasminnasi śritaḥ
14.1.d: कस्ते जामिर्जनानामग्ने को दाश्वध्वरः को ह कस्मिन्नसि श्रितः
14.1.e: May the far-striding Son of Strength, our friend who brings felicity, Who pours his gifts like rain, be ours

14.1.s: tvaṃ jāmirjanānāmagne mitro asi priyaḥ sakʰā sakʰibʰya īḍyaḥ
14.1.d: त्वं जामिर्जनानामग्ने मित्रो असि प्रियः सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः
14.1.e: From near and far away do thou, the everlasting, evermore Protect us from the sinful man! VIII Indra

14.1.s: yajā no mitrāvaruṇā yajā devām̐ r̥taṃ br̥hat agne yakṣi svaṃ damam
14.1.d: यजा नो मित्रावरुणा यजा देवाꣳ ऋतं बृहत् अग्ने यक्षि स्वं दमम्
14.1.e: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher!

14.1.s: īḍenyo namasyastirastamām̐si darśataḥ samagniridʰyate vr̥ṣā
14.1.d: ईडेन्यो नमस्यस्तिरस्तमाꣳसि दर्शतः समग्निरिध्यते वृषा
14.1.e: The earth and heaven cling close to thy victorious might, as sire and mother to their child. When thou attackest Vritra, all the hostile bands shrink and faint, Indra, at thy wrath. IX Indra

14.1.s: vr̥ṣo agniḥ samidʰyate 'śvo na devavāhanaḥ tam̐ haviṣmanta īḍate
14.1.d: वृषो अग्निः समिध्यते ऽश्वो न देववाहनः तꣳ हविष्मन्त ईडते
14.1.e: The sacrifice made Indra great when he unrolled the earth, and made Himself a diadem in heaven.

14.1.s: vr̥ṣaṇaṃ tvā vayaṃ vr̥ṣanvr̥ṣaṇaḥ samidʰīmahi agne dīdyataṃ br̥hat
14.1.d: वृषणं त्वा वयं वृषन्वृषणः समिधीमहि अग्ने दीद्यतं बृहत्
14.1.e: In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light, When he cleft Vala limb from limb.

14.1.s: utte br̥hanto arcayaḥ samidʰānasya dīdivaḥ agne śukrāsa īrate
14.1.d: उत्ते बृहन्तो अर्चयः समिधानस्य दीदिवः अग्ने शुक्रास ईरते
14.1.e: Showing the hidden, he drave forth the cows for the Angirasas, And Vala he cast headlong down. X Indra

14.1.s: upa tvā juhvo3 mama gʰr̥tācīryantu haryata agne havyā juṣasva naḥ
14.1.d: उप त्वा जुह्वो३ मम घृताचीर्यन्तु हर्यत अग्ने हव्या जुषस्व नः
14.1.e: Thou speedest down to succour us this-ever-conquering God of yours, Him who is drawn to all our songs; 2, The warrior whom none may wound, the Soma-drinker ne'er o'erthrown, The chieftain of resistless might.

14.1.s: mandram̐ hotāramr̥tvijaṃ citrabʰānuṃ vibʰāvasum agnimīḍe sa u śravat
14.1.d: मन्द्रꣳ होतारमृत्विजं चित्रभानुं विभावसुम् अग्निमीडे स उ श्रवत्
14.1.e: O Indra, send us riches, thou omniscient, worthy of our hymns: Help us in the decisive fray! XI Indra

14.1.s: pāhi no agna ekayā pāhyū3ta dvitīyayā pāhi gīrbʰistisr̥bʰirūrjāṃ pate pāhi catasr̥bʰirvaso
14.1.d: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्यू३त द्वितीयया पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो
14.1.e: That lofty power and might of thine, thy strength and thine intelligence, And thy surpassing thunderbolt, the wish makes keen.

14.1.s: pāhi viśvasmādrakṣaso arāvṇaḥ pra sma vājeṣu no 'va tvāmiddʰi nediṣṭʰaṃ devatātaya āpiṃ nakṣāmahe vr̥dʰe
14.1.d: पाहि विश्वस्माद्रक्षसो अराव्णः प्र स्म वाजेषु नो ऽव त्वामिद्धि नेदिष्ठं देवतातय आपिं नक्षामहे वृधे
14.1.e: O Indra, heaven and earth augment thy manly force and thy renown: The waters and the mountains stir and urge thee on:

14.1.s: ino rājannaratiḥ samiddʰo raudro dakṣāya suṣumām̐ adarśi cikidvi bʰāti bʰāsā br̥hatāsiknīmeti ruśatīmapājan
14.1.d: इनो राजन्नरतिः समिद्धो रौद्रो दक्षाय सुषुमाꣳ अदर्शि चिकिद्वि भाति भासा बृहतासिक्नीमेति रुशतीमपाजन्
14.1.e: Vishnu in the lofty ruling power, Varuna, Mitra sing thy praise: In thee the Maruts' company have great delight. XII Agni

14.1.s: kr̥ṣṇāṃ yadenīmabʰi varpasābʰūjjanayanyoṣāṃ br̥hataḥ piturjām ūrdʰvaṃ bʰānum̐ sūryasya stabʰāyandivo vasubʰiraratirvi bʰāti
14.1.d: कृष्णां यदेनीमभि वर्पसाभूज्जनयन्योषां बृहतः पितुर्जाम् ऊर्ध्वं भानुꣳ सूर्यस्य स्तभायन्दिवो वसुभिररतिर्वि भाति
14.1.e: O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength: With terrors trouble thou the foe

14.1.s: bʰadro bʰadrayā sacamāna āgātsvasāraṃ jāro abʰyeti paścāt supraketairdyubʰiragnirvitiṣṭʰanruśadbʰirvarṇairabʰi rāmamastʰāt
14.1.d: भद्रो भद्रया सचमान आगात्स्वसारं जारो अभ्येति पश्चात् सुप्रकेतैर्द्युभिरग्निर्वितिष्ठन्रुशद्भिर्वर्णैरभि राममस्थात्
14.1.e: Wilt thou not, Agni, lend us aid to win the cattle, win the wealth? Maker of room, make room for us

14.1.s: kayā te agne aṅgira ūrjo napādupastutim varāya deva manyave
14.1.d: कया ते अग्ने अङ्गिर ऊर्जो नपादुपस्तुतिम् वराय देव मन्यवे
14.1.e: In the great fight cast us not off, Agni, as one who bears a load: Snatch up the wealth and win it all! XIII Indra

14.1.s: dāśema kasya manasā yajñasya sahaso yaho kadu voca idaṃ namaḥ
14.1.d: दाशेम कस्य मनसा यज्ञस्य सहसो यहो कदु वोच इदं नमः
14.1.e: Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men bow down, As rivers bow them to the sea.

14.1.s: adʰā tvam̐ hi naskaro viśvā asmabʰyam̐ sukṣitīḥ vājadraviṇaso giraḥ
14.1.d: अधा त्वꣳ हि नस्करो विश्वा अस्मभ्यꣳ सुक्षितीः वाजद्रविणसो गिरः
14.1.e: Even fiercely-moving Vritra's head he served with his thunderbolt, His mighty hundred-knotted bolt.

14.1.s: agna ā yāhyagnibʰirhotāraṃ tvā vr̥ṇīmahe ā tvāmanaktu prayatā haviṣmatī yajiṣṭʰaṃ barhirāsade
14.1.d: अग्न आ याह्यग्निभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे आ त्वामनक्तु प्रयता हविष्मती यजिष्ठं बर्हिरासदे
14.1.e: That might of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth. XIV Indra

14.1.s: accʰā hi tvā sahasaḥ sūno aṅgiraḥ srucaścarantyadʰvare ūrjo napātaṃ gʰr̥takeśamīmahe 'gniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam
14.1.d: अच्छा हि त्वा सहसः सूनो अङ्गिरः स्रुचश्चरन्त्यध्वरे ऊर्जो नपातं घृतकेशमीमहे ऽग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम्
14.1.e: Kind-thoughted is the noble, gladdening, friendly one.

14.1.s: accʰā naḥ śīraśociṣaṃ giro yantu darśatam accʰā yajñāso namasā purūvasuṃ purupraśastamūtaye
14.1.d: अच्छा नः शीरशोचिषं गिरो यन्तु दर्शतम् अच्छा यज्ञासो नमसा पुरूवसुं पुरुप्रशस्तमूतये
14.1.e: Approach, O beauteous hero, this auspicious pair that draws the car! These two are coming near to us.

14.2.s: agnim̐ sūnum̐ sahaso jātavedasaṃ dānāya vāryāṇām dvitā yo bʰūdamr̥to martyeṣvā hotā mandratamo viśi
14.2.d: अग्निꣳ सूनुꣳ सहसो जातवेदसं दानाय वार्याणाम् द्विता यो भूदमृतो मर्त्येष्वा होता मन्द्रतमो विशि
14.2.e: Bend lowly down, as 'twere, your beads: be stands amid the water-flood, Pointing with his ten horns the way. I Indra

14.2.s: adābʰyaḥ puraetā viśāmagnirmānuṣīṇām tūrṇī ratʰaḥ sadā navaḥ
14.2.d: अदाभ्यः पुरएता विशामग्निर्मानुषीणाम् तूर्णी रथः सदा नवः
14.2.e: Pressers, blend Soma juice for him, each draugbt most excellent, for him The brave, the: hero, for his joy!

14.2.s: abʰi prayām̐si vāhasā dāśvām̐ aśnoti martyaḥ kṣayaṃ pāvakaśociṣaḥ
14.2.d: अभि प्रयाꣳसि वाहसा दाश्वाꣳ अश्नोति मर्त्यः क्षयं पावकशोचिषः
14.2.e: The two stroing bay steeds, voked by prayer, hither shall bring to us our friend, Indra, song-lover, through our songs.

14.2.s: sāhvānviśvā abʰiyujaḥ kraturdevānāmamr̥ktaḥ agnistuviśravastamaḥ
14.2.d: साह्वान्विश्वा अभियुजः क्रतुर्देवानाममृक्तः अग्निस्तुविश्रवस्तमः
14.2.e: The Vritra-slayer drinks the juice. May he who gives a hundred aids Approach, nor stay afar from us! II Indra

14.2.s: bʰadro no agnirāhuto bʰadrā rātiḥ subʰaga bʰadro adʰvaraḥ bʰadrā uta praśastayaḥ
14.2.d: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः
14.2.e: Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea O Indra, naught excelleth thee.

14.2.s: bʰadraṃ manaḥ kr̥ṇuṣva vr̥tratūrye yenā samatsu sāsahiḥ ava stʰirā tanuhi bʰūri śardʰatāṃ vanemā te abʰiṣṭaye
14.2.d: भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये येना समत्सु सासहिः अव स्थिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धतां वनेमा ते अभिष्टये
14.2.e: 'Thou' wakeful hero, by thy might hast taken food of Soma juice, Which, Indra, is within thee now.

14.2.s: agne vājasya gomata īśānaḥ sahaso yaho asme dehi jātavedo mahi śravaḥ
14.2.d: अग्ने वाजस्य गोमत ईशानः सहसो यहो अस्मे देहि जातवेदो महि श्रवः
14.2.e: O Indra, Vritra-slayer, let Soma be ready for thy maw, The drops be ready for thy forms! III Agni

14.2.s: sa idʰāno vasuṣkaviragnirīḍenyo girā revadasmabʰyaṃ purvaṇīka dīdihi
14.2.d: स इधानो वसुष्कविरग्निरीडेन्यो गिरा रेवदस्मभ्यं पुर्वणीक दीदिहि
14.2.e: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, a lovely hymn in Rudra's praise, Adorable in every house

14.2.s: kṣapo rājannuta tmanāgne vastorutoṣasaḥ sa tigmajambʰa rakṣaso daha prati
14.2.d: क्षपो राजन्नुत त्मनाग्ने वस्तोरुतोषसः स तिग्मजम्भ रक्षसो दह प्रति
14.2.e: May this our God, great, limitless, smoke-bannered, excellently bright, Urge us to holy thought and wealth

14.2.s: viśoviśo vo atitʰiṃ vājayantaḥ purupriyam agniṃ vo duryaṃ vaca stuṣe śūṣasya manmabʰiḥ
14.2.d: विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियम् अग्निं वो दुर्यं वच स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः
14.2.e: Like soma rich lord of men, may he, Agni, the banner of the Gods, Refulgent, hear us through our lauds! IV Indra

14.2.s: yaṃ janāso haviṣmanto mitraṃ na sarpirāsutim praśam̐santi praśastibʰiḥ
14.2.d: यं जनासो हविष्मन्तो मित्रं न सर्पिरासुतिम् प्रशꣳसन्ति प्रशस्तिभिः
14.2.e: Sing this, beside the flowing juice, to him, your hero, much invoked, To please him as a mighty Bull!

14.2.s: panyām̐saṃ jātavedasaṃ yo devatātyudyatā havyānyairayaddivi
14.2.d: पन्याꣳसं जातवेदसं यो देवतात्युद्यता हव्यान्यैरयद्दिवि
14.2.e: He, excellent, withholdeth not his bounteous gift of wealth in kine. When lie bath listened to our songs.

14.2.s: samiddʰamagnim̐ samidʰā girā gr̥ṇe śuciṃ pāvakaṃ puro adʰvare dʰruvam vipram̐ hotāraṃ puruvāramadruhaṃ kavim̐ sumnairīmahe jātavedasam
14.2.d: समिद्धमग्निꣳ समिधा गिरा गृणे शुचिं पावकं पुरो अध्वरे ध्रुवम् विप्रꣳ होतारं पुरुवारमद्रुहं कविꣳ सुम्नैरीमहे जातवेदसम्
14.2.e: May he with might unclose for us the cow's stall, whosesoe'er it be, To which the Dasyu-slayer goes! V Vishnu

14.2.s: tvāṃ dūtamagne amr̥taṃ yugeyuge havyavāhaṃ dadʰire pāyumīḍyam devāsaśca marttāsaśca jāgr̥viṃ vibʰuṃ viśpatiṃ namasā ni ṣedire
14.2.d: त्वां दूतमग्ने अमृतं युगेयुगे हव्यवाहं दधिरे पायुमीड्यम् देवासश्च मर्त्तासश्च जागृविं विभुं विश्पतिं नमसा नि षेदिरे
14.2.e: Through all this world strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep's dust.

14.2.s: vibʰūṣannagna ubʰayām̐ anu vratā dūto devānām̐ rajasī samīyase yatte dʰītim̐ sumatimāvr̥ṇīmahe 'dʰa smā nastrivarūtʰaḥ śivo bʰava
14.2.d: विभूषन्नग्न उभयाꣳ अनु व्रता दूतो देवानाꣳ रजसी समीयसे यत्ते धीतिꣳ सुमतिमावृणीमहे ऽध स्मा नस्त्रिवरूथः शिवो भव
14.2.e: Vishnu, the guardian, he whom none deceiveth, made three steps, thenceforth Establishing his high decrees.

14.2.s: upa tvā jāmayo giro dediśatīrhaviṣkr̥taḥ vāyoranīke astʰiran
14.2.d: उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः वायोरनीके अस्थिरन्
14.2.e: Look ye on Vishnu's works whereby the friend of Indra, close allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen

14.2.s: yasya tridʰātvavr̥taṃ barhistastʰāvasandinam āpaścinni dadʰā padam
14.2.d: यस्य त्रिधात्ववृतं बर्हिस्तस्थावसन्दिनम् आपश्चिन्नि दधा पदम्
14.2.e: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place of Vishnu, like An eye extended through the heavens.

14.2.s: padaṃ devasya mīḍʰuṣo 'nādʰr̥ṣṭābʰirūtibʰiḥ bʰadrā sūrya ivopadr̥k
14.2.d: पदं देवस्य मीढुषो ऽनाधृष्टाभिरूतिभिः भद्रा सूर्य इवोपदृक्
14.2.e: This, Vishou's station most sublime, the sages, ever-vigilant, Lovers of holy song, light up.

14.2.s: abʰi tvā pūrvapītaya indra stomebʰirāyavaḥ samīcīnāsa r̥bʰavaḥ samasvaranrudrā gr̥ṇanta pūrvyam
14.2.d: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यम्
14.2.e: May the Gods help and favour us out of the place whence Vishnu strode Over the back and ridge of earth. VI Indra

14.2.s: asyedindro vāvr̥dʰe vr̥ṣṇyam̐ śavo made sutasya viṣṇavi adyā tamasya mahimānamāyavo 'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvatʰā
14.2.d: अस्येदिन्द्रो वावृधे वृष्ण्यꣳ शवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवो ऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा
14.2.e: Let none, no, not thy worshippers, delay thee far away from us! Even from far away come thou unto our feast, or listen it already here!

14.2.s: pra vāmarcantyuktʰino nītʰāvido jaritāraḥ indrāgnī iṣa ā vr̥ṇe
14.2.d: प्र वामर्चन्त्युक्थिनो नीथाविदो जरितारः इन्द्राग्नी इष आ वृणे
14.2.e: For here, like rites on honey, those who pray to thee sit by the juice that they have poured. Wealth-craving singers have on Indra set their hope, as men set foot upon a car. VII Indra

14.2.s: indrāgnī navatiṃ puro dāsapatnīradʰūnutam sākamekena karmaṇā
14.2.d: इन्द्राग्नी नवतिं पुरो दासपत्नीरधूनुतम् साकमेकेन कर्मणा
14.2.e: Sung is the song of ancient time: to Indra have ye said the prayer. They have sung many a Brihati of sacrifice, poured forth the worshipper's many thoughts.

14.2.s: indrāgnī apasasparyupa pra yanti dʰītayaḥ r̥tasya patʰyā ' '3 anu
14.2.d: इन्द्राग्नी अपसस्पर्युप प्र यन्ति धीतयः ऋतस्य पथ्या ऽ ऽ३ अनु
14.2.e: Indra hath tossed together mighty stores of wealth, and both the worlds, yea, and the sun. Pure, brightly-shining, mingled with the milk, the draughts of Soma have made Indra glad. VIII Soma Pavamana

14.2.s: indrāgnī taviṣāṇī vām̐ sadʰastʰāni prayām̐si ca yuvoraptūryam̐ hitam
14.2.d: इन्द्राग्नी तविषाणी वाꣳ सधस्थानि प्रयाꣳसि च युवोरप्तूर्यꣳ हितम्
14.2.e: For Vritra-slaying Indra, thou, Soma, art poured that he may drink, And for the guerdon-giving man, the hero sitting in his seat.

14.2.s: śagdʰyū3 ṣu śacīpata indra viśvābʰirūtibʰiḥ bʰagaṃ na hi tvā yaśasaṃ vasuvidamanu śūra carāmasi
14.2.d: शग्ध्यू३ षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि
14.2.e: Friends, may the princes, ye and we, obtain this most resplendent one, Gain him who hath the smell of strength, win him whose home is very strength!

14.2.s: pauro aśvasya purukr̥dgavāmasyutso deva hiraṇyayaḥ na kirhi dānaṃ pari mardʰiṣatve yadyadyāmi tadā bʰara
14.2.d: पौरो अश्वस्य पुरुकृद्गवामस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः न किर्हि दानं परि मर्धिषत्वे यद्यद्यामि तदा भर
14.2.e: Him with the fleece they purify, brown, golden-hued, beloved of all. Who with exhilarating juice flows forth to all the deities. IX Indra

14.2.s: tvam̐ hyehi cerave vidā bʰagaṃ vasuttaye udvāvr̥ṣasva madʰavangaviṣṭaya udindrāśvamiṣṭaye
14.2.d: त्वꣳ ह्येहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये उद्वावृषस्व मधवन्गविष्टय उदिन्द्राश्वमिष्टये
14.2.e: Indra whose wealth is in thyself, what mortal will attack this man? The strong will win the spoil on the decisive day through faith in thee, O Maghavan!

14.2.s: tvaṃ purū sahasrāṇi śatāni ca yūtʰā dānāya mam̐hase ā purandaraṃ cakr̥ma vipravacasa indraṃ gāyanto 'vase
14.2.d: त्वं पुरू सहस्राणि शतानि च यूथा दानाय मꣳहसे आ पुरन्दरं चकृम विप्रवचस इन्द्रं गायन्तो ऽवसे
