14.2.e: In battles with the foe urge on our mighty ones who give the treasures dear to thee And may we with our princes, Lord of tawny steeds! pass through all peril, led by thee! X Indra

14.2.s: yo viśvā dayate vasu hotā mandro janānām madʰorna pātrā pratʰamānyasmai pra stomā yantvagnaye
14.2.d: यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानाम् मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्वग्नये
14.2.e: Come, priest, and of the savoury juice pour forth a yet more gladdening draught! So is the hero praised who ever prospers us.

14.2.s: aśva na gīrbʰī ratʰyam̐ sudānavo marmr̥jyante devayavaḥ ubʰe toke tanaye dasma vispate parṣi rādʰo magʰonām
14.2.d: अश्व न गीर्भी रथ्यꣳ सुदानवो मर्मृज्यन्ते देवयवः उभे तोके तनये दस्म विस्पते पर्षि राधो मघोनाम्
14.2.e: Indra, whom tawny coursers bear, praise such as thine, preeminent, None by his power or by his goodness hath attained.

14.2.s: imaṃ me varuṇa śrudʰī havamadyā ca mr̥ḍaya tvāmavasyurā cake
14.2.d: इमं मे वरुण श्रुधी हवमद्या च मृडय त्वामवस्युरा चके
14.2.e: We, seeking glory, have invoked this God of yours, the Lord of wealth, Who must be magnified by constant sacrifice. XI Agni

14.2.s: kayā tvaṃ na ūtyābʰi pra mandase vr̥ṣan kayā stotr̥bʰya ā bʰara
14.2.d: कया त्वं न ऊत्याभि प्र मन्दसे वृषन् कया स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
14.2.e: Sing praise to him, the Lord of light. The Gods have made the God to be their messenger, To bear oblation to the Gods.

14.2.s: indramiddevatātaya indraṃ prayatyadʰvare indram̐ samīke vanino havāmaha indraṃ dʰanasya sātaye
14.2.d: इन्द्रमिद्देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे इन्द्रꣳ समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये
14.2.e: Agni, the bounteous giver, bright with varied flames, laud thou, O singer Sobhari, Him who controls this sacred food with Soma blent, who hath first claim to sacrifice! XII Soma Pavamana

14.2.s: indro mahnā rodasī papratʰaccʰava indraḥ sūryamarocayat indre ha viśvā bʰuvanāni yemira indre suvānāsa indavaḥ
14.2.d: इन्द्रो मह्ना रोदसी पप्रथच्छव इन्द्रः सूर्यमरोचयत् इन्द्रे ह विश्वा भुवनानि येमिर इन्द्रे सुवानास इन्दवः
14.2.e: Expressed by stones, O Soma, and urged through the long wool of the sheep, Thou, entering the press-boards, even as men a fort, goldbued, hast settled in the vats.

14.2.s: viśvakarmanhaviṣā vāvr̥dʰānaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanvā3m̐ svā hi te muhyantvanye abʰito janāsa ihāsmākaṃ magʰavā sūrirastu
14.2.d: विश्वकर्मन्हविषा वावृधानः स्वयं यजस्व तन्वा३ꣳ स्वा हि ते मुह्यन्त्वन्ये अभितो जनास इहास्माकं मघवा सूरिरस्तु
14.2.e: He beautifies himself through the sheep's long fine wool, the bounteous, like the racing steed, Even Soma Pavamana who shall be the joy of sages and of holy bards. XIII Indra

14.2.s: ayā rucā hariṇyā punāno viśvā dveṣām̐si tarati sayugvabʰiḥ sūro na sayugvabʰiḥ dʰārā pr̥ṣṭʰasya rocate punāno aruṣo hariḥ viśvā yadrūpā pariyāsyr̥kvabʰiḥ saptāsyebʰirr̥kvabʰiḥ
14.2.d: अया रुचा हरिण्या पुनानो विश्वा द्वेषाꣳसि तरति सयुग्वभिः सूरो न सयुग्वभिः धारा पृष्ठस्य रोचते पुनानो अरुषो हरिः विश्वा यद्रूपा परियास्यृक्वभिः सप्तास्येभिरृक्वभिः
14.2.e: Here, verily, yesterday we let the Thunder-wielder drink his fill. Bring him the juice poured forth in sacrifice to-day! Now range you by the glorious one!

14.2.s: prācīmanu pradiśaṃ pāti cekitatsam̐ raśmibʰiryatate darśato ratʰo daivyo darśato ratʰaḥ agmannuktʰāni paum̐syendraṃ jaitrāya harṣayata vajraśca yadbʰavatʰo anapacyutā samatsvanapacyutā
14.2.d: प्राचीमनु प्रदिशं पाति चेकितत्सꣳ रश्मिभिर्यतते दर्शतो रथो दैव्यो दर्शतो रथः अग्मन्नुक्थानि पौꣳस्येन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षयत वज्रश्च यद्भवथो अनपच्युता समत्स्वनपच्युता
14.2.e: Even the wolf, the savage beast that rends the sheep, follows the path of his decrees. So graciously accepting, Indra, this our praise, with wondrous thought come forth to us! XIV Indra-Agni

14.2.s: tvaṃ ha tyatpaṇīnāṃ vido vasu saṃ mātr̥bʰirmarjayasi sva ā dama r̥tasya dʰītibʰirdame parāvato na sāma tadyatrā raṇanti dʰītayaḥ tridʰātubʰiraruṣībʰirvayo dadʰe rocamāno vayo dadʰe
14.2.d: त्वं ह त्यत्पणीनां विदो वसु सं मातृभिर्मर्जयसि स्व आ दम ऋतस्य धीतिभिर्दमे परावतो न साम तद्यत्रा रणन्ति धीतयः त्रिधातुभिररुषीभिर्वयो दधे रोचमानो वयो दधे
14.2.e: Indra and Agni, in your deeds of might ye deck heaven's lucid realms: Famed is that hero strength of yours.

14.2.s: uta no goṣaṇiṃ dʰiyamaśvasāṃ vājasāmuta nr̥vatkr̥ṇuhyūtaye
14.2.d: उत नो गोषणिं धियमश्वसां वाजसामुत नृवत्कृणुह्यूतये
14.2.e: To Indra and to Agni prayers go forward from the holy task. Along the path of sacred Law.

14.2.s: śaśamānasya vā naraḥ svedasya satyaśavasaḥ vidā kāmasya venataḥ
14.2.d: शशमानस्य वा नरः स्वेदस्य सत्यशवसः विदा कामस्य वेनतः
14.2.e: Indra and Agni, powers are yours, yours are oblations and abodes: Good is your zealous energy. XV Indra

14.2.s: upa naḥ sūnavo giraḥ śr̥ṇvantvamr̥tasya ye sumr̥ḍīkā bʰavantu naḥ
14.2.d: उप नः सूनवो गिरः शृण्वन्त्वमृतस्य ये सुमृडीका भवन्तु नः
14.2.e: Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-cheeked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.

14.2.s: pra vāṃ mahi dyavī abʰyupastutiṃ bʰarāmahe śucī upa praśastaye
14.2.d: प्र वां महि द्यवी अभ्युपस्तुतिं भरामहे शुची उप प्रशस्तये
14.2.e: As a wild elephant rushes on, this way and that way mad with heat, None may restrain thee, yet come hither to the draught! Thou, movest mighty in thy power.

14.2.s: punāne tanvā mitʰaḥ svena dakṣeṇa rājatʰaḥ ūhyātʰe sanādr̥tam
14.2.d: पुनाने तन्वा मिथः स्वेन दक्षेण राजथः ऊह्याथे सनादृतम्
14.2.e: When he, the terrible, ne'er o'erthrown, stedfast, made ready for the fight-- When Indra Maghavan lists to his praiser's call, he will not stand aloof, but come. XVI Soma Pavamana

14.2.s: mahī mitrasya sādʰatʰastarantī pipratī r̥tam pari yajñaṃ ni ṣedatʰuḥ
14.2.d: मही मित्रस्य साधथस्तरन्ती पिप्रती ऋतम् परि यज्ञं नि षेदथुः
14.2.e: The Pavamanas have been poured, the brilliant drops of Soma juice, For holy lore of every kind.

14.2.s: ayamu te samatasi kapota iva garbʰadʰim vacastaccinna ohase
14.2.d: अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिम् वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे
14.2.e: From heaven, from out the firmament hath PavamAna been effused Upon the back and ridge of earth.

14.2.s: stotram̐ rādʰānāṃ pate girvāho vīra yasya te vibʰūtirastu sūnr̥tā
14.2.d: स्तोत्रꣳ राधानां पते गिर्वाहो वीर यस्य ते विभूतिरस्तु सूनृता
14.2.e: The Pavamanas have been shed, the beautified swift Somadrops, Driving all enemies afar. XVII Indra-Agni I. Indra and Agni I invoke, joint-victors, bounteous, unsubdued, Foe-slayers, best to win the spoil.

14.2.s: ūrdʰvastiṣṭʰā na ūtaye 'sminvāje śatakrato samanyeṣu bravāvahai
14.2.d: ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा न ऊतये ऽस्मिन्वाजे शतक्रतो समन्येषु ब्रवावहै
14.2.e: Indra and Agni, singers skilled in melody hymn you bringing lauds: I choose you both to bring me food.

14.2.s: gāva upa vadāvaṭe mahi yajñasya rapsudā ubʰā karṇā hiraṇyayā
14.2.d: गाव उप वदावटे महि यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया
14.2.e: Together, with one mighty deed, Indra and Agni, ye shook down. The ninety forts which Dasas held. XVIII Agni

14.2.s: abʰyāramidadrayo niṣiktaṃ puṣkare madʰu avaṭasya visarjane
14.2.d: अभ्यारमिदद्रयो निषिक्तं पुष्करे मधु अवटस्य विसर्जने
14.2.e: O Child of Strength, to thee whose look is lovely, with oblations we, O Agni, have poured forth our songs.

14.2.s: siñcanti namasāvaṭamuccācakraṃ parijmānam nīcīnabāramakṣitam
14.2.d: सिञ्चन्ति नमसावटमुच्चाचक्रं परिज्मानम् नीचीनबारमक्षितम्
14.2.e: To thee for shelter are we come, as to the shade from fervent heat, Agni, who glitterest like gold

14.2.s: mā bʰema mā śramiṣmograsya sakʰye tava mahatte vr̥ṣṇo abʰicakṣyaṃ kr̥taṃ paśyema turvaśaṃ yadum
14.2.d: मा भेम मा श्रमिष्मोग्रस्य सख्ये तव महत्ते वृष्णो अभिचक्ष्यं कृतं पश्येम तुर्वशं यदुम्
14.2.e: Mighty as one who slays with shafts, or like a bull with sharpened horn, Agni, thou brakest down the forts. XIX Agni

14.2.s: savyāmanu spʰigyaṃ vāvase vr̥ṣnā na dāno asya roṣati madʰvā saṃpr̥ktāḥ sāragʰeṇa dʰenavastūyamehi dravā piba
14.2.d: सव्यामनु स्फिग्यं वावसे वृष्ना न दानो अस्य रोषति मध्वा संपृक्ताः सारघेण धेनवस्तूयमेहि द्रवा पिब
14.2.e: To give eternal glow, we pray Vaisvanara the holy one, Lord of the light of sacrifice.

14.2.s: imā u tvā purūvaso giro vardʰantu yā mama pāvakavarṇāḥ śucayo vipaścito 'bʰi stomairanūṣata
14.2.d: इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितो ऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत
14.2.e: Who, furthering the light of Law, hath spread himself to meet this work: He sends the seasons, mighty one.
